# About Accufoam

# Driven by innovation. Defined by our partners.

[AccufoamBrandPhotography-177.jpeg]

As America’s leading independent spray foam manufacturer, Accufoam is dedicated to designing and
innovating industry-leading insulation solutions that set the standard for performance and
reliability. Built on a foundation of technical expertise and a passion for innovation, we develop
spray foam systems that deliver superior thermal efficiency, durability, and ease of application for
contractors nationwide. As an independent manufacturer, we have the agility to adapt, the vision to
lead, and the commitment to provide products and support that help our partners succeed on every
job.

Proven Performance

Smart Innovation

Trusted Support

Lasting Value

[DSCF6937-2_edited_edited.jpg]

## Who We Are

At Accufoam, we are innovators, chemists, and problem-solvers dedicated to advancing building
science and supporting contractors nationwide. More than a manufacturer, we’re a trusted
partner—providing industry-leading spray foam products backed by technical expertise, training, and
dependable support.

## Our Mission

### Quality

At Accufoam, quality is built into every batch of spray foam we manufacture. Our rigorous testing
and commitment to consistency ensure contractors can trust our products to perform on every job.

### Innovation

We continually push the boundaries of building science, developing spray foam systems that lead the
industry in performance, safety, and sustainability. Innovation drives everything we do, from
product design to contractor support.

### Partnership

We believe success is built together, which is why we prioritize strong, lasting relationships with
the contractors and distributors we serve. Through training, technical expertise, and dependable
service, we help our partners grow and succeed.

## Our Team

[DSCF6234-2_edited.jpg]

## Robert McClellan

## President

Robert oversees the day-to-day operations of accounting and works closely with the executive team to
develop and implement strategies that support growth, minimize risk and preserve company assets. He
has devoted a majority of his career to the accounting function of various manufacturing companies.
Prior to working at Accufoam®, Robert founded a boutique accounting firm where he and his team
served clients’ needs across multiple industries. He acquired his accounting degree from one of the
top programs in the country at the University of Mississippi. Robert enjoys playing sports,
adventuring in the outdoors, and spending time with his wife and six children. He is an active
member of his church and has served on the boards of several local nonprofits.

[Ronnie_edited.jpg]

## Ronnie Dean

## National Sales Manager

Ronnie Dean brings over 30 years of experience in sales and marketing aligning customer needs with
best-in-class products. His emphasis on ease of use and ease of doing business in terms of the
overall experience builds a lasting “trusted advisor” type customer relationship. Before joining our
team, Ronnie held various positions in wireless technology, developing semiconductor products for
mobile telephones, satellite radios, and the automotive industry. Ronnie holds a Bachelor of Science
in Electrical Engineering from Polytechnic State University. He is an avid track enthusiast who
enjoys chasing lap times and helping keep the manual alive. When not on a track he enjoys dragging
his family on history vacations, cooking, and appreciating nature with a hike.

[DSCF6102-2_edited.jpg]

## Charlie Rose

## Chief Commercial Officer

Charlie is responsible for the sales and marketing strategy at Accufoam®. In this role, he oversees
the development of the sales team and works with the executive team on growth strategies and
emerging markets. Charlie has an extensive background in sales and management. Prior to working at
Accufoam, he worked as a national sales manager in the chemical distribution industry. Charlie
received his BA from North Carolina State University and MBA from Clemson University. When not in
the office, you can find Charlie spending time with his wife and two children at the ball field,
catching a game, or on the golf course.

[DSCF6170-2_edited.jpg]

## Abel Sauceda

## National Technical Manager

Abel Sauceda oversees all aspects of Technical Service operations at Creative Polymer Solutions. He
leads and trains a team of tech service reps, coordinates projects, and ensures quality and safety
standards are consistently met. Abel emphasizes training and continuing education, while also
focusing on resolving technical service issues efficiently and maintaining high levels of customer
satisfaction. Before joining Creative Polymer Solutions, Abel ran his own spray foam business and
spent seven years in spray foam insulation distribution, where he was recognized as a top Graco
equipment and parts salesman. With nearly eight years in the spray foam insulation industry and over
eleven years in the building supply sector, Abel brings a wealth of experience to the table.
Certified as a Master Mechanic for PMC (Polyurethane Machinery Corporation) equipment and fluent in
both English and Spanish, Abel is passionate about woodworking and saltwater fishing. He values
quality time with his family and enjoys traveling with his wife to explore new destinations.

[James_edited_edited.png]

## James Hammon

## Chief Technical Officer & C0-Founder

James D. Hammon serves as Chief Technology Officer and Co-Founder of Accufoam®, where he leads
technology strategy, research and development, product innovation, and technical support
initiatives. Since helping establish the company, James has played a key role in developing
proprietary polyurethane technologies, expanding product offerings, supporting customers, and
driving innovation across multiple markets. He works closely with customers, manufacturing teams,
and commercial leadership to develop solutions that address complex technical challenges while
supporting the company’s long-term growth strategy. James holds a Bachelor of Science in
Biochemistry from the Georgia Institute of Technology, a Master of Science in Materials Engineering,
and a Master of Business Administration.

[DJI_20240523152304_0052_D-2.jpg]

Creative Polymer Solutions is America's leading independent systems house in polyurethane foam

application-speciﬁc solutions leveraging the unique and versatile properties of polyurethane resins.

# About Accufoam

# Driven by innovation. Defined by our partners.

[AccufoamBrandPhotography-177.jpeg]

As America’s leading independent spray foam manufacturer, Accufoam is dedicated to designing and
innovating industry-leading insulation solutions that set the standard for performance and
reliability. Built on a foundation of technical expertise and a passion for innovation, we develop
spray foam systems that deliver superior thermal efficiency, durability, and ease of application for
contractors nationwide. As an independent manufacturer, we have the agility to adapt, the vision to
lead, and the commitment to provide products and support that help our partners succeed on every
job.

Proven Performance

Smart Innovation

Trusted Support

Lasting Value

[DSCF6937-2_edited_edited.jpg]

## Who We Are

At Accufoam, we are innovators, chemists, and problem-solvers dedicated to advancing building
science and supporting contractors nationwide. More than a manufacturer, we’re a trusted
partner—providing industry-leading spray foam products backed by technical expertise, training, and
dependable support.

## Our Mission

### Quality

At Accufoam, quality is built into every batch of spray foam we manufacture. Our rigorous testing
and commitment to consistency ensure contractors can trust our products to perform on every job.

### Innovation

We continually push the boundaries of building science, developing spray foam systems that lead the
industry in performance, safety, and sustainability. Innovation drives everything we do, from
product design to contractor support.

### Partnership

We believe success is built together, which is why we prioritize strong, lasting relationships with
the contractors and distributors we serve. Through training, technical expertise, and dependable
service, we help our partners grow and succeed.

## Our Team

[DSCF6234-2_edited.jpg]

## Robert McClellan

## President

Robert oversees the day-to-day operations of accounting and works closely with the executive team to
develop and implement strategies that support growth, minimize risk and preserve company assets. He
has devoted a majority of his career to the accounting function of various manufacturing companies.
Prior to working at Accufoam®, Robert founded a boutique accounting firm where he and his team
served clients’ needs across multiple industries. He acquired his accounting degree from one of the
top programs in the country at the University of Mississippi. Robert enjoys playing sports,
adventuring in the outdoors, and spending time with his wife and six children. He is an active
member of his church and has served on the boards of several local nonprofits.

[Ronnie_edited.jpg]

## Ronnie Dean

## National Sales Manager

Ronnie Dean brings over 30 years of experience in sales and marketing aligning customer needs with
best-in-class products. His emphasis on ease of use and ease of doing business in terms of the
overall experience builds a lasting “trusted advisor” type customer relationship. Before joining our
team, Ronnie held various positions in wireless technology, developing semiconductor products for
mobile telephones, satellite radios, and the automotive industry. Ronnie holds a Bachelor of Science
in Electrical Engineering from Polytechnic State University. He is an avid track enthusiast who
enjoys chasing lap times and helping keep the manual alive. When not on a track he enjoys dragging
his family on history vacations, cooking, and appreciating nature with a hike.

[DSCF6102-2_edited.jpg]

## Charlie Rose

## Chief Commercial Officer

Charlie is responsible for the sales and marketing strategy at Accufoam®. In this role, he oversees
the development of the sales team and works with the executive team on growth strategies and
emerging markets. Charlie has an extensive background in sales and management. Prior to working at
Accufoam, he worked as a national sales manager in the chemical distribution industry. Charlie
received his BA from North Carolina State University and MBA from Clemson University. When not in
the office, you can find Charlie spending time with his wife and two children at the ball field,
catching a game, or on the golf course.

[DSCF6170-2_edited.jpg]

## Abel Sauceda

## National Technical Manager

Abel Sauceda oversees all aspects of Technical Service operations at Creative Polymer Solutions. He
leads and trains a team of tech service reps, coordinates projects, and ensures quality and safety
standards are consistently met. Abel emphasizes training and continuing education, while also
focusing on resolving technical service issues efficiently and maintaining high levels of customer
satisfaction. Before joining Creative Polymer Solutions, Abel ran his own spray foam business and
spent seven years in spray foam insulation distribution, where he was recognized as a top Graco
equipment and parts salesman. With nearly eight years in the spray foam insulation industry and over
eleven years in the building supply sector, Abel brings a wealth of experience to the table.
Certified as a Master Mechanic for PMC (Polyurethane Machinery Corporation) equipment and fluent in
both English and Spanish, Abel is passionate about woodworking and saltwater fishing. He values
quality time with his family and enjoys traveling with his wife to explore new destinations.

[James_edited_edited.png]

## James Hammon

## Chief Technical Officer & C0-Founder

James D. Hammon serves as Chief Technology Officer and Co-Founder of Accufoam®, where he leads
technology strategy, research and development, product innovation, and technical support
initiatives. Since helping establish the company, James has played a key role in developing
proprietary polyurethane technologies, expanding product offerings, supporting customers, and
driving innovation across multiple markets. He works closely with customers, manufacturing teams,
and commercial leadership to develop solutions that address complex technical challenges while
supporting the company’s long-term growth strategy. James holds a Bachelor of Science in
Biochemistry from the Georgia Institute of Technology, a Master of Science in Materials Engineering,
and a Master of Business Administration.

[DJI_20240523152304_0052_D-2.jpg]

## A Creative Polymer Solutions Company

Creative Polymer Solutions is America's leading independent systems house in polyurethane foam
technology. From the factory to the job site, CPS takes an innovative approach to develop
application-speciﬁc solutions leveraging the unique and versatile properties of polyurethane resins.
Everything we do reflects our precision chemistry, high-accuracy manufacturing, and dependable
customer service. All so you can have a partner you're confident relying on.

About Aerofoam® Thermal Insulation Solutions

Aerofoam ® Thermal Insulation Division is the leading manufacturer of insulation products such as elastomeric insulation and polyolefin insulation in UAE. A division of Hira Industries LLC, the company is renowned for providing thermal insulation, acoustic solutions and engineered foams to its loyal clientele throughout the Americas, Middle East, SE Asia, Africa, India, Australia, and Europe.

With a strong network of distributors in the Americas, Middle East, SE Asia, Africa, India and Australia, Aerofoam ® thermal insulation solutions division provides world-class technical support and prompt delivery of its products to its customers. All Aerofoam ® products are manufactured according to British, American and other international standards and undergo rigorous testing procedures before being distributed to the market.

# ABOUT US

Aerofoam^{®} is a brand of Hira Industries, a family-owned multinational organization with offices
in 30 countries, 16 production units and a well-trained workforce of 1500 team members.

At Aerofoam^{®}, we are committed to provide high quality sustainable thermal insulation and
acoustic solutions, we invest in smart technologies for high-quality cost-effective solutions with
excellent performance in energy conservation that exceed client expectations while also improving
living comfort. Aerofoam^{®} thermal insulation and acoustic solutions have multiple applications
that help the customers obtain more for less.

At Aerofoam^{®}, we are dedicated to improving energy efficiency, saving energy losses, reducing
carbon emissions and costs with a comprehensive range of hygienic and environment friendly
polyolefin and elastomeric thermal insulation, and efficient acoustic solutions.

#### **Our product line includes but is not limited to:**

[Aerofoam^{®} XLPE][41] – A cross-linked closed cell polyolefin thermal insulation foam for HVAC
applications, Aerofoam^{®} XLPE is manufactured in different sizes and foil facers for indoor and
outdoor applications.

[Aerofoam^{®} NBR][42] – A flexible closed cell elastomeric thermal insulation foam, Aerofoam^{®}
NBR is FM approved. Aerofoam^{®} NBR products are manufactured in various sizes and foil facers
which include colored glass cloth, aluminum foil for indoor and outdoor applications.

# ABOUT US

Aerofoam^{®} is a brand of Hira Industries, a family-owned multinational organization with offices
in 30 countries, 16 production units and a well-trained workforce of 1500 team members.

At Aerofoam^{®}, we are committed to provide high quality sustainable thermal insulation and
acoustic solutions, we invest in smart technologies for high-quality cost-effective solutions with
excellent performance in energy conservation that exceed client expectations while also improving
living comfort. Aerofoam^{®} thermal insulation and acoustic solutions have multiple applications
that help the customers obtain more for less.

At Aerofoam^{®}, we are dedicated to improving energy efficiency, saving energy losses, reducing
carbon emissions and costs with a comprehensive range of hygienic and environment friendly
polyolefin and elastomeric thermal insulation, and efficient acoustic solutions.

#### **Our product line includes but is not limited to:**

[Aerofoam^{®} XLPE][41] – A cross-linked closed cell polyolefin thermal insulation foam for HVAC
applications, Aerofoam^{®} XLPE is manufactured in different sizes and foil facers for indoor and
outdoor applications.

[Aerofoam^{®} NBR][42] – A flexible closed cell elastomeric thermal insulation foam, Aerofoam^{®}
NBR is FM approved. Aerofoam^{®} NBR products are manufactured in various sizes and foil facers
which include colored glass cloth, aluminum foil for indoor and outdoor applications.

[AeroReflect Reflective Insulation][43] – Aerofoam^{®} reflective roof thermal insulation products
are specially designed to reflect radiant heat and ensure you are kept cool in summer and warm in
winter. We assure you superior thermal performance and improved energy efficiency in homes,
commercial and industrial buildings.

[AeroSound^{®} Acoustic Solutions][44] – The best solutions for your acoustic comfort in civil and
industrial construction.

Aerofoam^{®} thermal insulation products have been used in various projects across several
geographic locations and comply with the most important standards required by the insulation
industry.

_crawl.linkedin_about: At Alleguard, we’re built from the ground up to expand and shape your business. We understand the diversity of challenges that customers are facing across different industries—from lacking confidence in their supply chain to needing the latest innovations at their fingertips. These challenges are also opportunities, and whether our customers are in construction, protective packaging, cold-chain or other industries, we are relentless in seeing around corners and going the extra mile to help their businesses succeed. Our breadth and depth of engineering expertise, materials knowledge and geographic reach allow us to not only meet but also, surpass our customers’ expectations across industries. We have a combined 60-year history and proven track record to address our customers’ needs. What began as six regional businesses has become an international network of designers, engineers, manufacturers and specialists working as one to provide unmatched service and support to our customers. Our history of building great relationships with both colleagues and clients empowers us to be innovators in our industry

# Geofoam

Geofoam’s affordability, R-Value retention, light weight, and durability make it the perfect choice
for civil engineering and infrastructure applications such as slope stabilizer, retaining wall
backfill, road embankments, and pavement insulation.

[Talk to a Sales Rep][138]

Lightweight

Water Resistant

High Thermal Insulation Value

Easy to Handle

High Compressive Strength

## What Is Geofoam?

Geofoam is an expanded polystyrene rigid cellular plastic foam manufactured in blocks and available
in a range of sizes and densities.

## Our Geofoam Products

[ Retaining Wall Learn More ][139]

### Retaining Wall

Geofoam blocks provide a durable, safe, budget-friendly alternative to soil fill behind retaining
walls.

[ Bridge Deck Filler Learn More ][140]

### Bridge Deck Filler

Reduce design and construction costs with lightweight, durable Geofoam embankment fill.

[ Green Roof Construction Learn More ][141]

### Green Roof Construction

Geofoam provides long-term R-value retention and superior compressive strength for green roof
construction.

[ Geofoam Soil Substitute Learn more ][142]

### Geofoam Soil Substitute

Available in a variety of densities, Alleguard Geofoam Soil Substitute blocks are custom cut to your
specifications.

When deciding on an appropriate soil substitute for civil engineering projects, job coordinators
take material and labor costs, material performance, availability, durability, and sustainability
into account. Geofoam checks all of these boxes and more. Unlike soil, Geofoam reduces lateral
pressure on structures while maintaining high compressive strength.

[ Geofoam Backfill Learn more ][143]

### Geofoam Backfill

Lightweight Geofoam blocks reduce lateral pressure, making them perfect for a wide range of backfill
applications.

Weather-resistant, easy to work with, and easy to specify, Geofoam is a great option for lightweight
backfill and void fill in civil engineering projects such as buried wall construction. Geofoam can
be unloaded and installed by hand, lowering labor time and cost.

##### Benefits of Geofoam

### Reduce Costs, Increase Stability

Used in geotechnical applications for decades, Geofoam’s extraordinary properties make it ideal for
a wide variety of civil engineering and infrastructure projects, including green roof construction,
bridge deck filler, retaining wall construction, and more. Geofoam is lightweight and low density
with superior compressive strength and thermal insulation value. And its ease of handling reduces
labor costs and construction time.

From molded coolers to custom solutions, Alleguard’s Cold Chain products are designed to maintain
quality and prevent loss of temperature-controlled products from produce to pharmaceuticals.

[Talk to a Sales Rep][138]

#### Maintain Cold Chain Product Integrity

With superior insulating properties, outstanding shock resistance, EPS packaging is ideal for food,
pharmaceutical, and life science products. It maintains product safety, security, and temperature
stability throughout the cold chain delivery process.

## Our Cold Chain Solution Products

### Molded Insulated Shipping Containers

Our molded insulated shipping containers offer lightweight, cost-effective temperature control. Our
pre-qualified shippers for various temperature ranges and pack-outs are ideal for frozen,
refrigerated, perishable, and temperature-sensitive items.

[ 6-Panel Box Liners Learn More ][140]

### 6-Panel Box Liners

Alleguard Six-Panel Box Liners can be customized to fit boxes of any size. We can also customize
liner thickness to fit any application.

[ XDS Solutions Learn More ][141]

### XDS Solutions

Our XDS Extended Duration Shipping containers are designed to keep products cool for longer shipping
durations, offering you more shipping options and greater savings.

[ Custom Solutions Learn More ][142]

### Custom Solutions

We design, produce, and offer custom cold-chain solutions including EPS manufactured products, gel
packs, corrugated kitting, and other molded or fabricated solutions.

[ Biodegradable EPS Learn More ][143]

### Biodegradable EPS Foams

At the forefront of sustainable packaging materials, biodegradable EPS offers a greener alternative
to traditional EPS without compromising on performance.

Biodegradable EPS foam is ideal for molded coolers and custom cold chain solutions. Its superior
insulating properties ensure that perishable items remain at the required temperatures during
transit, preserving product freshness and safety.

## Ampex® Radiant Floor
## Heating Panel

Our Radiant Floor Heating Panels combine rigid insulation, a vapor barrier and a PEX tubing locking
mechanism into a single solution that significantly reduces installation time. Our patented
“mushroom” shaped nubs lock PEX tubing in place without staples or zip ties. Customers will
appreciate how quickly surfaces reach the desired temperature thanks to a larger contact area for
tubing and concrete.
* Four sided interlocking shiplap connectors
* HIPS film acts as a vapor barrier and adds durability
* Bridge connectors enable better heat distribution
* Mushroom nubs firmly locks the tubing in place
* Available in a range of R-values and compressive strengths

## Ampex® Low Profile

Ampex Low Profile is a non-structural insulated panel used for hydronic radiant floor systems within
interior applications. The panels are placed above existing concrete slabs, and overlayed with
concrete topping. The combination of closed cell, molded Expanded Polystyrene (EPS) insulation with
High Impact Polystyrene (HIPS) film, makes for a resilient panel.

The panel combines high density rigid insulation, a vapor barrier and PEX piping locking mechanism
into a single solution that significantly reduces installation time. Ideal for installation above
concrete slabs such as in basements, and bathrooms.

### SilveRboard®

SilveRboard® is extremely durable, lightweight, and is easy to install. Cost-effective and
moisture-resistant, SilveRboard® has excellent dimensional stability, compressive strength and
R-value retention.

Aavailable in a wide range of thicknesses ranging from 1/2″ (13mm) to 6″ (152mm).

### SilveRboard^{®} Graphite

High performing and cost effective non-structural graphite polystyrene (GPS) rigid insulation board
is ideal for exterior wall applications on wood or steel frame construction. The expanded
polystyrene (EPS) core is embedded with graphite particles which increase thermal performance
compared to conventional EPS.

Available in thicknesses from 1/2″ (13mm) to 6″ (152mm).

Standard board dimensions include 4×8′ and 4×9′ (1.2×2.4m and 1.2×2.7m).

### Envirostrap Integrated Strapping

Envirostrap Integrated Strapping is a rigid insulation board made from closed cell EPS with two
integrated furring strips on one side. This highly effective combination of materials offers a
2-in-1 solution incorporating insulation and finish attachment surfaces that can be used for both
exterior above-grade and interior below-grade applications.

Envirostrap comes in 32″ (813mm) width and is available in 8’ and 9′ lengths (2.4m and 2.7m).

Available in thicknesses from 2-5/8″ (67mm) and 3-1/2″ (89mm).

[Learn more about Envirostrap →][147]

[ Amrad Learn more ][148]

### Amrad: Insulated Radon Gas Mitigation Panel

Amrad is an insulated under slab depressurization panel and a key component in a radon gas
mitigation system. The void created by the integrated channels serve as an air gap for soil gas
collection. Radon gas is able to vent out to the exterior through the use of a connected PVC piping
with a continuously running exhaust fan.

[Learn more about Amrad →][149]

Tapered Roofing

### Tapered Roofing

Alleguard Tapered EPS Roofing offers stable, long-term R-values and superior dimensional stability
with excellent compressive strength, water resistance, and drainage capabilities. The tapered design
outperforms traditional flat foam panels in resistance to tensile forces and structural loads.
Tapered EPS Roofing contains fewer voids than flat panels, protecting against heat transfer in the
event of a fire. It’s the perfect choice for ballasted mechanically fastened single-ply roof
applications with a slip sheet and low sloped built-up roofs made from modified bitumen.

#### Our Rigid Board has superior long-term R-value retention and moisture resistance. Customizable,
#### sustainable, and cost effective.

## Why EPS?

EPS has high R-value retention, is fully recyclable, and is easily customizable. EPS is made without
ozone-harming compounds or any kind of dye. It is available in a variety of compressive strengths
and has superior bonding capabilities. Best of all, EPS will save you time and money. So the real
question is: Why not EPS?

#### Build Resilient and Energy-Efficient Roofs

Alleguard’s EPS solutions are designed to meet the demands of modern roofing, offering unparalleled

energy-efficient roofs that are built to last.

## Our Roof Insulation Products

[ Reflective SilveRboard® Learn more ][140]

### Reflective SilveRboard®

SilveRboard® flat sheet rigid board insulation is an excellent choice for roofing applications,
offering enhanced energy efficiency and durability. With a high-performance Expanded Polystyrene
(EPS) core, it delivers superior R-Values to improve overall roof insulation. The reflective foil
facing significantly reduces heat transfer, helping to maintain consistent indoor temperatures
throughout the year. Additionally, its lightweight yet durable construction makes installation quick
and efficient, ensuring maximum roofing performance with minimal effort.

**Product Features:**
* High-Performance EPS
* Reflective EPS Foam Board
* R4.1, R4.3, R4.35 and R5
* 20-Year Thermal Warranty

[Learn more about SilveRboard® →][141]

[ Envirosheet Flat Insulation Learn more ][142]

### Envirosheet Flat Insulation

Envirosheet is a cost-effective rigid board insulation solution designed for both residential and
commercial roofing applications. Its durable Expanded Polystyrene (EPS) core delivers high R-Values,
ensuring long-term thermal efficiency in any climate. The lightweight yet rigid construction
enhances installation ease while providing superior performance for both flat and sloped roofing
systems.

**Product Features:**
* High-Performance EPS
* Lightweight & Easy To Install
* R3.9 – R4.4 Available
* 20-Year Thermal Warranty

[Learn more about Envirosheet →][143]

[ Flute Fill Learn more ][144]

### Flute Fill

Designed to enhance roofing assemblies with precision, performance, and cost-efficiency.
Customizable in flat cut or tapered cut, Flute Fill EPS insulation offers a lightweight design that
simplifies installation while reducing structural load. Specifically engineered for standing seam
metal roof systems, Flute Fill combines high compressive strength with superior moisture resistance
to deliver long-lasting durability. Its excellent R-Value retention ensures optimal thermal
insulation over time, contributing to energy-efficient and sustainable construction.

**Product Features:**
* Customizable options for flat or tapered cuts to meet specific roofing needs.
* High compressive strength for added stability in metal roof systems.
* Superior moisture resistance to prevent mold and structural degradation.
* Lightweight design for easy handling and reduced structural load.
* Excellent R-Value retention for long-term thermal performance.
* Cost-effective alternative to traditional infill materials.

[Learn more about Flute Fill →][145]

[ Holey Board Learn more ][146]

### Holey Board

Alleguard’s Holey Board (HB) is a custom-cut foam board crafted from closed-cell Expanded
Polystyrene (EPS), offering cost-effective performance for lightweight insulating concrete (LWIC)
roof systems. Featuring factory-cut holes, Holey Board integrates seamlessly with cellular, perlite,
or vermiculite concrete to create efficient and durable roof assemblies. Fully encapsulated within

## Our Below Grade Insulation Products

[ High-Density (HD) SilveRboard® Learn more ][136]

### High-Density SilveRboard®

High Density (HD) SilveRboard is a rigid insulation board made from Expanded Polystyrene (EPS)
covered with a layer of polypropylene reflective lamination on both sides. This highly effective
combination of materials offers high compressive strength and great thermal performance when used in
below grade and under slab applications.

The double-sided lamination dramatically increases board strength and flexibility, reducing site
damage and waste. The availability of larger panels and laminated film help improve job site
efficiency and reduce labor costs.

[Learn more about High-Density SilveRboard →][137]

[ High-Density (HD) Envirosheet Learn more ][138]

### High-Density Envirosheet

High-Density (HD) Envirosheet is a high density economical foam board insulation made from Expanded
Polystyrene (EPS) offering a high R-value per dollar. It is a highly durable and cost-effective
product that is primarily designed to be used for below grade applications for residential or
commercial construction.

The closed-cell structure gives the board superior water resistive properties while the high density
of the foam makes for an excellent alternative for projects where high compressive strength is
required.

[Learn more about HD Envirosheet →][139]

[ Amrad Learn more ][140]

### Amrad

[Amrad]

Amrad is an insulated under slab depressurization panel and a key component in a radon gas
mitigation system. The void created by the integrated channels serve as an air gap for soil gas
collection. Radon gas is able to vent out to the exterior through the use of a connected PVC piping
with a continuously running exhaust fan. This panelized solution with its unique channel design,
void percentage, film and foam density creates a strong and durable panel, giving builders the
ability to build an insulated concrete slab while meeting radon building code requirements and
improving the indoor air quality for the occupants.

[Learn more about Amrad →][141]

[ Amdrain Amdrain ][142]

### Amdrain: Foundation Insulation

Amdrain is a two-in-one rigid Expanded Polystyrene (EPS) insulation board with integrated drainage
channels. The panel is designed to be used in both exterior and interior applications for below
grade foundation walls. The inner side (in contact with foundation wall) has vertical grooves
(9/16”/14.2mm deep) creating small air gaps and allowing for moisture drainage while the opposite
side is flat.

[Learn more about Amdrain →][143]

[ Amdry Eco Amdry Eco ][144]

### Amdry Eco: Laminated Multipurpose EPS

Amdry Eco is a non-structural rigid insulation panel made from closed cell, molded Expanded
Polystyrene (EPS) with a layer of High Impact Polystyrene (HIPS) film. The laminated side has
bi-directional 1/2” (13mm) wide by 1/2” (13mm) high channels that can be used for venting or water
drainage, depending on the application.

The combination of molded EPS, HIPS film and moisture management pattern offers a highly versatile
supplementary component that can be used in floor assemblies.

[Learn more about Amdry Eco →][145]

EPS has high R-value retention, is fully recyclable, and is easily customizable. EPS is made without

and has superior bonding capabilities. Best of all, EPS will save you time and money. So the real

## Building with SilveRboard®

### Superior Thermal Insulator

SilveRboard® has exceptional long-term R-value retention as well as increased thermal resistance in
lower temperatures.

### Built-in Water & Vapor Barriers

When the joints are taped and sealed it can function as a vapor barrier.

### Durable, Lightweight, & Flexible

Each panel is easy to handle due to the low weight and can be easily cut.

### Improved Indoor Air Quality

SilveRboard does not contain CFCs or HCFCs, no off-gassing and does not promote growth of mold and
mildew.

### Environmentally Friendly

EPS foam can be recycled and uses only steam and water during manufacturing.

### Increases Comfort & Energy Savings

Acts as continuous insulation in the building envelope, reducing thermal bridging and energy
consumption while improving home owner comfort.

## Expanded Polystyrene Embedded with Graphite Particles

SilveRboard® Graphite XS can be used as the second plane of protection under exterior cladding when
the joints are properly taped and sealed, eliminating the need for an additional membrane. The
laminated film comes micro perforated by default (denoted by XS) but is also available without
perforations by special order.

**Availability**

Both SilveRboard® 35XS and SilveRboard® Graphite XS are available in a wide range of thicknesses
ranging from 1/2″ (13mm) to 6″ (152mm). Standard board dimensions include 4×8′ and 4×9′ (1.2×2.4m
and 1.2×2.7m).

#### Product Features

*Vapor Permeance*
Perforated 2.74 US perms (157 ng/Pa.s.m2) Non-perforated 0.15 US perms (8.6 ng/Pa.s.m²)

## About Graphite Polystyrene Insulation (GPS)

High performing and cost effective non-structural graphite polystyrene (GPS) rigid insulation board
for exterior wall applications on wood or steel frame construction. The expanded polystyrene (EPS)
core is embedded with graphite particles which increase the thermal performance, compared to
conventional EPS.

In addition to the increased thermal resistance, the foam is laminated with a reflective film on
both sides increasing board strength and flexibility, reducing site damage and waste. The reflective
laminated surfaces are micro perforated giving the panel high water vapor permeance greatly reducing
the likelihood of trapped moisture through the increased drying potential. The larger panels and
laminated film help improve job site efficiency and reduce labor costs.

[Learn More][151]

## Building with SilveRboard® Graphite

### Superior Thermal Insulator

SilveRboard® Graphite has a high R-value and an exceptional long-term R-value retention. It also
provides increased thermal resistance in lower temperatures.

### Permeable Barrier

The perforated boards provide high vapor permeance allowing walls to dry out and can act as a second
plane of protection when taped and sealed.

### Durable, Lightweight, Flexible

Each panel is easy to handle due to the ultra-low weight and is easily cut.

### Improved Indoor Air Quality

SilveRboard® Graphite does not contain CFCs or HCFCs, no off-gassing and does not promote growth of
mold and mildew.

### Environmentally Friendly

Graphite EPS foam saves energy during manufacturing.

### Increases Comfort & Energy Savings

Acts as continuous insulation in the building envelope, reducing thermal bridging and energy
consumption while improving comfort.

## About Envirosheet EPS Insulation

Envirosheet is an economical rigid insulation board made from Expanded Polystyrene (EPS) offering a
high R-value per dollar when compared to other generic rigid insulation solutions on the market. It
is a highly flexible and cost-effective product that can be used for above grade and below grade
interior applications in residential or commercial construction.

Envirosheet EPS insulation can be installed on most substrates and can accommodate virtually any
finish ranging from stucco, siding and masonry veneer providing professionals great design
flexibility. The EPS has high permeance to allow the passage of water vapor, reducing the risk of
trapped moisture in the wall assembly.

Envirosheet is available in a variety of sizes, thicknesses and densities. The availability of
larger panels helps improve job site efficiency and reduce labor cost.

#### Product Features

[Envirosheet Data Sheet][141]

*Compressive Strength*
12 psi (86 kPa)
*Thermal Resistance*
3.9 hr.ft2.F/Btu/1 inch (0.68 m2K/W per 25mm)
*Vapor Permeance*
4.9 US perms (282 ng/Pa.s.m2)

#### Applications

Interior foundation wall

Recladding

Supplementary insulation

Exterior above grade wall

## About High Density (HD) Envirosheet

High Density (HD) Envirosheet is a high density economical foam board insulation made from Expanded
Polystyrene (EPS) offering a high R-value per dollar. It is a highly durable and cost-effective
product that is primarily designed to be used for below grade applications for residential or
commercial construction.

The closed-cell structure gives the board superior water resistive properties while the high density
of the foam makes for an excellent alternative for projects where high compressive strength is
required.

High Density (HD) Envirosheet comes in multiple densities and is available in a various sizes and
thicknesses. The availability of larger panels helps improve job site efficiency and reduce labor
cost. The high compressive strength makes it the ideal solution for majority of below grade
applications such as foundation walls and below concrete slabs.

#### Product Features

*Compressive Strength*
16, 22, 30, 40 & 60 psi (110, 152, 207, 436 & 517 kPa)
*Density*
1.35, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3.5 lb/ft³ (21.6, 24, 32, 40, 56 kg/m³)
*Thermal Resistance*
4.0, 4.1, 4.2, 4.3 & 4.6 hr.ft2.F/Btu/1 inch (0.70, 0.72, 0.74, 0.76, 0.81 m2K/W per 25mm)
*Vapor Permeance*
3.5, 3.29, 2.5, 1.83, 1.83 US perms (200, 187, 147, 104, 104 ng/Pa.s.m2)

#### Applications

Exterior foundation wall

Above and below concrete slabs

Frost walls

Radiant floor heating

Snow melt and de-icing

# Enviroslab Perimeter Foundation Solution

Enviroslab is a non-structural, rigid insulation form made from closed cell Expanded Polystyrene
(EPS) offering cost effective performance.

## Improved R-Value for the Foundation Perimeter

Designed to be installed as pre-cut insulated forms for shallow frost walls, reduce thermal
bridging, and directly improve building envelope performance.

Enviroslab’s exceptionally low, long term, in-service water absorption properties allow it to
maintain its specified thermal performance and durability when installed for slab on grade or below
grade applications.

#### Product Features

[Enviroslab Product Data Sheet][140]

*R-Value/inch*
R4.2, R4.3, and R4.4
*Compressive Strength*
20 psi (138 kPa), 25 psi (172 kPa), 30 psi (207 kPa), 40 psi (276 kPa), 50 psi (345 kPa), and 60
psi (414 kPa)
*Flexural Strength*
35 psi (242 kPa), 50 psi (345 kPa), 60 psi (414 kPa), and 75 psi (517 kPa)

### Availability

Enviroslab is custom cut as per your specified project requirements. Dimensions and/or cut section
drawings can be submitted for quoting, production, and delivery on site.

Standard length of Enviroslab is 8′

Continuous rigid insulation with integrated strapping.

## Envirostrap Rigid foam Insulation

Envirostrap is a rigid insulation board made from closed cell Expanded Polystyrene (EPS) with two
integrated furring strips on one side. This highly effective combination of materials offers a
2-in-1 solution incorporating insulation and finish attachment surfaces that can be used for both
above grade and below grade interior applications. The furring strips can either be fully recessed
inside the foam for interior finish installation or can protrude from the surface of the foam by ¾”
(19mm), creating an air gap that is needed for exterior cladding installation.

The two furring strips are located 16” on center (406mm) on each panel and are 2.5” (63mm) wide and
make for an easy installation of finishes such as siding or gypsum board (drywall). The combination
of the thicker strips (1” (25mm)) with the spacing and width provides the user with the widest range
of warranty compliance by the various siding manufacturers.

The furring strips are made from plywood in order to eliminate bowing and warping that can be found
in typical dimensional lumber. For instances where wood cannot be used due to potentially increased
moisture issues, the panels can be ordered with plastic strips giving the user excellent
flexibility.

# Amrad: Insulated Radon Gas Mitigation Panel

Innovative rigid insulation panel for under slab depressurization systems

[Talk to a Sales Rep][140]

High Performance System

Durability and Lightweight

Innovated Panel Design

Long-Term R-Value Retention

Superior Energy Efficiency

## About Amrad: Insulated Radon Gas Mitigation Panel

Amrad is an insulated under slab depressurization panel and a key component in a radon gas
mitigation system. The void created by the integrated channels serve as an air gap for soil gas
collection. Radon gas is able to vent out to the exterior through the use of a connected PVC piping
with a continuously running exhaust fan. This panelized solution with its unique channel design,
void percentage, film and foam density creates a strong and durable panel, giving builders the
ability to build an insulated concrete slab while meeting radon building code requirements and
improving the indoor air quality for the occupants.

The channel pattern and ratio of solid to empty allows Amrad to replace 4” (102mm) of clean granular
fill as normally required by the building code. In addition, the air gap created by the channels
serves as a capillary break between the soil and slab, greatly reducing moisture related issues.
Amrad’s High Impact Polystyrene (HIPS) film serves a dual function by providing the required vapor
barrier under the concrete slab while acting as an air barrier to prevent any radon gas from
infiltrating into the interior space. The Amrad film replaces the need for a dedicated soil gas
retarding membrane as required by the building code.

*Vapor Permeance*

# Fanfold Cover Board

Versatile, lightweight, and easy to handle, Alleguard Fanfold Cover Board is ideal for wall and
roofing insulation applications.

[Construction Products][139]
[Talk to a Sales Rep][140]

#### Fanfold Cover Board for Wall and Roofing Applications

Consisting of a high-quality EPS core with a laminate facer, Fanfold Cover Board is accordion-folded
for ease of transportation, handling, and installation. Fanfold Cover Board’s hinge folding ensures
that it lies flat for an exceptionally smooth surface. Fanfold Cover Board conserves energy and
enhances the performance of existing insulation resulting in a building that is more comfortable and
energy efficient.

#### Product Features

[Fanfold Data Sheet][141]

*Compressive Strength*
10 – 40 psi (69 – 276 kPa)
*Thermal Resistance*
3.9 – 4.4 F.ft² .hr/Btu (0.69 – 0.77 m² K/W)
*Vapor Permeance*
2.27 – 5.00 US perms (130 – 287 ng/Pa.s.m²)

## Our Fanfold Cover Board Products

[Fanfold Roof Recovery Board ][142]

## Fanfold Roof Recovery Board

With an EPS core an energy-efficient laminate facer, lightweight Fanfold Roof Recovery Board
provides superior roof insulation. Its fanfold design cuts down on installation time and ensures a
perfectly smooth surface.

#### **Laminate Options – **

Clear poly on both sides

Clear poly on one side, reflective on the other

[Fanfold Wall Sheathing][143]

## Fanfold Wall Cover Board

Constructed using expanded polystyrene and laminated with clear polypropylene on one side and
metalized polypropylene on the other, Fanfold Insulation Board levels uneven walls, helps control
air and dust infiltration, and is perforated for permeability, reducing the risk of condensation
within walls.

# Insulated Concrete Masonry Units

Alleguard leverages the superior durability and energy efficiency of EPS to design preformed
Concrete Block Insulating Systems that match any construction requirements.

[Talk to a Sales Rep][135]

#### Insulated Concrete Blocks Improve Energy Efficiency and Lower Costs

No matter which Insulated Concrete Masonry Unit you choose, you’re choosing improved energy
efficiency, reduced costs, and easy installation. Alleguard offers a range of ICMU products so you
can find the right solution for your project.

## Our ICMU Products

Korfil® Block Insulation

### Korfil® Block Insulation

KORFIL® Inserts are individually molded of expandable polystyrene and designed to fit standard two
(2) core masonry units of 6, 8, 10 and 12-inch widths for use in both single wythe and cavity wall
construction. Inserts are preinstalled at the block plant prior to delivery on the job site.

Icon® Universal Inserts

### Icon® Universal Inserts

ICON® Inserts are molded from expandable polystyrene. The design of the insert allows it to compress
so it will fit the cores of all masonry units with just one size. Inserts are placed in the cores of
the block at the block plant. By placing inserts in blocks, there is a significant improvement in
the thermal efficiency of masonry walls.

Korfil® Hi-R Masonry Wall System

### Korfil® Hi-R Masonry Wall System

The Hi-R Wall System is a specially designed concrete masonry unit and individually molded
insulation insert. The block and the insulation are combined at the block manufacturing plant prior
to delivery to the job site. The assembly provides a wall system capable of achieving higher thermal
R-values than conventional masonry, with no effect on the structural integrity of masonry
construction.

Hi-R-H Energy Efficient Wall System

### Hi-R-H Energy Efficient Wall System

HI-R-H are pre-insulated fully grouted masonry wall systems that offer superior thermal performance.
Double exposed single wythe masonry walls with durable architectural finishes for conditioned spaces
in all Climate Zones. Hi-R-H half-high units are also available.

##### PRODUCTS

# Exterior Insulation and Finish Systems (EIFS)

Exterior Insulation and Finishing Systems, or EIFS, provide insulation, moisture protection, and an
attractive exterior finish in a single, integrated EPS solution.

[Talk to a Sales Rep][135]

#### EIFS for Wall and Roofing Applications

Alleguard Exterior Insulation and Finishing Systems consists of a high performing EPS substrate that
can be integrated with a base coat, mesh, and a finishing coat, providing broad design and color
flexibility, low maintenance, high durability, and increased energy efficiency.

## Our EIFS Products

## EIFS Wall Cladding

Alleguard EIFS Wall Cladding provides excellent compressive strength, superior water protection, and
maintains structural integrity in a wide range of temperatures.

## EIFS and Roofing

Ideal for exterior soffits and canopy fascia that are subject to extreme weather such as blowing
rain and extreme temperatures, EIFS provides a lower-cost alternative that outperforms traditional
materials.

## The Alleguard Advantage

With a combined 60-year history and proven track record of supporting our customers’ visions,
Alleguard is strategically built from the ground up to expand and shape your business. Whether
you’re in construction, protective packaging, cold-chain or other industries, we are relentless in
going the extra mile to help your business succeed.

[Learn More][136]

## Why EPS?

EPS has high R-value retention, is fully recyclable, and is easily customizable. EPS is made without
ozone-harming compounds or any kind of dye. It is available in a variety of compressive strengths
and has superior bonding capabilities. Best of all, EPS will save you time and money. So the real
question is: Why not EPS?

[Learn More][137]

#### Shaping A More Sustainable World

Sustainability is one of our top priorities, both for our products themselves and for what our
products make possible. Manufactured without ozone-damaging compounds, recyclable and endlessly
reusable, EPS has a smaller carbon footprint and results in less pollution than the manufacturing of
alternative materials. And EPS helps create a more sustainable world by making buildings more energy
efficient, reducing greenhouse gas emissions, preventing product damage and waste, and reducing
shipping fuel usage, just to name a few. We’re constantly working to find new ways to be good
stewards of our customers’ visions and of our environment.

# Amdrain: Foundation Insulation

Supplementary component in all types of foundation wall systems where there is a need for insulation
with integrated drainage.

[Talk to a Sales Rep][139]

Easy Tongue & Groove Installation

Durability and Lightweight

High Vapor Permeance

Long term thermal resistance

Cost Effective

## About Amdrain Foundation Insulation

Amdrain is a two-in-one rigid Expanded Polystyrene (EPS) insulation board with integrated drainage
channels. The panel is designed to be used in both exterior and interior applications for below
grade foundation walls. The inner side (in contact with foundation wall) has vertical grooves
(9/16”/14.2mm deep) creating small air gaps and allowing for moisture drainage while the opposite
side is flat.

Amdrain EPS panel comes in 4’x8’ (1.22m x 2.44m) sheets with the thickness ranging from 1.5” (38mm)
to 5” (127mm). The panels are designed to be installed in the vertical orientation only. The tongue
and groove interlock helps maintain the continuity of the insulation eliminating the need for taping
of the joints.

#### Product Features

[Amdrain Data Sheet][140]

*Thermal Resistance*
4 hr.ft2.F/Btu/1 inch (0.70 m2K/W per 25mm)
*Vapor Permeance*
3.2 US perms (183 ng/Pa.s.m2)
*Compressive Strength*
22 psi (151 kPa)

## Building with Amdrain

### Superior Thermal Insulator

Amdrain has exceptional long-term R-value retention as well as increased thermal resistance in lower
temperatures.

### No Risk of Trapped Moisture

Made from EPS with high permeance to allow the passage of water vapor.

### Easy to Install

Amdrain foundation insulation is installed with no special tools, equipment or skills.

### Durable

Has excellent resistance to mold, mildew and maintains its performance over time.

### Moisture Management

When installed on the interior, the vertical grooves provide a drainage plane separating potential
condensation from the wood framing.

### Additional Protection for Waterproofing and Damp Proofing Systems

Provides additional protection during backfill to the waterproofing and/or damp roofing system
installed on the foundation wall.

### Improved Drainage

When installed on the exterior, the vertical grooves provide an additional drainage plane relieving
any hydrostatic pressure, allowing moisture to be redirected down to foundation drain.

## Flat and Tapered Roofing Insulation

Made from closed-cell Expanded Polystyrene (EPS), this insulation system is custom-manufactured to
meet the unique slope and thickness requirements of each project, offering virtually limitless
design possibilities. Ideal for new construction and retrofit applications, it delivers exceptional
thermal resistance and long-term durability. With low in-service water absorption, Alleguard’s
Tapered Roof Insulation maintains its specified R-Values over time, ensuring reliable energy
efficiency. Lightweight and easy to handle, it simplifies installation while accommodating optimal
sloping and drain placement for efficient water drainage.

#### Product Features

[Product Data Sheet][141]

*Compressive Strength*
10 – 40 psi (69 – 276 kPa)
*Thermal Resistance*
3.9 – 4.4 F.ft² .hr/Btu (0.69 – 0.77 m² K/W)
*Vapor Permeance*
2.27 – 5.00 US perms (130 – 287 ng/Pa.s.m²)

#### Applications

Commercial, residential, institutional, and industrial projects.

Compatible with single-ply and built-up roofing systems.

Flat roofs and low-slope roofs.

Hybrid tapered roof insulation solutions.

## Flute Fill Rigid Insulation

Alleguard Flute Fill is an ideal way to provide additional stability to roofing assemblies.
Customizable in flat cut or tapered cut, Flute Fill is lightweight solution for standing seam metal
roof systems offering high compressive strength, moisture resistance, and high R-value retention,
all at a lower cost.

#### Product Features

[Flute Fill Data Sheet][141]

*Compressive Strength*
10 – 25 psi (69 – 172 kPa)
*Thermal Resistance*
3.9 – 4.3 F.ft² .hr/Btu (0.69 – 0.76 m² K/W)
*Vapor Permeance*
2.27 – 5.00 US perms (130 – 287 ng/Pa.s.m²)

## Premium EPS Holey Board

Made of premium EPS, Alleguard’s Holey Board is designed for use in lightweight concrete insulating
roofing systems. Energy-efficient, cost-effective, water-resistant Holey Board has outstanding
compressive strength and R-value retention. It’s available in a variety of densities and thicknesses
and can be customized with any hole pattern to fit your needs.

#### Product Features

[Holey Board Data Sheet][141]

*Compressive Strength*
10 – 25 psi (69 – 172 kPa)
*Thermal Resistance*
3.9 – 4.3 F.ft² .hr/Btu (0.69 – 0.76 m² K/W)
*Vapor Permeance*
2.27 – 5.00 US perms (130 – 287 ng/Pa.s.m²)
[Certifications][142]
[ASTM C578][143]

#### Why EPS?

EPS is superior to XPS in almost every way. EPS has higher R-value retention, absorbs less moisture,
is fully recyclable, and is more easily customizable. EPS is made without ozone-harming compounds or
any kind of dye. It has more potential compressive strength and has superior bonding capabilities.
Best of all, EPS will save you more time and money. So the real question is: Why not EPS?

## Amdeck: Insulated Concrete Floor and Roof System

Amvic’s Amdeck system is an insulated, stay in place concrete form that can be used for virtually
any floor or roof construction. It is compatible with any wall type that would normally be used with
typical concrete slab. It is a 4-in-1 system offering structure, insulation, sound attenuation and
finished attachment. Amdeck is a cost effective, resilient and environmentally friendly construction
system helping revolutionize modern construction and change the way we build.

This innovative modular system uses beam pocket cutouts in the foam to create a one-way concrete
slab allowing the designer to maximize the clear spans. The system has integrated joists that are
used to support temporary construction loads and provide a surface for interior finish attachment.
Amdeck Pro reduces temporary shoring requirements while Amdeck Eco follows typical shoring
requirements for concrete slabs. Amdeck can be used in a horizontal or sloped configuration for
floors and roofs with typical finished unsupported clear spans up to 30’ (9.1m). It is perfectly
suited for use with ICF walls or independently with other structural systems.

[Amdeck: Insulated Concrete Floor and Roof System]

Amdeck Eco is designed for low-rise residential applications with longer sections increasing
construction speed. The use of dimensional lumber for the joists simplifies the construction by

## Why Build With Amdeck?

### Energy Efficiency

Amdeck’s continuous layer of insulation serves to reduce the effects of thermal bridging while
having the flexibility to accept additional insulation to improve its thermal performance even
further. The combination of the high thermal resistance, improved air tightness and thermal mass
makes for a very energy efficient building.

### Indoor Comfort

The combination of increased air tightness and continuous insulation creates a superior building
envelope which has virtually no drafts and maintains the conditioned space within the optimal
thermal comfort range. The use of the concrete contributes to great sound attenuation properties
giving the occupants a quiet and comfortable interior.

### Sustainability

The highly energy efficient envelope can reduce the building’s carbon footprint while the durable
and robust structure fortifies it against nature’s unavoidable hazards giving concrete construction
a long service life. Additionally, EPS can be made from recycled material minimizing the impact on
the environment through reduced raw material demand.

### Strength and Resilience

The monolithic reinforced concrete slab makes for a much stronger structure when compared to other
methods of construction. The combination of high strength and fire resistance creates superior
resistance to both natural and man-made disasters. The floor/roof components do not lose their
structural integrity when exposed to high moisture environments.

## About Amdry Eco EPS Insulation

Amdry Eco is a non-structural rigid insulation panel made from closed cell, molded Expanded
Polystyrene (EPS) with a layer of High Impact Polystyrene (HIPS) film. The laminated side has
bi-directional 1/2” (13mm) wide by 1/2” (13mm) high channels that can be used for venting or water
drainage, depending on the application.

The combination of molded EPS, HIPS film and moisture management pattern offers a highly
versatile supplementary component that can be used in floor assemblies.

#### Product Features

*Compressive Strength*
20 psi (138 kPa)
*Thermal Resistance*
4.2 hr.ft2.F/Btu/1 inch (0.78 m2K/W
*Vapor Permeance*
1.0 US perms (57ng/Pa.s.m2)

#### Applications

Above Concrete Slab

Basement Slab

Bathroom Slab

Floor Retrofit

# Geofoam Retaining Wall

When constructing a steep slope, using soil alone behind a retaining wall poses a risk of excessive
weight, compromises ground stability and settling along with other unknowns. Lightweight EPS Geofoam
is becoming more and more popular among engineers for use in retaining wall construction when
sourcing an affordable, reliable lightweight material.

[Learn More about Geofoam][139]
[Talk to a Sales Rep][140]

High compressive strength

Reduces lateral pressure

Cost-effective

## Geofoam in Retaining Wall Applications

Geofoam is becoming more popular among engineers because of its lightweight properties compared to
other options of soil, sand and stone which can weigh 100 times more than Geofoam. The use of
stacking Geofoam blocks offers a lightweight fill that will not wash away over time or add excessive
weight to an area of land or buried structures. In many cases, EPS Geofoam is more cost-effective
than other soil substitutes.

#### Why EPS?

EPS has high R-value retention, is fully recyclable, and is easily customizable. EPS is made without
ozone-harming compounds or any kind of dye. It is available in a variety of compressive strengths
and has superior bonding capabilities. Best of all, EPS will save you time and money. So the real
question is: Why not EPS?

# EPS Bridge Deck Fillers

Geofoam has been used in geotechnical applications for more than 30 years. The outstanding
compressive strength of EPS makes it a great choice for bridge deck filler.

[Talk to a Sales Rep][139]

High compressive strength

Lightweight

Cost-effective

Reduces differential movement

## Geofoam in Bridge Deck Filler Applications

Geofoam is only 1% the weight of soil and rock and less than 10% the weight of other lightweight
fill alternatives, making it an excellent soil substitute. Geofoam outperforms traditional
embankment fill by reducing backfill weight which lowers lateral forces on abutment walls,
foundations, and other retaining structures. This reduces both design and construction costs.

Geofoam blocks provide stability to unstable soil conditions. Their lightweight characteristics make
them a great solution for lightening the load of concrete in bridges. The low thermal conduction
property of Geofoam is ideal for use in roadway and runway subgrade insulation and frost protected
shallow foundation construction.

Geofoam is resistant to settling, deterioration, and water damage. The integrity of Geofoam blocks
remains unchanged when buried for years beneath soil and water.

[Learn More about Geofoam][140]

#### Why EPS?

EPS has high R-value retention, is fully recyclable, and is easily customizable. EPS is made without
ozone-harming compounds or any kind of dye. It is available in a variety of compressive strengths
and has superior bonding capabilities. Best of all, EPS will save you time and money. So the real

# Using Geofoam for Green Roofs

Growing awareness and concern for our environment have increased the interest and applications of
green roofs. Geofoam is the ideal insulation for green roof construction. This environmentally sound
roofing construction also offers long term cost savings. The overall environmental benefits include
stormwater management and temperature regulation. For a consumer, a green roof offers insulation,
which reduces energy costs and extends the life of the roof.

[Learn More about Geofoam][139]
[Talk to a Sales Rep][140]

Stormwater management

Reduces heating & cooling costs

Increases roof longevity

Improves air quality

Fire retardation

## Why Use Geofoam for Green Roof Design?

Geofoam is a lightweight substance that reduces downward pressure while retaining its compressive
strength. It can be pre-cut for specific jobs, allowing for limitless customization of the landscape
design with a quick and less labor-intensive installation. Geofoam is CFC, HFC, HCFC and
formaldehyde-free in addition to being recyclable, which is ideal in an environmentally friendly
design.

Insulation is a key element for a successful green roof. Geofoam, made of expanded polystyrene
(EPS), provides an insulation layer that maintains its R-value over time. Available in various
densities, R-values and sizes, it is the ideal solution for installation under the vegetation of a
green roof design.

Growing awareness and concern for our environment have increased the interest and applications of
green roofs. Geofoam is the ideal insulation for green roof construction. This environmentally sound
roofing construction also offers long term cost savings. The overall environmental benefits include
stormwater management and temperature regulation. For a consumer, a green roof offers insulation,
which reduces energy costs and extends the life of the roof.

### Typical Structure of a Green Roof
* Vegetation
* Growing Medium
* Drainage, Aeration, Water Storage & Root Barrier
* Insulation – Geofoam
* Waterproof Barrier
* Roof/Structural Support

## Proud to be LEED-ing the Way with LEED® Points

In accordance with [US Green Building Council (USGBC)][141] standards, Alleguard’s ICA-LITE® EPS
Panels and Geofoam may provide LEED® points for construction projects. Members of USGBC developed
the Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED®) Green Building Rating System to establish
practices for designing, constructing, and certifying sustainable buildings. Learn more about the
LEED program can be found at www.usgbc.org as well as our [LEED Guide][142].

Alleguard Geofoam meets or exceeds the requirements of **ASTM D6817**, *Standard Specification for
Rigid Cellular Polystyrene Geofoam.*

### Benefits of a Green Roof Made with Geofoam:
* Stormwater Management
* Reduces Heating and Cooling Costs
* Increases Roof Longevity
* Improves Air Quality
* Fire Retardation
* Opportunity to contribute to LEED® points
* Reduces urban heat-island effect
* Noise Reduction
* Aesthetic Value
* Creates Valuable Amenity Space

#### Why EPS?

EPS has high R-value retention, is fully recyclable, and is easily customizable. EPS is made without
ozone-harming compounds or any kind of dye. It is available in a variety of compressive strengths
and has superior bonding capabilities. Best of all, EPS will save you time and money. So the real
question is: Why not EPS?

## Biodegradable EPS

At the forefront of sustainable packaging materials, biodegradable EPS offers a greener alternative
to traditional EPS without compromising on performance.

Biodegradable EPS Foam is available for all of our molded coolers and custom cold chain solutions.

[More About Biodegradable EPS Foam][143]

### Related Materials

[ Expanded PolyStyrene (EPS) ][144]

EPS is produced by using steam to expand and fuse polystyrene beads via a variety of manufacturing
processes creating a closed-cell structure that contains air, making it ideal for a variety of
applications including construction, packaging, shipping, and food storage.

[ Graphite Polystyrene (GPS) ][145]

Graphite Polystyrene is created by integrating graphite particles into EPS. The graphite particles
increase thermal performance compared to conventional EPS.

[ ARCEL ][146]

ARCEL is a moldable foam composed of polystyrene and polyethylene. It’s extremely durable and
flexible, making it ideal for packaging and shipping applications.

[ Biodegradable Foam ][147]

Biodegradable EPS Foam offers all of the benefits of traditional EPS – high compressive strength,
energy efficiency, and sustained performance – and it’s biodegradable. Biodegradable Foams can be
substituted for EPS in applications from packaging, to insulation.

# 6-Panel Liners

Alleguard 6-Panel Box Liners are a cost-effective and customizable way to package, protect, and ship
products that require temperature control without need for custom tooling or production molds.

## Turn Any Box Into A Cooler

Alleguard 6-Panel Box Liners transform any size box into an instant insulated shipping container.
Both EPS and Graphite Polystyrene can be used to line the inside of a box, creating a
cost-effective, climate-controlled shipping solution for products requiring temperature control. Our
6-Panel Box Liners can be customized to any box dimension and desired thickness.

### Related Materials

[ Expanded PolyStyrene (EPS) ][141]

EPS is produced by using steam to expand and fuse polystyrene beads via a variety of manufacturing
processes creating a closed-cell structure that contains air, making it ideal for a variety of
applications including construction, packaging, shipping, and food storage.

[ Graphite Polystyrene (GPS) ][142]

Graphite Polystyrene is created by integrating graphite particles into EPS. The graphite particles
increase thermal performance compared to conventional EPS.

# XDS Solutions

Our XDS™ Extended Duration Shipping containers are designed to keep products temperature controlled
for longer shipping durations, offering you more options and greater savings.

[Talk to a Sales Rep][139]

#### Maintain Temperature Integrity

XDS™ Extended Duration Shipping containers are sustainable, cost-effective, proven performers. XDS
containers provide up to 75% savings in product cost compared to polyurethane or isocyanate
containers and reduce the amount of dry ice needed by up to 50% by weight. Tests have proven that
our XDS containers extend product integrity below -7° C for five to twelve days.

## Biodegradable EPS

At the forefront of sustainable packaging materials, biodegradable EPS offers a greener alternative
to traditional EPS without compromising on performance.

Biodegradable EPS Foam is available for all of our molded coolers and custom cold chain solutions.

[More About Biodegradable EPS Foam][142]
[Certifications][143]

*ISTA certifications can be provided by a 3rd party testing group.*

### Related Materials

[ Expanded PolyStyrene (EPS) ][144]

EPS is produced by using steam to expand and fuse polystyrene beads via a variety of manufacturing
processes creating a closed-cell structure that contains air, making it ideal for a variety of
applications including construction, packaging, shipping, and food storage.

[ Graphite Polystyrene (GPS) ][145]

Graphite Polystyrene is created by integrating graphite particles into EPS. The graphite particles
increase thermal performance compared to conventional EPS.

[ ARCEL ][146]

ARCEL is a moldable foam composed of polystyrene and polyethylene. It’s extremely durable and
flexible, making it ideal for packaging and shipping applications.

[ Biodegradable Foam ][147]

Biodegradable EPS Foam offers all of the benefits of traditional EPS – high compressive strength,
energy efficiency, and sustained performance – and it’s biodegradable. Biodegradable Foams can be
substituted for EPS in applications from packaging, to insulation.

# Flexible Foams

Alleguard Flexible Foams provide protection against damage to a wide variety of products. We have
decades of experience creating custom flexible foam solutions for clients in a wide variety of
industries.

[Talk to a Sales Rep][135]

#### Strong, Safe, Versatile

With outstanding reliability and damage-resistance, Alleguard Flexible Foam has an unlimited range
of applications and uses. We specialize in custom engineering and fabricating flexible foam to fit
any need, with particular expertise serving the electronics, automotive, medical, appliance and
aerospace industries.

## What Is Flexible Foam?

Alleguard’s Flexible Solutions has high thermal resistance, a high weight-to-strength ratio,
flexibility, and comes in a variety of densities making it ideal for a wide range of applications.

#### Benefits and Flexible Foam

Flexible Foam is flexible in more ways than one. Its strength and adaptability makes it perfect for
many industries requiring custom solutions for products such as protective packaging, insulation,
marine floatation, sports equipment, soundproofing materials, and more.

Armacell serves diverse markets worldwide, focusing on applications in industrial operations, building construction, and HVAC systems.

_crawl.linkedin_about: ARMACELL - DRIVING ENERGY EFFICIENCY Armacell is the inventor of flexible elastomeric foams for equipment insulation. We develop innovative and safe thermal, acoustic and mechanical solutions that create sustainable value for our customers. Day in, day out, our products make a significant difference around the world. As a multi-material and multi-product company, we operate two main businesses: Advanced Insulation and Engineered Foams. Our product focus is on insulation materials enhancing the energy efficiency of technical equipment, high-performance foams for sophisticated and lightweight applications, recycled PET products and next-generation aerogel technology. ## Get in touch!

You may not recognize our name, but our products are improving your life in hundreds of different
ways.

Whether you are a healthcare professional, an active military member, or a respected veteran, Bergad
is there. We touch every life with materials that save lives, provide comfort, enhance your music
and gaming experience, and protect the environment.

To this day, we continue to expand our specialty foams and create cutting-edge solutions that
provide comfort, protection, and a competitive edge for consumer products, medical solutions,
industrial needs, and military applications.

## If Your Application Requires Foams, You Need Bergad

You’ll find our Military Grade Foam helping U.S. armed forces in extreme environmental conditions,
while our Polyurethane Gels and Sponge Foams help to improve the patient experience in medical
offices and hospitals. Our Transportation Foams make cars more comfortable just as our Aircraft
Foams provide comfortable seating solutions and our Consumer Electronics Foams enhance the gaming
experience. When it comes to energy exploration, our Containment Berm Foams can withstand repeated
compression and are ideal for secondary spill containment.

## Join Our Team

We value our people and invest in our employees. Find out if you’re just the candidate we’ve been
searching for.

[Apply Today][62]

## Humble Beginnings

Founded in 1988, Bergad began as a producer of bunk bed mattresses in a building with wooden floors
and a questionable furnace. Within three decades, it would become an industry leader in the
development of polyurethane foams and gels.

## Our Timeline

1990’s – Began producing memory foams in-house to ensure quality material.

2000’s – Expanded the product line to focus on technical grade foams.

2015 – Moved operations to a larger facility which allowed us to expand our product line to include
gels, gel composites and phase change materials.

2018 – Achieved ISO 9001:2015 certification, the world’s most widely recognized and accepted quality
management standard.

## Today

Today, you may not recognize our name, but our products are improving your life in hundreds of
different ways.

Whether you are a healthcare professional, a housewife, an active military member, or a respected
veteran, Bergad is there. We touch every life with materials that save lives, provide comfort,
enhance your music and gaming experience, and protect the environment.

To this day, we continue to expand our specialty foams and create cutting-edge solutions that
provide comfort, protection, and a competitive edge for consumer products, medical solutions,
industrial needs, and military applications.

## If Your Application Requires Foams, You Need Bergad

You’ll find our Military Grade Foam helping U.S. armed forces in extreme environmental conditions,
while our Polyurethane Gels and Sponge Foams help to improve the patient experience in medical
offices and hospitals. Our Transportation Foams make cars more comfortable just as our Aircraft
Foams provide comfortable seating solutions and our Consumer Electronics Foams enhance the gaming
experience. When it comes to energy exploration, our Containment Berm Foams can withstand repeated
compression and are ideal for secondary spill containment.

## Humble Beginnings

Founded in 1988, Bergad began as a producer of bunk bed mattresses in a building with wooden floors
and a questionable furnace. Within three decades, it would become an industry leader in the
development of polyurethane foams and gels.

## Our Timeline

1990’s – Began producing memory foams in-house to ensure quality material.

2000’s – Expanded the product line to focus on technical grade foams.

2015 – Moved operations to a larger facility which allowed us to expand our product line to include
gels, gel composites and phase change materials.

2018 – Achieved ISO 9001:2015 certification, the world’s most widely recognized and accepted quality
management standard.

## Today

Today, you may not recognize our name, but our products are improving your life in hundreds of
different ways.

Whether you are a healthcare professional, a housewife, an active military member, or a respected
veteran, Bergad is there. We touch every life with materials that save lives, provide comfort,
enhance your music and gaming experience, and protect the environment.

To this day, we continue to expand our specialty foams and create cutting-edge solutions that
provide comfort, protection, and a competitive edge for consumer products, medical solutions,
industrial needs, and military applications.

## If Your Application Requires Foams, You Need Bergad

You’ll find our Military Grade Foam helping U.S. armed forces in extreme environmental conditions,
while our Polyurethane Gels and Sponge Foams help to improve the patient experience in medical
offices and hospitals. Our Transportation Foams make cars more comfortable just as our Aircraft
Foams provide comfortable seating solutions and our Consumer Electronics Foams enhance the gaming
experience. When it comes to energy exploration, our Containment Berm Foams can withstand repeated
compression and are ideal for secondary spill containment.

How We Work
NPD Process

Step 01
Enquiry Generation
Start your project with precision by engaging with our New Product Development (NPD) Team during the enquiry generation phase. Begin by filling out our enquiry form, detailing not just the basics but all technical, dimensional, or specific requirements. Our NPD Team excels in meticulously understanding both new and existing customer needs to ensure that every aspect of the project is clearly defined from the outset. This initial step is crucial as it helps us prepare a proposal that precisely aligns with your expectations, complete with scope, pricing, and projected timelines, ensuring a tailored approach to your unique challenges.

Move Forward with Us

Step 02
Feasibility Review
Upon receiving your detailed enquiry, our NPD Team conducts a thorough Feasibility Review. This crucial step dives deep into your technical, dimensional, and specific requirements, assessing the feasibility and optimization of your needs against our production capabilities. We closely evaluate capacity utilization to ensure that our resources are aligned efficiently with your project demands. By examining all aspects, from resource availability to compliance with industry standards, we ensure that our proposal is built on a solid, achievable foundation, ready to meet your expectations fully.

Move Forward with Us

Step 03
Quotation & Samples Submission
Following a successful feasibility review, we proceed to the Submission of Quotation & Samples. You will receive a comprehensive proposal that meticulously outlines the costs, timelines, and detailed specifications

Home

We bring comfort to your life. ®

Carpenter Co. is the world’s largest vertically integrated manufacturer of polyurethane foams, and serves a diversified global marketplace with polyurethane chemical solutions, polyester fibers, and insulation materials through a network of more than 60 production locations.

PLAY VIDEO

We understand the science behind enhancing the quality of people’s lives.

Our 6,500+ employees across the globe seek to provide the most innovative products and solutions with a focus on enhancing the quality of people’s lives while being a good steward of our resources.

Markets We Serve

Start your Carpenter journey

We work together across the globe to produce some of the world’s most innovative products and solutions. Explore our opportunities and apply today.
