# About

## About Carpenter

Carpenter Co. got its start in 1950. Read our [History][116] page to learn how we’ve grown from a
local latex foam manufacturer to the world’s largest vertically integrated manufacturer of
polyurethane foam and specialty polymer products.

────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────
[e.r. carpenter co sign]│[carpenter 75th anniversary logo]
────────────────────────┴─────────────────────────────────

At Carpenter, our [Purpose, Vision, Mission and Values][117] shape everything we do. They guide our
decisions and ensure that employees, customers, partners, and communities always receive our very
best.

We hold ourselves to the highest ethical and moral standards, following a clear [Code of Conduct &
Ethics][118] that reflects our commitment to integrity in every action.

Equally central to who we are is our focus on [Environmental Stewardship][119]. We’re dedicated to
enhancing the quality of people’s lives while also taking steps to preserve our planet.

Backed by state-of-the-art [Research & Development][120] facilities in Richmond and beyond, our
expert teams continuously design innovative products and perform rigorous in-house testing to drive
progress responsibly.

# History

## The History of Carpenter

From a local distributor of latex foam to the world’s largest vertically integrated manufacturer of
flexible polyurethane foam, comfort materials and specialty polymer products.

Carpenter Co. got its start as a latex foam distributor in 1950 when E. Rhodes Carpenter decided to
start his own business. We set up shop in Richmond’s Manchester neighborhood and soon purchased
distribution warehouses in High Point and Hickory, North Carolina. By 1956, we were manufacturing
our own flexible urethane foam.

Our Richmond plant was relocated to its current location on Richmond Highway in 1961. It wasn’t long
before we began operating the first continuous foam pouring line in Virginia.

────────────────────┬──────────────
[e rhodes carpenter]│[powell plant]
────────────────────┤
[richlux foam ad] │
────────────────────┴──────────────

In the late 1960s, we expanded west for the first time, opening plants in Temple, Texas, and
Russellville, Kentucky.

We established Choate Chemical Company in 1972 in Pasadena, Texas, as a source of raw materials for
our foam producing facilities. The following year, our Roger W. Powell Plant, named after the man
who developed Carpenter’s chemical processes and oversaw the construction of the facility, began
manufacturing polyether polyols. The Powell Plant today is home to seven reactors that manufacture
polyether and polyester polyols.

As demand for our foam grew through the late ’70s and early ’80s, so did Carpenter. We began making
bonded carpet cushion, and production facilities were opened in Conover, North Carolina; Tupelo,
Mississippi; Riverside, California; Elkhart, Indiana; and Toronto, Ontario, Canada, and Calgary,
Alberta, Canada.

We established our corporate headquarters on Monument Avenue in Richmond in 1984, and our
state-of-the-art research and development facility was opened next to the Richmond plant in 1989.
The Reinhart Technical Center (RTC) is named after Bud Reinhart, who set up Carpenter’s continuous
foam pouring operations and developed our groundbreaking Richlux^{®} foam in the 1960s. The numerous
accomplishments that have taken place at RTC have made our name synonymous with innovation and
quality.

> When Unit P-6, a reactor used for large-scale polyether polyol manufacturing, was built at our
> Roger W. Powell Plant in 2003, it was the largest reactor of its kind in the world.

In the early 1990s, we expanded into Europe with the acquisition of Hyman PLC foam manufacturing
plants in the United Kingdom and France, and we constructed a new facility in Germany in 1993. Our
U.S. Tire Fill Division transitioned to producing and selling products for our own customers.

In the early 2000s, our European presence grew with the acquisition of Cirrus AB in Sweden and
Denmark, and Dumo N.V. in Belgium, while domestic foam production sites opened in Lakeland, Florida,
and Fogelsville, Pennsylvania.

The 2010s were a period of internal growth for Carpenter, as several of our production plants were
expanded to meet larger sales capacities.

With the acquisition of Recticel N.V.’s Engineered Foams Division in June 2023, Carpenter Co. has
become the world’s largest manufacturer of flexible foam. The acquisition added more production
facilities in Europe and the United States, and brought our business into Africa and Asia for the
first time.

──────────┬───────────
[recticel]│[BedInABox]
──────────┤
[casper] │
──────────┴───────────

Carpenter’s December 2023 acquisition of NCFI Polyurethanes, Inc.’s Consumer Products Division
brought several established brands, including BedInABox^{®} and sleepdog^{®}, into the Carpenter
fold.

Casper Sleep Inc. became a subsidiary of Carpenter in October 2024, adding an array of
high-performing mattresses and sleep products to the Carpenter portfolio.

# Purpose, Vision, Mission and Values

# Purpose, Vision, Mission and Values

Our [Guiding Principles][117] are embedded into our work each day. Our culture is built upon these
overarching commitments, which inspire our decision-making and the way we impact the future.

### Purpose

#### Why we exist

We exist to enhance the quality
of people’s lives.

### Vision

#### What we aim to achieve

To be the most admired company known for unmatched efficiency and continuous improvement in creating
products and delivering solutions that make our customers more successful and our world more
comfortable, safer and healthier.

### Mission

#### How we plan to achieve the vision

We wisely invest for the long term to create value for the mutual advancement of our company,
people, customers, partners and communities.

### Core Values

#### Pride in Work

With a spirit of perseverance and a chemistry built on mutual respect, we create long-term
relationships. That’s a promise. We act with a sense of urgency and operate with agility. We deliver
world-class service to our partners and never forget that their success determines ours.

#### Open to Improvement

We challenge ourselves to be better every day as we continue to build an industry-leading company.
We are flexible in our thinking and embrace change as an opportunity to constantly improve. We
recognize that great ideas come from an engaged team where every voice matters, and our doors are
always open.

#### Steward of Resources

We respect the resources that have been entrusted to us and are committed to enhancing their value.
We work to create a sustainable environment for everyone.

# Code of Conduct & Ethics

## Code of Conduct & Ethics

##### Introduction

Carpenter is committed to conducting its business in accordance with the highest ethical and moral
standards, as well as in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations of the countries and
localities in which we operate. This commitment reflects our Guiding Principles, which all employees
shall follow and practice in every aspect of our business lives.

In following these principles, each employee must recognize that personal interests must not be
placed above the loyalty and responsibility we each owe to Carpenter as employees. Each of us shall
discharge our responsibilities solely on the basis of what is in the best interest of Carpenter and
independent of our personal considerations or relationships.

As used in this Code of Conduct & Ethics:
* “Carpenter” means Carpenter Co., and all domestic or foreign subsidiaries and affiliates, as well
as any joint ventures in which Carpenter has a majority interest and/or management
responsibility,
* “employees” or “representatives” mean and include all Carpenter employees, officers, and
directors, and
* “supervisor” means the person to whom an employee or representative reports.

On occasion, we may face situations involving a potential conflict of interest or a question as to
the proper course of conduct we are expected to follow. While it is not possible to anticipate each
and every situation that may arise, this Code of Conduct & Ethics addresses those types of
situations that are most likely to occur and to provide general guidance in all other situations.

Each Carpenter employee should read this Code of Conduct & Ethics in order to familiarize themselves
with its contents. If you encounter a situation that is not specifically addressed here, you are
expected to apply the overall philosophy and concepts embodied herein and to conduct yourself
accordingly. In addition, you are expected to act in accordance with the provisions of the Employee
Handbook (if available) and specific Carpenter policies that are available from your supervisor or
Human Resources office. If a question still exists in your mind, the particular circumstances should
be discussed with your supervisor, your Human Resources manager, the Legal Department or a member of
senior management.

##### Carpenter Philosophy

One of Carpenter’s Guiding Principles best summarizes its philosophy. “We must do the best we can to
serve ourselves, but we should not forget that in the final analysis, we serve society whose
approval of our actions forms the basis for the existence of our Company”. This means that we should
conduct our affairs with customers, suppliers, employees and others in an honest and straightforward
manner. Not only is this good ethics, it is good business as well.

Although it is important to recognize the value of having and adhering to such a philosophy,
Carpenter also recognizes that it is equally important to create and maintain a work environment
that fosters this philosophy and within which employees can work comfortably. An essential part of
this environment is our Open-Door policy, which provides our employees the opportunity to discuss
situations that are of concern with the appropriate supervisor or member of management. Employees
must be able to feel satisfied that a situation has been handled properly. Thus, open communication
is expected and encouraged, especially in dealing with sensitive issues involving business ethics,
conflicts of interest, and employee relations.

Every Carpenter employee is expected to act in the best interest of Carpenter at all times and to
conduct your day-to-day business on behalf of Carpenter in accordance with the following
principles:

##### Conflicts of Interest

As a Carpenter employee, you must avoid situations where your personal interests conflict, or could
reasonably appear to conflict, with the interests of Carpenter, or which might influence or appear
to influence your judgment or actions in the performance of your duties. An example might be a
personal or family financial interest in a company that is either a competitor of, or that has
business relations with, Carpenter (this restriction does not apply to minimal holdings of the stock
or other securities of a corporation whose shares are publicly traded). Employees should also avoid
outside employment or activities that could in any way negatively impact job performance or
Carpenter’s reputation in the community, or otherwise conflict with your obligations to Carpenter.

##### Use of Carpenter Assets

The assets of Carpenter are to be used solely for its benefit. Each employee is responsible for
assuring that corporate assets are used only for valid corporate purposes. These assets are not
limited to just our physical plants, equipment, inventory, corporate funds, or office supplies. They
also include new technologies, inventions, business strategies, financial data, and other
information about our business. No employee may use these assets to pursue personal gain for
themselves or others. No employee may sell or otherwise transfer any such assets to other people,
except in the ordinary course of business and in accordance with standard procedures. Any such sale
or transfer must be supported by properly approved documentation and recorded in Carpenter’s books
and records.

##### Confidential Information

As a Carpenter employee, you may have access to confidential information about Carpenter and its
customers, suppliers, and competitors. This information should not be disclosed to non-employees for
any reason except in accordance with Carpenter’s established procedures, such as pursuant to
confidentiality agreements. Employees must not use confidential information obtained on the job to
pursue personal financial gain. “Confidential information” includes information or data on products,
business strategies, corporate manuals, materials, processes, systems, procedures, etc., as well as
all financial data. The aforementioned types of information, documents and data are considered
Carpenter’s trade secrets and are intended to be protected by all applicable laws governing such
trade secrets.

##### Bribes and Kickbacks

Employees or their families may not under any circumstances accept or encourage the payment of
personal bribes, kickbacks, rebates or other forms of payment in connection with the purchase or
sale of goods and services. These payments can take many forms and are not limited to direct cash
payments. In general, if the employee or their family stands to gain personally through the
transaction, it is prohibited. Such practices are not only unethical but are in many cases illegal.

##### Reciprocity

There may be instances where Carpenter purchases goods or services from a supplier that also buys
goods and services from us. While this practice is considered acceptable, any form of pressure for
reciprocity with that supplier is not. Suppliers must not be asked to buy our products or services
in order to become or continue to be a supplier to Carpenter.

##### Gifts or Gratuities

Employees may not accept gifts of money under any circumstances, nor may they solicit non-monetary
gifts, gratuities, or any other personal benefit or favor of any kind from individuals, suppliers,
or customers. Employees may accept unsolicited, non-monetary gifts from a customer or potential
customer only if the gift is of nominal value or the gift is primarily of an advertising or
promotional nature. Gifts of more than $50 may be accepted if protocol, courtesy, or other special
circumstances exist, as sometimes happens with international transactions. However, all such gifts
must be reported to the appropriate Executive/Senior Vice President, who will determine if the
employee may keep or must return the gift, or whether the gift should more appropriately become
Carpenter’s property.

##### Entertainment

Employees should not solicit entertainment from any individual, supplier, or customer with whom
Carpenter does business. In appropriate circumstances, employees may entertain individuals with whom
Carpenter has a business relationship, as long as the entertainment is provided in accordance with
Carpenter’s entertainment and other policies. Offering or accepting entertainment other than in the
development of a business relationship must be avoided.

##### Payments to Sales Representatives and Consultants

Agreements with sales representatives or consultants must (i) be in writing, (ii) clearly and
accurately set forth the services to be performed, (iii) reflect the basis for earning the
commission or fee involved, (iv) set forth the applicable rate or fee and (v) be reviewed and signed
by an authorized Carpenter representative. Any such payments must be reasonable in amount and
commensurate with the value and type of services rendered.

# Environmental Stewardship

### Environmental Stewardship

At Carpenter, we focus on always being Carpenter Conscious – conscious of our people, planet, and
purpose.

We require ourselves to be:
* Socially responsible
* Mindful of resources and our environmental footprint
* Committed to making our world more comfortable, safer, and healthier

### People

###### **We focus on our social responsibility and the well-being of individuals impacted by our
###### company by focusing on:**

**Health & Safety**
* Providing a healthy and safe work environment

**Employee Development & Training**
* Encouraging continuous learning and growth

**Inclusive Work Culture**
* Being a workplace for everyone

### Planet

###### **We take steps
###### to preserve our planet
###### by focusing on:**

**Waste Management**
* Eliminating waste in all forms
* Reduce, reuse, recycle
* Stewardship of resources

**Efficiency & Innovation**
* Product lifecycle management
* Optimized logistics

**Renewable Materials**
* Recycled feedstocks
* Natural oil-based polyols
* Mass-balanced raw materials

### Purpose

###### **We exist
###### to enhance the quality
###### of people’s lives.**
* We are committed to taking steps to preserve our planet.
* We respect the resources that have been entrusted to us and strive to enhance their value.
* We work to create a sustainable environment for everyone by continuously pursuing innovation and
improvement in how we operate.

# Research & Development

# Research & Development

The Reinhart Technical Center and our Sustainability and Innovation Department represent Carpenter’s
longstanding commitment to innovation and continuous improvement.

───────────────────────────┬────────────────
[reinhart technical center]│[wetteren plant]
───────────────────────────┴────────────────

### Committed to Innovation

Most processes, products and standards used in the polyurethane foam industry today are developed by
our skilled teams of scientists, engineers and technicians. We’re proud to offer innovative products
and solutions to diverse markets, all of which have been refined and perfected at our global
research centers.

We continually invest in technologies supporting research and product development. Our world-class
technical facilities in Richmond, Virginia, and Wetteren, Belgium, serve as global testing centers
for many testing protocols, including:
* Physical testing
* Mattress durability testing
* Large & small-scale flammability testing
* Wet analytical
* Instrumental analytical testing
* Thermal analysis

## Specialists & Packaging Solutions from Pune, Maharashtra, India.

Protective Packaging, Stretch film loose-fill packaging materials, and their integration into
existing packaging processes. We are foam fabrication Specialists & largest packaging solution
provider in India. Application of products are in Home appliances, Automobile Industry,
Telecommunication Sector & in Healthcare industry

To contribute to the growth of the Indian economy through the largest range of Packaging Solutions &
Cushioning applications with customization to suits customers needs.

**OUR VISSION : **

Being the most value-driven solution provider in all of our pacakging & cushioning application
businesses with the objective of adding value to our customers daily lives and fostering a culture
of respect and empowerment for all our stakeholders.

# About Us

Domfoam Inc. (originally known as Dominion Foam Corp.) was founded in 1963 by a young entrepreneur,
Saul Pomerantz. From its humble beginnings operating from a small garage, we have evolved into a
major player in the Canadian flexible-foam industry.

In 1991, the company was sold to a group of outside investors. Its assets were re-purchased by the
Pomerantz family in 2012, which is committed to maintaining the long-term success of the company.

We currently manufacture and fabricate a full line of polyurethane foam products primarily for use
in the furniture and bedding industries. We also produce re-bonded foam for carpet underlay and
other applications.

# About Us

Domfoam Inc. (originally known as Dominion Foam Corp.) was founded in 1963 by a young entrepreneur,
Saul Pomerantz. From its humble beginnings operating from a small garage, we have evolved into a
major player in the Canadian flexible-foam industry.

In 1991, the company was sold to a group of outside investors. Its assets were re-purchased by the
Pomerantz family in 2012, which is committed to maintaining the long-term success of the company.

We currently manufacture and fabricate a full line of polyurethane foam products primarily for use
in the furniture and bedding industries. We also produce re-bonded foam for carpet underlay and
other applications.

EPS is widely used in the construction industry for a diverse range of applications, be it

## Materials

### Expanded Polystyrene

Expanded Polystyrene (EPS) has excellent compressive strength, thermal performance and good first
drop cushioning and impact absorption performance. Available in a density range from EPS70-400
(18-200g/l) EPS consists of 98% air.

[Explore][42]

### Expanded Polypropylene

Expanded Polypropylene (EPP) can sustain multiple impacts whilst retaining its shape and offers
impressive weight saving benefits. Available in black in a wide range of material densities from
18-250g/l, EPP is also available in a spectrum of colours.

[Explore][43]

### Porous Expanded Polypropylene

Expanded Polypropylene (EPP) can sustain multiple impacts whilst retaining its shape and offers
impressive weight saving benefits. Available in black in a wide range of material densities from
18-250g/l, EPP is also available in a spectrum of colours.

[Explore][44]

### Arcel

ARCEL is a durable, versatile material and is very popular due to its bead size and density range
(between 18-50 g/l). As a co-polymer of polyethylene & polystyrene, ARCEL provides both flexibility
and strength and exhibits tough puncture resistance.

[Explore][45]

### Design

The development of ideas is only the first step in producing a new moulded foam solution; we use the
design stage to clearly define the purpose, function and any key feature requirements for the
product, while also taking into account sustainability, the supply chain and end of life recycling.

[Explore][92]

### Testing

We can simulate real world transit conditions and evaluate physical and mechanical handling in the
distribution environment. In-house testing also allows us to performance check any critical design
attributes of the packaging and components we manufacture.

[Explore][93]

### Design Consultancy

Sustainable innovation is at our core, so we use the design stage to build a clear picture of what
is important to the client and end customer to ensure we meet the high expectations of all
concerned.

committing to tooling and a first production run. Prototype also allow conduct any necessary trials
and tests with consumers or against other products to ensure it is fit for its intended application.

# Operational Excellence

## We achieve Excellence through our Business Strategy

Operational Excellence is a business strategy we have adopted with the aim to drive consistency and
reliability in all areas of Engineered Foam Products business to become a mindset change driven by
continuous improvement.

## Our Goals

We integrate different approaches to achieve specific goals

Operational excellence becomes the goal of any organisation striving to improve on a day-to-day
basis and promoting a positive culture change where problem-solving, teamwork, and leadership
results are the norm.

Across the business our sites are certified against standards for the environment, quality and
health and safety (ISO 14001, 9001, 45001). Specific to the automotive industry our Spennymoor site
has also complied with the requirements of ISO TS16949 (since 2007), in 2018 they achieve the latest
iteration of the standard IAFT 16949.

### Expanded Polystyrene

Expanded Polystyrene (EPS) has excellent compressive strength, thermal performance and good first
drop cushioning and impact absorption performance. Available in a density range from EPS70-400
(18-200g/l) EPS consists of 98% air.

[Explore][42]

### Expanded Polypropylene

Expanded Polypropylene (EPP) can sustain multiple impacts whilst retaining its shape and offers
impressive weight saving benefits. Available in black in a wide range of material densities from
18-250g/l, EPP is also available in a spectrum of colours.

[Explore][43]

### Porous Expanded Polypropylene

Expanded Polypropylene (EPP) can sustain multiple impacts whilst retaining its shape and offers
impressive weight saving benefits. Available in black in a wide range of material densities from
18-250g/l, EPP is also available in a spectrum of colours.

[Explore][44]

### Arcel

ARCEL is a durable, versatile material and is very popular due to its bead size and density range
(between 18-50 g/l). As a co-polymer of polyethylene & polystyrene, ARCEL provides both flexibility
and strength and exhibits tough puncture resistance.

## HOTBIN Composting

Invented by AC Innovations and manufactured by Engineered Foam Products; HOTBIN is an aerobic
composting bin designed to utilise the excellent insulation benefits of expanded polypropylene to
recycle a wider variety of waste into rich homemade compost, reducing the amount of waste sent to
landfill.

### HOTBIN Compost Bin:
* HOTBIN is 32 times faster than a traditional cold composting system
* Heats up to a temperature of 60°C (140°F)
* Contains a bio filter to minimise odours
* Recycles garden waste, fruit and veg, left-over food waste including cooked food and perennial
weeds

HOTBIN compost bin demonstrates some of our excellent moulding capabilities including:
* Pop locks, creating a secure seal around the moulded in the lid and access doorhatch
* A working hinge – is this supposed to be a living hinge?

# Innovation

## Sophisticated 3D Shapes and More

As well as a unique set material properties EPP is diverse enough to allow the creation of parts
that integrate living hinges, multiple densities, inserts and cable management channels as part of
the moulding process.

## Cost-Effective, High-Performance Materials

Materials and material grades available in low to very high densities that have embedded
enhancements are now available include expanded foams that offer:
* Complex geometry moulding
* Fire retardancy
* Electrostatic discharge protection
* End of life composting

Tooling, processing and manufacturing innovation also brings features to foam that you may not be
aware of including:
* Dual density moulding – The ability to mould different areas of the same tool in different
densities
* Insert moulding – The ability directly in mould metal wires and plastic fixtures into a part
* Textured ‘A’ class surface finished that disguise the natural appearance of the beads
* Living hinges
* Pop-locks and resistance fits

Texturing

## Our Story of Sustainable Innovation

Engineered Foam Products have been moulding sustainable solutions that help to improve people’s
everyday lives for over half a century.

Our heritage dates to the early 1960’s with our roots in the South West moulding simple shapes and
packaging. As business took off two new sites in Livingston and Northampton were constructed to
ensure the safe delivery of white goods to people’s homes with cleverly designed, energy absorbing
packaging.

Today we lighten, insulate and protect using just a very small percentage of material, just 2-4% in
the process, the rest of what makes up a finished moulding is air.

## Expanding Foams Offer Impressive Green Credentials

For too long our materials have had a bad reputation due to a lack of understanding which has led to
myths being presented as fact.

These claims are largely based around sustainability, fuelled by the upsetting sight of seeing EPS
dumped by the roadside, in parks or floating in the sea.

Have you ever questioned the sustainable credentials of EPS and other expanded foams? If so, then
you are not the first.

Mythbusters

avoided. Recycled material can be made into new EPS/EPP parts or into a wide variety of products
such as hangers, CD cases, rulers and even wood substitute alternatives for benches and fencing.

### Unlimited recycling potential

### Expanded Polystyrene

Expanded Polystyrene (EPS) has excellent compressive strength, thermal performance and good first
drop cushioning and impact absorption performance. Available in a density range from EPS70-400
(18-200g/l) EPS consists of 98% air.

[Explore][42]

### Expanded Polypropylene

Expanded Polypropylene (EPP) can sustain multiple impacts whilst retaining its shape and offers
impressive weight saving benefits. Available in black in a wide range of material densities from
18-250g/l, EPP is also available in a spectrum of colours.

[Explore][43]

### Porous Expanded Polypropylene

Expanded Polypropylene (EPP) can sustain multiple impacts whilst retaining its shape and offers
impressive weight saving benefits. Available in black in a wide range of material densities from
18-250g/l, EPP is also available in a spectrum of colours.

[Explore][44]

### Arcel

ARCEL is a durable, versatile material and is very popular due to its bead size and density range
(between 18-50 g/l). As a co-polymer of polyethylene & polystyrene, ARCEL provides both flexibility
and strength and exhibits tough puncture resistance.

Naturally consisting of 98% air, expanded polystyrene is inherently highly buoyant, hydrophobic and

times faster than traditional cold composting methods.

# Vacutainer® Trays

Vacutainer® trays require a lot of protection during transit to minimise damage and ensure the
viability of the shipped contents. Trays commonly require narrow but strong walls to securely hold
large quantity of vials. To ensure manufacture of these 2-3mm narrow walls a small-bead EPS
(expanded polystyrene) grade is required.

## 1000M³ of EPS blocks to securely pack undersea umbilical’s

With a very challenging lead time Engineered Foam Products helped the client to rapidly source
1000M³ of EPS blocks to securely pack undersea umbilical’s due for international shipment from their
manufacturing site in the North East of the UK. Heavy duty umbilical’s provide a critical link
supplying hydraulic power, electrical power and control signals as well as consumables such as
anti-corrosion or anti-waxing chemicals to isolated subsea wells from fixed platforms or floating
production systems (FPSO).

## The Challenge

The client was seeking a cost-effective solution for a new time-sensitive project which required the
shipment of two umbilical’s measuring a staggering 26km total length with heavy and bulky
termination heads, aboard a single vessel.

### Expanded Polystyrene

Expanded Polystyrene (EPS) has excellent compressive strength, thermal performance and good first
drop cushioning and impact absorption performance. Available in a density range from EPS70-400
(18-200g/l) EPS consists of 98% air.

[Explore][42]

### Expanded Polypropylene

Expanded Polypropylene (EPP) can sustain multiple impacts whilst retaining its shape and offers
impressive weight saving benefits. Available in black in a wide range of material densities from
18-250g/l, EPP is also available in a spectrum of colours.

[Explore][43]

### Porous Expanded Polypropylene

Expanded Polypropylene (EPP) can sustain multiple impacts whilst retaining its shape and offers
impressive weight saving benefits. Available in black in a wide range of material densities from
18-250g/l, EPP is also available in a spectrum of colours.

### Arcel

ARCEL is a durable, versatile material and is very popular due to its bead size and density range

and strength and exhibits tough puncture resistance.

_crawl.linkedin_about: We solve our customers’ toughest packaging challenges through our unique blend of technical collaboration, innovation and extraordinary service. TECHNICAL COLLABORATION: Our process of collaboration starts with curiosity. We look for the challenges our customers may be experiencing, and we consider how we can make improvements. We make it our business to work closely with customers to engineer those challenges away. These win-win technical partnerships lead to a stream of innovative packaging solutions that improve both businesses. INNOVATION: Innovation at Flexipol requires deep problem-solving skills and considerable resilience. We learn through the rigorous process of experimentation. For us, the path to breakthrough technology is lined with trialing and learnings, each one of these essential for inspired innovation. EXTRAORDINARY SERVICE: We listen to our customers and we keep our promises. Through our substantial expertise and constant support, you will have the confidence to make the best packaging decisions. That’s because we’re in this for the long term. WE ARE ONE COMPANY, THREE BRANDS Flexipol is one company with three specialist brands, Palagan, Synpac and Flexipol, each focusing on unique markets. Each brand designs and manufactures industry leading differentiated flexible packaging. UK MANUFACTURING FOR INTERNATIONAL MARKETS Flexipol has UK manufacturing facilities in Dunstable, Haslingden and Hessle and sales offices across the UK. Our technical capabilities enable us to service international processing and manufacturing businesses, wherever they are located. WE ARE ALL SYNNOVIA Flexipol is a Synnovia company. Synnovia manufactures high volume specialised components and consumables for niche applications or highly specialised designs. With its global operating platform, Synnovia services multinational blue-chip original equipment manufacturers and other customers in over 80 countries worldwide.

THE MOST TRUSTED PU FOAM MANUFACTURER

Quality Foam

Manufacturers

Choosing the right foam for your mattress, furniture, studio or for transporting fragile goods is extremely important and can be challenging. As the leading manufacturers of the Indian foam industry, we intricately craft our polyurethane foam foams to help you make the right choice. Backed by decades of expertise in the manufacturing industry, we are able to deliver premium quality foams to meet your needs every time.
Whether it’s soft foam, insulating foams or acoustic foams . We make sure that you have enough to make a choice from. At Flexipol, we strive to only provide high quality and duly approved foams and other products to our clients.

Industries

We Serve

Being one of the best Memory Foam manufacturers in India, suppliers and wholesalers in the foam industry, we constantly strive to meet all of your industrial requirements. By using the latest cutting-edge technologies from Germany, we offer various categories of high-quality industrial foams – Soft Latex Foam , Hard Foam , Quilting Foam , Foam Rolls and many more. With a wide range of technical foams we cater to various industries like automotive, garment, packaging, household, construction and much more.

We are the industry pioneers of manufacturing flexible foam solutions for a broad spectrum of applications & industries including automotive, garments, packaging, construction, mattress & pillow etc. Our commitment to quality allows us to deliver high-performing, long-lasting and cost-effective foam solutions via our in-house application-specific brands- Resiflex, Power Puf, Viscoflex Sound Flex, Lamifoam and Puf. Flexipol understands & caters to your unique foam requirements and assists you by supplying the foam material that fits your unique needs.

# About Us

[Home][48] » About Us

## Chairman's note

**It gives me immense** pleasure in welcoming you all to my [Flexipol Foams][49] Family. With an
extensive experience of more than three decades, I feel proud of our business excellence and
heartwarming stories of customer satisfaction. With the focus on innovation and commendable quality,
our employees have dedicated themselves with utmost commitment to make our company stand out. We are
one of the most trusted brands in the foam manufacturing and supplying industry. Coupled with great
quality products and efficient staff, Flexipol’s each product batch is tested for hardness, tensile
strength and density. We are one of the early manufacturers in the foaming industry in India and we
take great pride in using the most advanced and scientific technology imported from Germany. The
foam developed at Flexipol is rigorously tested in our foam laboratories for its physical properties
like density, tensile resilience, elongation and hardness.

We at Flexipol look forward to building a lasting partnership with you!

## About Our Company

**Offering [high quality products][50]** for over three decades, Flexipol is one of the largest Foam
Manufacturers in India. The secret to our large customer base and immense customer satisfaction is
maintaining a personalized approach with each and every customer. We are consistently ranked among
the top foam manufacturers and suppliers in the vast field of polyurethanes.

Our core values include loyalty, integrity, honesty and determination towards our customers and
work. The high-quality professionalism that we offer at Flexipol, is the secret to our success.
We are the pioneers in the field of polyurethanes, we incorporate effective and innovative solutions
to provide nothing but the best to our customers. Our exclusive computerized continuous foam
production plant enables us to offer most of our products, making us an integral part in the world
of Memory Foam in India.

We manufacture a complete range of flexible foam sheets and rolls that are made in different colors,
densities and sizes. We are the largest and the most trusted manufacturer of Memory Foam in India,
specializing in super soft foam, hard foam and foam rolls for fabric lamination in a variety of
widths and thicknesses.

We were one of the proud 70 exhibitors who were chosen to participate in the PU-TECH, the first ever
polyurethane summit for South and South-East Asia presented by the Indian Polyurethane Association.

With a vision and mission to provide effective and innovative solutions, Flexipol looks forward to
leading the industry as the [best Foam Manufacturer][51] in India. We promise to ensure utmost
customer satisfaction through continual improvement and innovations in our field.

We look forward to building a lasting partnership with you.

Flexipol- The leading name in the PU foam manufacturing industry.

# Viscoelastic/Memory Foam Manufacturer and Supplier in India

**Viscoelastic/Memory Foam **is also known as a memory Foam. Memory foam reacts to body shape and
temperature to conform to the body.

As one of the first manufacturers of Viscoelastic/Memory Foam in India, we have perfected our
product over the years. The ball rebound of our memory foam is low as compared to other brands. We
also produce memory foam containing cooling gel crystals which helps in heat dissipation. Our memory
foam has high durability and long-lasting comfort along with high resistance to allergens and
bacteria.

Our memory foam is trusted by more than 40 mattress brands across India. We offer Visco elastic
memory foam in a variety of shapes and sizes as per the requirements of our clients such as rolls
and sheets. We also provide customisation options for our clients where they can get products
tailor-made for their needs.

# Latex Foam Sheets

Our Hypersoft/ [Latex Foam][50] is renowned for its superior bounce and resilience in the industry,
making it an ideal option for the top layer of a mattress or quilting. Its open cell structure
allows natural air circulation, keeping you cool and comfortable. It is an authentic [HR foam][51]
that feels incredibly soft and luxurious. In addition, it provides enhanced breathability and better
overall temperature regulation.

## **Alternative To Natural Latex**

Our latex-like foam sheet provides an alternative to natural latex. Our foam is inexpensive compared
to natural latex, yet still provides the same luxurious soft and comfortable feeling. Our latex foam
can be cut to the desired thickness, guaranteeing that it meets the customer’s needs. Unlike natural
latex, our foam does not disintegrate or crumble and provides optimum support and comfort for our
customers.

# Convoluted/Profile Foam Manufacturer and Supplier in India

[**Convoluted/Profile foam**][50] is more commonly referred to as “egg crate foam”. The reason
behind the name is simply the product looks like an egg carton with its peaks and valleys. We offer
2 varieties of convoluted profile foam to meet all your demands.

We can also customise the height and the width of the peaks as per your requirement.

## Convoluted Profile Foam - 1

This is a [versatile foam][51] that can be used for a variety of different reasons. It is most
commonly used in packaging as it is lightweight and absorbs shocks, easily protecting all types of
delicate and fragile products. It is also used to deflect noise vibration and also in toppers

## Convoluted Profile Foam - 2

This foam is used typically in mattress toppers. A mattress topper is an additional layer of support
that can be added to an existing mattress. The peaks in a convoluted foam provide extra support to
the body, while the design ensures that there is proper air circulation.

# ACOUSTIC FOAM SHEETS

## Sound Proofing Acoustic Polyurethane Foam

**[ACOUSTIC FOAMS][50]** is specially made for applications where sound absorption characters are
required. It is convoluted in various shapes to attain higher sound insulation levels.

Our soundproof foam has an NRC (Noise Reduction Coefficient) value of 0.85. This can be easily glued
to other materials such as non-woven fabric, glass fibre, sun mica, gypsum sheet etc. by means of
glue. This makes it a perfect solution for a recording studio and to reduce sound pollution in the
commercial and residential buildings.

Our sound insulation foam has flame retardant properties which makes it perfect for use in generator
sets, engine testing rooms, automotive industry, industrial silencers, auditoriums and conference
halls.

# UV Stable Foam Manufacturer and Supplier in India

[UV Stable Foam]

**UV foam is **widely used because UV stability plays a very important role when discolouration
(yellowing) adversely affects the quality, appearance and shelf life of the product. The combined
actions of ultraviolet light and oxygen adversely affect the products and hence starts to pale. This
makes the foam suitable for use in various types of undergarments and shoes, which does not harm the
human body. This special foam offers superior thermoformability and colour stability. It has high
light stability which is obtained by means of special additives.

Our UV flame is made with the specially imported latest technology which along with our experienced
engineers and stringent lab tests, ensures that our foam meets the all the international standards

We at Flexipol offer UV stable, skin-friendly, white polyurethane foam ideal for innerwear, footwear
and garments. Resistant to all sorts of detrimental polymer degradation inflicted by multiple
physical factors, including radiation, heat, and others, described as ageing. Exposing the material
to sunlight means exposing it to a wide spectrum of radiations, among others visible and
ultraviolet, causing negative changes in the polymer’s properties. Our specially treated UV foam is
perfect for making moldable and easy to wash bra-cups in various shapes & sizes. This laminated foam
is provided to our customers at competitive prices.

thickness and softness to the top of the mattress, and it helps to keep the comfort layers below
from shifting or moving out of place.

Our quilting foam is available in 3 grades both of which ensure that the comfort for all needs and
is trusted by many major [mattress manufacturers][50].

Expertise & Conception

## L'exigence du Fly Case sur-mesure

Que vous l'écriviez **flight case**, **flycase** ou **fly case**, notre mission reste la même :
concevoir l'ultime bouclier de protection et de transport de vos équipements sensibles. Un **fly
case sur mesure** par Conex peut être une simple caisse mobile comme un meuble complexe permettant
de répondre à un large éventail de fonctionnalités adapté sur mesure aux besoins de nos clients.
Ingénierie de précision mêlant usinage de mousse numérique, panneaux composites et accastillage
spécifique, le fly case constitue un assemblage à forte résistance capable de durer dans le temps.
De l'audiovisuel à l'industrie, nous développons chaque **flight case** pour répondre aux normes de
transport les plus strictes.

Précision & Ingénierie

## Notre Processus de Fabrication

ÉTAPE 01

### Étude & Prise de cotes

Analyse de votre cahier des charges, prise des dimensions exactes de votre matériel et définition de
vos contraintes de transport (poids, fragilité, normes d'étanchéité).

1
2
ÉTAPE 02

### Conception CAO 3D

Modélisation virtuelle complète de votre flight case et de la mousse d'intégration pour garantir un
ajustement et une ergonomie d'utilisation parfaits.

ÉTAPE 03

### Usinage CNC & Découpe

Usinage numérique haute précision des panneaux bois/Astroboard et découpe sur mesure des mousses de
maintien (polyéthylène, Plastazote).

3
4
ÉTAPE 04

### Assemblage Industriel

Profilés aluminium renforcés, structure entièrement rivetée, fermoirs papillon et coins renforcés :
chaque flight case est assemblé à la main par nos techniciens pour garantir robustesse et longévité.

ÉTAPE 05

### Finition & Intégration sur Mesure

Une fois la flight case assemblée, nos techniciens réalisent l'intégration intérieure sur mesure :
calage de protection, mousse usinée, cloisons et séparations, blocs-tiroirs, habillages techniques,
intégration de systèmes complexes, tests de conformité CE et contrôles d'étanchéité.

5
6
ÉTAPE 06

### Contrôle Qualité & Expédition

Chaque flight case fait l'objet d'un contrôle final de l'intégration, des finitions et de la tenue
mécanique, avant un conditionnement soigné et une expédition sécurisée vers vos sites
d'exploitation.

ÉTAPE 07

### Service après-vente, réparation & évolution

Notre service après-vente permet de réparer, faire évoluer et reconfigurer vos flight cases dans le
temps. Une approche durable qui prolonge leur durée de vie et s'appuie sur un suivi rigoureux des
versions antérieures.

7

## Ecomate® Blowing Agent Technology: Sustainable Performance Meets Environmental Standards

Since 2002, Ecomate has been field-proven as a successful alternative to environmentally harmful
blowing agents in a wide range of applications, from energy-efficient insulation in consumer
appliances to lightweight integral skin foam in automotive components.

Ecomate is:
* **Free of HFCs, HCFCs and CFCs**
* **Proven in both rigid and flexible foam applications**
* **Seamless system conversion with no new permits required**

Ecomate blown foams provide manufacturers with environmentally sustainable technology while
achieving processing and product performance standards. Our proprietary solution is PFAS-Free,
zero-GWP, non-VOC and meets the requirements of all applicable environmental regulations and
agreements.

## Polyurethane Foam: Common Questions and Expert Answers

### [What is the history of polyurethane?][70]

Polyurethane was first discovered in 1937 by Otto Bayer and made commercially available in the
1950s. Initially used as a coating material, it has since revolutionized a broad range of industries
with its flexibility and durability. It is now used in the production of insulation, foam
mattresses, car seats, shoe soles, and more.

### [What is the chemical structure of polyurethane foam?][71]

The chemical structure of polyurethane foam is based on the condensation reaction of an isocyanate
and a hydroxyl-containing compound, usually a polyol. This reaction creates cross-linked molecules
that form a flexible and durable foam when combined with a blowing agent.

### [How is polyurethane foam produced?][72]

Polyurethane foam is produced through either a liquid injection foam or slabstock foam process,
depending on the desired properties and intended use of the final product. Each method has its own
advantages and disadvantages, so finding the right method for a specific application is key to
achieving optimal results.

### [How strong is polyurethane foam?][73]

The strength of polyurethane foam depends on various factors including density and formulation, but
generally speaking it is known to be very resilient and durable material.

### [What is polyurethane used for?][74]

Polyurethane foam can be used for applications ranging from cushioning, soundproofing, impact
protection, energy absorption, thermal insulation, packaging materials and more.

### [Is polyurethane foam environmentally friendly?][75]

Most types of polyurethanes are non-toxic and considered environmentally friendly compared to other
materials such as oil-based plastics or foams made with CFCs (chlorofluorocarbons).

### [Are there any health risks associated with polyurethane foam?][76]

Generally speaking there are no health risks associated with using polyurethane foams but some
individuals may be sensitive to certain components such as diisocyanates which may cause irritation
when handled without proper protective equipment.

### [What are the 2 main types of polyurethane foam?][77]

Flexible foam, which is used mainly in cushioning and upholstery, and rigid foam, which is used
mainly in insulation and structural support.

### [What is a polyurethane systems house?][78]

Polyurethane systems houses provide comprehensive solutions for producing polyurethane chemical
systems, utilizing state-of-the-art production processes and customized options to ensure projects
are executed with precision and accuracy.

## Polyurethane Foam: Common Questions and Expert Answers

### [What is the history of polyurethane?][70]

Polyurethane was first discovered in 1937 by Otto Bayer and made commercially available in the
1950s. Initially used as a coating material, it has since revolutionized a broad range of industries
with its flexibility and durability. It is now used in the production of insulation, foam
mattresses, car seats, shoe soles, and more.

### [What is the chemical structure of polyurethane foam?][71]

The chemical structure of polyurethane foam is based on the condensation reaction of an isocyanate
and a hydroxyl-containing compound, usually a polyol. This reaction creates cross-linked molecules
that form a flexible and durable foam when combined with a blowing agent.

### [How is polyurethane foam produced?][72]

Polyurethane foam is produced through either a liquid injection foam or slabstock foam process,
depending on the desired properties and intended use of the final product. Each method has its own
advantages and disadvantages, so finding the right method for a specific application is key to
achieving optimal results.

### [How strong is polyurethane foam?][73]

The strength of polyurethane foam depends on various factors including density and formulation, but
generally speaking it is known to be very resilient and durable material.

### [What is polyurethane used for?][74]

Polyurethane foam can be used for applications ranging from cushioning, soundproofing, impact
protection, energy absorption, thermal insulation, packaging materials and more.

### [Is polyurethane foam environmentally friendly?][75]

Most types of polyurethanes are non-toxic and considered environmentally friendly compared to other
materials such as oil-based plastics or foams made with CFCs (chlorofluorocarbons).

### [Are there any health risks associated with polyurethane foam?][76]

Generally speaking there are no health risks associated with using polyurethane foams but some
individuals may be sensitive to certain components such as diisocyanates which may cause irritation
when handled without proper protective equipment.

### [What are the 2 main types of polyurethane foam?][77]

Flexible foam, which is used mainly in cushioning and upholstery, and rigid foam, which is used
mainly in insulation and structural support.

### [What is a polyurethane systems house?][78]

Polyurethane systems houses provide comprehensive solutions for producing polyurethane chemical
systems, utilizing state-of-the-art production processes and customized options to ensure projects
are executed with precision and accuracy.

Polyurethane Foam Fabrication Applications

Polyurethane foam remains one of the most widely sourced materials in foam fabricating because it can be converted into cushioning, packaging, sealing, and acoustic components across many end uses. Buyers often turn to polyurethane foam companies when they need flexible performance, energy absorption, or comfort-driven applications in furniture, transportation, healthcare, and protective packaging. Polyurethane foam manufacturers in the USA also support custom part fabrication for pads, inserts, liners, and die-cut shapes used in both light-duty and technical environments.

Polyethylene Foam for Protective and Industrial Use

Polyethylene foam is frequently chosen when a project requires durability, moisture resistance, insulation, or shock absorption. Foam products manufacturers convert it into protective packaging, case inserts, thermal barriers, spacers, and vibration-dampening components used in electronics, industrial equipment, shipping, and construction. For buyers comparing materials, this category is especially important when product protection, clean edges, and repeatable converting performance matter.

High-Density Foam Manufacturing Capabilities

High-density foam manufacturers serve projects that require greater firmness, structural support, or long-term dimensional stability. These materials are often fabricated into load-bearing pads, specialty inserts, gasketing elements, medical supports, and performance components where compression resistance is a priority. A foam manufacturing company with experience in dense materials, tight tolerances, and repeatable cutting methods can be a strong fit for more demanding industrial and technical applications.

Industry Applications for Foam Fabrication

Automotive manufacturers rely on fabricated foam for cushioning, sealing, noise control, and vibration management in interior and protective assemblies. Medical product makers require foam converting for positioning pads, support surfaces, and custom components that meet handling and material requirements. Electronics companies source precision foam inserts and protective packaging that shield delicate parts during storage and shipment. Construction applications use fabricated foam for insulation, weather sealing, and sound control. Packaging and filtration operations depend on converted foam for inserts, barriers, media support, and product protection where fit and performance both matter.

Providing a wide range of products and services to "Foam Your World," we are able to cater to both the personalized request of an individual as well as the larger needs of businesses, allowing you to accomplish your goals.

Foam Fabricating Supplier Directory Overview

Find and compare foam fabricating services for packaging, insulation, gasketing, acoustic control, cushioning, and protective components through this supplier directory. Buyers can browse foam producers that work with polyurethane foam, polyethylene foam, high-density foam, open-cell foam, and closed-cell foam for industrial, commercial, and specialty applications. Use this page to source custom-cut parts, laminated materials, fabricated inserts, seals, pads, and converted foam products for automotive, medical, electronics, construction, filtration, and consumer product needs. Connect with foam manufacturers in the USA that support prototyping, production runs, material selection, and application-specific performance requirements.

Polyurethane Foam Fabrication Applications

Polyurethane foam remains one of the most widely sourced materials in foam fabricating because it can be converted into cushioning, packaging, sealing, and acoustic components across many end uses. Buyers often turn to polyurethane foam companies when they need flexible performance, energy absorption, or comfort-driven applications in furniture, transportation, healthcare, and protective packaging. Polyurethane foam manufacturers in the USA also support custom part fabrication for pads, inserts, liners, and die-cut shapes used in both light-duty and technical environments.

Polyethylene Foam for Protective and Industrial Use

Polyethylene foam is frequently chosen when a project requires durability, moisture resistance, insulation, or shock absorption. Foam products manufacturers convert it into protective packaging, case inserts, thermal barriers, spacers, and vibration-dampening components used in electronics, industrial equipment, shipping, and construction. For buyers comparing materials, this category is especially important when product protection, clean edges, and repeatable converting performance matter.

High-Density Foam Manufacturing Capabilities

High-density foam manufacturers serve projects that require greater firmness, structural support, or long-term dimensional stability. These materials are often fabricated into load-bearing pads, specialty inserts, gasketing elements, medical supports, and performance components where compression resistance is a priority. A foam manufacturing company with experience in dense materials, tight tolerances, and repeatable cutting methods can be a strong fit for more demanding industrial and technical applications.

Industry Applications for Foam Fabrication

Automotive manufacturers rely on fabricated foam for cushioning, sealing, noise control, and vibration management in interior and protective assemblies. Medical product makers require foam converting for positioning pads, support surfaces, and custom components that meet handling and material requirements. Electronics companies source precision foam inserts and protective packaging that shield delicate parts during storage and shipment. Construction applications use fabricated foam for insulation, weather sealing, and sound control. Packaging and filtration operations depend on converted foam for inserts, barriers, media support, and product protection where fit and performance both matter.

Evaluating Production Volume and Supplier Fit

When evaluating foam fabricating services, start with production volume, throughput, and repeatability. A supplier that is ideal for short prototype runs may not be the right fit for steady high-volume output, while larger programs may require automated cutting, lamination, or molding support. Buyers comparing foam manufacturers in the USA should look at whether the supplier can scale without sacrificing consistency.

Foam Fabrication Processes and Methods

Process selection also matters. Die cutting can support fast, repeatable two-dimensional parts, while waterjet cutting may be better for tighter tolerances or more intricate shapes. Thermoforming, lamination, routing, and adhesive application each affect part performance, lead time, and tooling needs. Choosing the right foam technology is often just as important as choosing the right material.

Integration and Downstream Manufacturing Support

Integration with existing production lines should be reviewed early. Many buyers need parts that arrive labeled, laminated, assembled, kitted, or packaged for downstream use. A capable foam producer should be able to support specification review, prototyping, and conversion methods that align with assembly, shipping, or installation workflows.

Inspection, Certification, and Material Standards

Inspection and certification requirements should not be treated as an afterthought. Depending on the application, buyers may need documentation tied to density, compression, flame performance, cleanliness, traceability, or industry-specific material standards. This is where a specialized foam manufacturing company can stand apart from general suppliers.

Choosing the Right Foam Fabricator

Finally, compare suppliers by specialization, not just price. Some focus on packaging and cushioning, while others are stronger in gasketing, medical parts, insulation, or acoustic products. The best sourcing decision usually comes from matching material capability, process expertise, and industry experience to the actual application.

FAQ

How do I find foam fabricating services for my exact application?

Start by narrowing your requirement to material type, part shape, production volume, and end-use environment. Then compare suppliers by the processes they offer, such as die cutting, waterjet cutting, lamination, or molding. A directory works best when you use it to shortlist suppliers whose materials and converting methods clearly match the application.

What is the difference between polyurethane foam and polyethylene foam for fabricated parts?

Polyurethane foam is often selected for cushioning, comfort, acoustic control, and energy absorption. Polyethylene foam is more commonly used where durability, moisture resistance, and protective packaging performance are priorities. The better choice depends on whether softness, resilience, rigidity, insulation, or environmental resistance matters more in the final part.

How do I compare foam manufacturers in the USA for custom production?

Look beyond basic product claims and compare material range, converting methods, tolerance control, sample capability, and production scalability. Review whether the supplier handles prototyping and full-run manufacturing with the same level of quality control. It also helps to confirm experience in your industry, especially when the application involves packaging, medical parts, insulation, or technical assemblies.

When should I use high-density foam manufacturers instead of general foam suppliers?

High-density materials are often required when parts need structural support, compression resistance, or longer service life under load. That makes specialized suppliers more valuable when performance is tied to firmness, dimensional stability, or demanding operating conditions. General suppliers may still be suitable, but dense foam applications usually benefit from more focused material and process expertise.

What should I ask before choosing a foam producer from a directory?

## We bring comfort to your life.^{®}

Carpenter Co. is the world’s largest vertically integrated manufacturer of polyurethane foams, and
serves a diversified global marketplace with polyurethane chemical solutions, polyester fibers, and
insulation materials through a network of more than 60 production locations.

[PLAY VIDEO][116]

## We understand the science behind enhancing the quality of people’s lives.

Our 6,500+ employees across the globe seek to provide the most innovative products and solutions
with a focus on enhancing the quality of people’s lives while being a good steward of our resources.

[Markets We Serve][117]

### Start your Carpenter journey

We work together across the globe to produce some of the world’s most innovative products and
solutions. Explore our opportunities and apply today.

# About Us

## East Meets West

Our business strategy focuses on delivering specialized polyurethane foam solutions through a global
approach that integrates the top business strategies from both the East and the West.

Our Eastern-inspired methods emphasize continuous improvement and the importance of fostering
long-term, cooperative relationships.

Our Western practices bring over two decades of expertise in the development, manufacturing, and
enhancement of specialized polyurethane foam solutions, offering significant value to our customers.

# The difference? Vertical Integration.

[A vertical infographic with icons representing steps or stages, including a light bulb with a gear
and magnifying glass, a laboratory flask, a platform with droplets, a cutting tool, a shield with a
checkmark, and stacked boxes. The background is blue with white icons.]

Being vertically integrated allows Foamtec International to control the entire manufacturing
process.

This allows us to be an all-in-one, end-to-end solution provider.

[Person operating a machine for material testing or calibration in a laboratory setting.]

## Research & Development

Foamtec's Research and Development team is robust, with over 30 specialists based in Thailand and
the United States. Their focus is dedicated to resolving client challenges through collaborative
efforts. This comprehensive approach supports their reputation for advancing industry standards and
enhancing product performance.

[Close-up of a CNC machine or 3D printer manufacturing a plastic or aluminum part with electronic
components or wiring visible beneath.]

## Foam
## Converting

[Industrial warehouse with yellow and green foam blocks stacked against a wall and a long white
material on a metal conveyor or work table.]

## Foam
## Pouring

With over 25 years of foam pouring expertise, Foamtec International is able to modify every aspect
of the foam’s characteristics.

Whether it’s the color, porosity, density, cytotoxicity, absorption rate, etc…

Foamtec International is able to create the perfect foam to meet your critical criteria.

Equipped with state-of-the-art equipment, Foamtec International is able to convert foam buns/rolls
into simple shapes such as sheets or complex 3D dimensions for intricate designs.

[Factory worker operating machinery in a textile or fabric manufacturing plant with pink and purple
fabric roll.]

## Foam
## Fabrication

Our main specialty foam facility utilizes a variety of different fabrication processes to give our
partners exactly what they are looking for. This includes: felting, reticulation, convolution, die
cutting, slitting, lamination, hot forming, horizontal slicing, vertical cutting, & many more!

[View of a scientific laboratory with a monitor displaying cellular images and computer code, and a
person in a white lab coat partially visible.]

## Quality
## Checks

Foamtec ensures high quality in their products through rigorous quality checks. We utilize ISO and
IATF certified quality management systems, reflecting their commitment to meet stringent industry
standards. Our quality control processes are designed to maintain superior product standards and
reliability, ensuring that all specialty polyurethane foam products meet both the technical
requirements and the high expectations of their clients across various industries.

[Close-up of cleaning sponges in pink, brown, and yellow colors stacked vertically.]

## Final
## Packaging

Foamtec's final packaging capabilities are integral to their quality assurance, ensuring that
products are delivered in optimal condition. They utilize advanced packaging techniques to protect
the integrity and quality of their specialty polyurethane foams during shipment. This includes
tailor-made solutions that meet specific customer requirements and environmental considerations,
helping to prevent damage and reduce waste.

# About Us

## East Meets West

Our business strategy focuses on delivering specialized polyurethane foam solutions through a global
approach that integrates the top business strategies from both the East and the West.

Our Eastern-inspired methods emphasize continuous improvement and the importance of fostering
long-term, cooperative relationships.

Our Western practices bring over two decades of expertise in the development, manufacturing, and
enhancement of specialized polyurethane foam solutions, offering significant value to our customers.

# The difference? Vertical Integration.

[A vertical infographic with icons representing steps or stages, including a light bulb with a gear
and magnifying glass, a laboratory flask, a platform with droplets, a cutting tool, a shield with a
checkmark, and stacked boxes. The background is blue with white icons.]

Being vertically integrated allows Foamtec International to control the entire manufacturing
process.

This allows us to be an all-in-one, end-to-end solution provider.

[Person operating a machine for material testing or calibration in a laboratory setting.]

## Research & Development

Foamtec's Research and Development team is robust, with over 30 specialists based in Thailand and
the United States. Their focus is dedicated to resolving client challenges through collaborative
efforts. This comprehensive approach supports their reputation for advancing industry standards and
enhancing product performance.

[Close-up of a CNC machine or 3D printer manufacturing a plastic or aluminum part with electronic
components or wiring visible beneath.]

## Foam
## Converting

[Industrial warehouse with yellow and green foam blocks stacked against a wall and a long white
material on a metal conveyor or work table.]

## Foam
## Pouring

With over 25 years of foam pouring expertise, Foamtec International is able to modify every aspect
of the foam’s characteristics.

Whether it’s the color, porosity, density, cytotoxicity, absorption rate, etc…

Foamtec International is able to create the perfect foam to meet your critical criteria.

Equipped with state-of-the-art equipment, Foamtec International is able to convert foam buns/rolls
into simple shapes such as sheets or complex 3D dimensions for intricate designs.

[Factory worker operating machinery in a textile or fabric manufacturing plant with pink and purple
fabric roll.]

## Foam
## Fabrication

Our main specialty foam facility utilizes a variety of different fabrication processes to give our
partners exactly what they are looking for. This includes: felting, reticulation, convolution, die
cutting, slitting, lamination, hot forming, horizontal slicing, vertical cutting, & many more!

[View of a scientific laboratory with a monitor displaying cellular images and computer code, and a
person in a white lab coat partially visible.]

## Quality
## Checks

Foamtec ensures high quality in their products through rigorous quality checks. We utilize ISO and
IATF certified quality management systems, reflecting their commitment to meet stringent industry
standards. Our quality control processes are designed to maintain superior product standards and
reliability, ensuring that all specialty polyurethane foam products meet both the technical
requirements and the high expectations of their clients across various industries.

[Close-up of cleaning sponges in pink, brown, and yellow colors stacked vertically.]

## Final
## Packaging

Foamtec's final packaging capabilities are integral to their quality assurance, ensuring that
products are delivered in optimal condition. They utilize advanced packaging techniques to protect
the integrity and quality of their specialty polyurethane foams during shipment. This includes
tailor-made solutions that meet specific customer requirements and environmental considerations,
helping to prevent damage and reduce waste.

## Strategically
## Located.

We produce our high-quality polyurethane foam in Laem Chabang, Thailand. As one of the top foam
manufacturers worldwide, our strategic location near a major port significantly enhances our
operational efficiencies and customer service capabilities. This proximity allows for quicker and
more economical shipping options, streamlining our supply chain and reducing transit times. It
enables us to swiftly meet global market demands and maintain our competitive advantage by ensuring
timely delivery of our high-quality specialty polyurethane foam products to our customers worldwide.

[Aerial view of a busy shipping port with numerous cargo ships, cranes, containers, and storage
areas along the ocean.]

## Multiple Locations to Serve You!

[Aerial view of a manufacturing facility with labeled sections for foam converting, research and
development offices, foam manufacturing, a cleanroom product laboratory, and an ISO 13485 certified
product manufacturing with microbiology and cytotoxicity labs.]

Foamtec International operates multiple facilities across various countries. Foamtec has specialized
facilities in the United States, Singapore, China, Thailand, and Malaysia. Each location is equipped
to handle specific aspects of their manufacturing and service offerings, focusing on areas like
specialty converting, medical device manufacturing, foaming, converting, and research and
development. We are proud to be one of the top foam manufacturers in Asia that serves all countries
around the globe.

### Foamtec Facility Locations

Foamtec International are in the bottom left corner.]

# About Us

## East Meets West

Our business strategy focuses on delivering specialized polyurethane foam solutions through a global
approach that integrates the top business strategies from both the East and the West.

Our Eastern-inspired methods emphasize continuous improvement and the importance of fostering
long-term, cooperative relationships.

Our Western practices bring over two decades of expertise in the development, manufacturing, and
enhancement of specialized polyurethane foam solutions, offering significant value to our customers.

# The difference? Vertical Integration.

[A vertical infographic with icons representing steps or stages, including a light bulb with a gear
and magnifying glass, a laboratory flask, a platform with droplets, a cutting tool, a shield with a
checkmark, and stacked boxes. The background is blue with white icons.]

Being vertically integrated allows Foamtec International to control the entire manufacturing
process.

This allows us to be an all-in-one, end-to-end solution provider.

[Person operating a machine for material testing or calibration in a laboratory setting.]

## Research & Development

Foamtec's Research and Development team is robust, with over 30 specialists based in Thailand and
the United States. Their focus is dedicated to resolving client challenges through collaborative
efforts. This comprehensive approach supports their reputation for advancing industry standards and
enhancing product performance.

[Close-up of a CNC machine or 3D printer manufacturing a plastic or aluminum part with electronic
components or wiring visible beneath.]

## Foam
## Converting

[Industrial warehouse with yellow and green foam blocks stacked against a wall and a long white
material on a metal conveyor or work table.]

## Foam
## Pouring

With over 25 years of foam pouring expertise, Foamtec International is able to modify every aspect
of the foam’s characteristics.

Whether it’s the color, porosity, density, cytotoxicity, absorption rate, etc…

Foamtec International is able to create the perfect foam to meet your critical criteria.

Equipped with state-of-the-art equipment, Foamtec International is able to convert foam buns/rolls
into simple shapes such as sheets or complex 3D dimensions for intricate designs.

[Factory worker operating machinery in a textile or fabric manufacturing plant with pink and purple
fabric roll.]

## Foam
## Fabrication

Our main specialty foam facility utilizes a variety of different fabrication processes to give our
partners exactly what they are looking for. This includes: felting, reticulation, convolution, die
cutting, slitting, lamination, hot forming, horizontal slicing, vertical cutting, & many more!

[View of a scientific laboratory with a monitor displaying cellular images and computer code, and a
person in a white lab coat partially visible.]

## Quality
## Checks

Foamtec ensures high quality in their products through rigorous quality checks. We utilize ISO and
IATF certified quality management systems, reflecting their commitment to meet stringent industry
standards. Our quality control processes are designed to maintain superior product standards and
reliability, ensuring that all specialty polyurethane foam products meet both the technical
requirements and the high expectations of their clients across various industries.

[Close-up of cleaning sponges in pink, brown, and yellow colors stacked vertically.]

## Final
## Packaging

Foamtec's final packaging capabilities are integral to their quality assurance, ensuring that
products are delivered in optimal condition. They utilize advanced packaging techniques to protect
the integrity and quality of their specialty polyurethane foams during shipment. This includes
tailor-made solutions that meet specific customer requirements and environmental considerations,
helping to prevent damage and reduce waste.

## Strategically
## Located.

We produce our high-quality polyurethane foam in Laem Chabang, Thailand. As one of the top foam
manufacturers worldwide, our strategic location near a major port significantly enhances our
operational efficiencies and customer service capabilities. This proximity allows for quicker and
more economical shipping options, streamlining our supply chain and reducing transit times. It
enables us to swiftly meet global market demands and maintain our competitive advantage by ensuring
timely delivery of our high-quality specialty polyurethane foam products to our customers worldwide.

[Aerial view of a busy shipping port with numerous cargo ships, cranes, containers, and storage
areas along the ocean.]

## Multiple Locations to Serve You!

[Aerial view of a manufacturing facility with labeled sections for foam converting, research and
development offices, foam manufacturing, a cleanroom product laboratory, and an ISO 13485 certified
product manufacturing with microbiology and cytotoxicity labs.]

Foamtec International operates multiple facilities across various countries. Foamtec has specialized
facilities in the United States, Singapore, China, Thailand, and Malaysia. Each location is equipped
to handle specific aspects of their manufacturing and service offerings, focusing on areas like
specialty converting, medical device manufacturing, foaming, converting, and research and
development. We are proud to be one of the top foam manufacturers in Asia that serves all countries
around the globe.

# About Us

We Are Future Foam...
Comfort Through Chemistry

We take pride in being a team of innovators who manufacture the best in foam materials built to your
exact specifications every single time. Family owned since 1958, we are guided by our passion to
continually invent customer-driven solutions that push results and solve problems—not just in the
short term but for years to come. And with locations and manufacturing facilities strategically
placed around the world, we are able to stay flexible and give you the benefit of local expertise
with an international reach.

[Our History][20]

## CONTACT THE Team

Since 1958 our team has been propelled by curiosity and a steadfast dedication to inventing and
creating the best foam formulations for our customers.

[Contact Us][21]

## JOIN THE TEAM Careers

We are dedicated to being at the forefront of our industry and are constantly experimenting with our
chemistry and foam.

[Careers][22]

## LEARN MORE Resources

Your needs drive our thinking forward. And we’ll partner with you to tackle any challenge, no matter
how large or how small.

[Resources][23]

[Virtual Tour][24]

formulations for our customers.
