# Making award winning Swimming pool float aid for disabled children

Hydrotherapy and swimming give a wonderful sense of freedom to anyone who is otherwise confined to a
wheelchair or has very limited mobility. In addition, the exercise is invaluable to mobilise stiff
joints.

At Kewell Converters Ltd. we are proud to make a variety of swimming pool float aids which allow
users to achieve a level of independence in the water, and also, it goes without saying, a high
level of safety.

Fabricated from our buoyant, water-resistant and easy-to-clean foam, we have produced swimming
collars, head and neck supports as well as other flotation devices, for children and adults alike.

These are adjustable or come in a range of sizes, and may be useful in the bath as well as the
swimming pool.

Zotefoams are justifiably proud of the fact that Plastazote is the most referred thermoplastic in
the whole of the medical lexis, here at Kewells we are proud to supply some of Europe’s leading
quoted healthcare companies with their bespoke designed foam applications. Many of the foams
specified by our customers in this area require the foams in skin contact and also to be MRI, CT and
X-Ray lucent so they can be deployed in splint and support applications we manufacture.

We often specify Azote foams for prosthetic applications due to their very low mass, additionally
their range of available densities means that they have a wide range of podiatric applications,
particularly; Plantar Fasciitis,Pes Planus and Pes Cavus.

Plastazote and other foams are used in “moulding to the body” applications which has uses such as
manufacture of joint supports, spinal supports and immobilising orthoses.

The unusual hydrophobic and flexible nature of our foams also makes them ideal for manufacturing
hydrotherapy equipment. There are a wide variety of other medical foam solutions and of course we
are always interested to deliver new healthcare uses for our foams!

Whether you have a requirement for sports protection equipment such as ice and field hockey
goalkeeper (or netminder) protection, cricket pads and glove pad manufacture or you are a provider
of outdoor learning equipment in playgrounds and want an edge from leading design and manufacture in
foam, you should be talking to Kewells!

We have long experience in managing inventory, manufacture and design for a wide range of customers
in this area and can create foam solutions to meet your needs whether that be laminating two foams
together to deliver a soft feel surface on one side with some heavy duty impact protection on the
other, or perhaps you need an unusual shape fabricating for a challenging sporting or play
conundrum, call us first!

# Driven by precision: delivering high-performance foam solutions for Formula One

## **How Kewell Converters engineered bespoke automotive foam parts for a leading F1 racing team**

### **Background**

At Kewell Converters, we’re proud to be one of the UK’s most experienced foam fabricators and foam
converters, delivering high-quality, precision-engineered foam solutions to a wide range of
industries. With over 50 years of expertise, our team thrives on solving complex challenges –
especially in the fast-paced, high-stakes world of automotive engineering.

One of our most exciting recent projects involved supporting a [Formula One][58] racing team as they
prepared for a major Grand Prix. The team approached us with a unique request: they needed
custom-designed foam parts to securely house battery units used in their vehicles. The brief was
clear but challenging – protect the components, maximise the number of units per case, and deliver
the finished product within a tight deadline. Each order was different, requiring a fully bespoke
solution and a high degree of collaboration across our team.

### **The challenge**

In Formula One, there’s no margin for error. The customer needed tailored automotive foam inserts
that would not only protect delicate battery units but also fit seamlessly into their standard
transport boxes. These foam inserts had to be engineered to exact dimensions, use high-performance
materials, and be produced quickly and efficiently.

With many variables and components to consider – including sizing, protection, material selection,
and packaging – the challenge was not just technical but logistical. We also needed to ensure
minimal waste while providing a premium finish and precise fit, reflecting the [quality][59] and
performance expectations of a world-class racing team.

### **The solution**

This project was a true team effort. Our skilled CAD designer kicked the project off by creating a
concept drawing for a large plastic container. Within just a few days, the design was approved by
the customer and then production was set into motion.

To meet the team’s performance and sustainability requirements, we chose [Zotefoams][60] for the
project—specifically LDR 18 and Ecozote, a high-quality, recycled foam material. This selection
aligned with the customer’s need for durability and environmental responsibility.

Once the material arrived on-site, our operations team comprising of John, [Joel][61], [Micky][62]
and Chris, worked together to bring the design to life. We used advanced [water-jet cutting][63] to
shape the foam with high precision, followed by contour cutting and [CNC routing][64] to achieve
complex profiles and clean edges. These techniques enabled us to deliver the highest standard of
finish expected from a foam converter.

In just under 2 days of production time, the custom [foam inserts][65] were manufactured, assembled,
and packed ready to be shipped to the customer. We also took [sustainability][66] a step further by
repurposing offcuts to create additional tray components, ensuring minimal waste and maximum value.

### **The results**

The Formula One team was thrilled with the results. The finished foam parts met all requirements:
the battery units were protected, the foam packaging inserts fitted their standard cases perfectly
and the maximum number of units were able to be transported efficiently.

The customer appreciated not only the quality of the foam parts but also the collaborative and
responsive service from our team. Our ability to move quickly from concept to production, without
compromising on quality, was critical to the success of the project.

This project demonstrates our expertise in automotive foam, our ability to work under pressure, and
our commitment to delivering tailored, high-performance foam solutions that meet our customers’
unique needs.

### **Looking for expert automotive foam solutions?**

Whether you’re in motorsport, EV development, or automotive logistics, Kewell Converters is your
trusted partner for bespoke, high quality automotive foam solutions. From water-jet cutting and CNC
routing to premium Zotefoams and branded foams, we engineer every detail to meet the exacting
demands of the automotive industry.

Visit our [Automotive][67] page to learn more and see how we can support your next project and don’t
hesitate to [get in touch][68] with our team!

# Helping a Shropshire harness maker improve consistency and keep heavy horse craft alive

### How bespoke polyethylene foam components helped a traditional horse collar maker maintain
### quality, consistency and craft heritage

### **Background**

Terry Davis is one of the last traditional horse collar makers in the UK. Working from his workshop
in Wistanstow, Shropshire, he handcrafts collars used around the world, each one shaped around a
horse’s neck using specialist materials and generations of knowledge.

After sustaining a serious hand injury in 2009, Terry needed an alternative to the traditional
leather tube packed with rye straw. He required a material that was strong, resilient and easier to
work with. When he first approached Kewell Converters, he found a supplier who understood both the
practical demands and the heritage importance of his craft.

### **The challenge**

Terry produces very small batches and his production levels have fluctuated in recent years.
Originally Kewell Converters manufactured Terry’s components using roll-formed foam tubing. While
this created excellent results, the process is extremely labour intensive and no longer viable for
very low volume orders.

Terry needed:
* Smaller and more cost-effective quantities
* Consistent outer diameters
* Foam material that maintains strength and shape for many years
* A supplier willing to adapt processes to support a niche artisan craft

### **The solution**

Kewell Converters continued to use the LD60 polyethylene foam Terry has relied on for over a decade.
It offers the right density and durability for collars that must hold their shape over time.

To keep supporting Terry despite the reduced volumes, the team explored alternative manufacturing
methods. The most practical solution was to adapt the [CNC][58] Vertical Contour Cutting machine,
programming a sideways cutting path to replicate the tube-like profile as closely as possible in
smaller quantities.

This approach:
* Allows production in short, affordable batches
* Maintains the material performance Terry depends on
* Produces lengths that Terry can manually trim and finish to meet the exact dimensions required for
each collar

Although the CNC method naturally differs from the original tubing machine, it ensures Terry can
continue his craft without prohibitive setup costs. Throughout the project, Chloe in Customer Care
provided regular updates while the production team trialled different setups to achieve the most
consistent outcome.

### **The results**

Working collaboratively, Kewell Converters and Terry created a reliable, sustainable approach that
supports his production needs and maintains the [quality][59] expected of traditional heavy horse
collars.

The LD60 polyethylene foam continues to provide the strength and longevity required for collars that
often last for decades. As demand for heavy horse equipment gradually increases again, Kewell
Converters remains committed to supplying dependable, well-made foam components that help preserve
both the heritage and the future of this rural craft.

### **Preserving heritage through engineering support**

This project reflects Kewell Converters’ dedication to supporting specialist makers and traditional
industries. By adapting modern foam engineering techniques and offering a flexible, collaborative
approach, the team helps ensure this rare craft can continue for years to come.

If you need bespoke foam components, including tubing, [cases][60] or custom-cut profiles, the
Kewell Converters team can help you identify the most effective foam solution for your project.

# ULTIFLOAT: revolutionising swim training with bespoke foam

### **From concept to water-ready float – how we helped bring innovation to life**

### **Background**

[**ULTIFLOAT**][58] is a London-based start-up created by a Swim Coach with over 30 years’
experience. Designed to address the limitations of conventional swim floats, the ULTIFLOAT helps
swimmers improve body alignment, balance and technique from the very first stroke. Its unique
two-grip design encourages correct posture in the water, making lessons easier for both coaches and
swimmers.

When the ULTIFLOAT team approached us, they were looking for more than a manufacturer – they needed
a foam conversion partner who could turn their concept into a safe, durable, and water-ready
product. They wanted someone who understood the behaviour of foam and could help optimise the design
from the very beginning.

### **The Challenge**

The concept was clear, but bringing it to life involved several challenges:
* Choosing a foam with the right [buoyancy][59] and weight to suit swimmers of all ages and
abilities
* Making the float lightweight and easy to handle while also being durable enough for regular use
* Creating a foam prototype that could be tested and refined before committing to full production
* Incorporating precise design features, such as the heat-embossed grips, which required accuracy
and careful attention during production

We knew that to succeed, we needed to combine our technical experience with a collaborative
approach, guiding the ULTIFLOAT team through material choice, design optimisation, and production.

### **Solution**

With over 50 years’ experience working exclusively with [foam][60], we were confident Kewell
Converters could help. We recommended a premium foam with the right density for buoyancy, comfort,
and durability.

We created a prototype and worked closely with the founder through extensive testing to make sure
every detail was perfect. The grips were heat embossed, a step that required precision to ensure
consistency and usability. Using our CAD design capabilities and advanced production methods, we
produced the initial 1,000 units to the exact specifications required.

The result is a [high-quality][61], durable swim float that performs brilliantly in the water.
Lightweight and easy to use, it allows swimmers to focus on technique from the very first lesson.

“Kewell Converters were extremely helpful – friendly, professional and supportive throughout the
process.” Paul Dillon, ULTIFLOAT Founder

“It’s always exciting to work with a business bringing something new to market. Our job is to take
an idea, listen carefully, and then use our experience to make sure the foam performs exactly as it
needs to.” Nick Kewell, Managing Director, Kewell Converters

### **Looking ahead**

Following the launch, ULTIFLOAT is now exploring new colours and designs. This project shows how we
combine technical expertise with a collaborative approach, helping innovators take ambitious ideas
and turn them into practical, exceptional products.

Got an idea that needs the right foam expertise to make it real?

Partner with Kewell Converters and turn your concept into a market-ready product. [Contact us][62]
today.

# About us

[bespoke case insert for tooling]

## What we do

**Welcome to Kewell Converters**, the UK’s leading specialist in foam fabrication and conversion.
Established in 1971, we have over 50 years of experience in delivering bespoke, high-quality foam
products tailored to meet the unique needs of our diverse clientele.

We specialise in the design, development and manufacture of bespoke foam products, tailored to meet
the specific needs of our clients across a variety of demanding industries.

> We're a family managed and owned business and we try to ensure that those family values are part
> of the core way in which we do business... We talk to our customers, understand our customers and
> go above and beyond expectations.

Nick and Marcos Kewell Directors
[Marcos & Nick Kewell joint managing directors]

## We truly care

We’re an independent family run business that will never get complacent.

We’ll always look out for you by offering the best value and aim to consistently exceed your
expectations.

## Innovation is in our DNA

We’re curious and good at problem solving, continuing to push boundaries using new techniques and
materials.

We never stand still and invest in new technologies.

## With precision and quality

We’re passionate engineers that never cut corners or compromise on delivering the highest degree of
quality.

It’s all in the detail.

## Integrity matters

We do what we say and are trustworthy and honest.

Ethics matter.

## Meet the team

The business is family owned and operated and our culture reflects this. With over 50 years of
experience passed through generations, family values are at the core of what we do and our
highly-skilled and dedicated team are a testament to the high quality service and products we offer.

[Find out more][57]

## Manufacturing

We have continued to invest and our advanced, 33,000 sq ft, production and design facility was
commissioned in Kent (England) in 2011. The combination of CAD/CAM design and programming along with
CNC multi-head/axis routing enables us to offer a truly professional and custom solution to any
sector where the application of innovative foam design assists the best display, safe transport or
safety of application for our customers.

### Air Filtering

Merryweather Foam can help you determine the most effective foam filters for your facility’s air
filtration system, as well as custom medical foam filters for therapeutic applications like
nebulizers and other respiratory care applications.

CLOSE

### Blood Filtration & Oxygenation

The pumping action of heart-lung machines can create air bubbles that cause life-threatening
conditions by blocking the passage of blood through the veins. Passing the blood through a medical
foam filter made of reticulated foam eliminates the danger by breaking up air bubbles and making
blood safe for circulation.

CLOSE

### Orthotic Inserts

Our wide selection of high-quality materials and foam fabrication capabilities makes it easier for
your team to develop custom medical orthotic supplies for a variety of painful foot conditions. Give
your patient reliable relief with durable Merryweather medical foam inserts made to your
specifications.

CLOSE

### EKG Pads

Reticulated medical foam pads can be pre-impregnated with gel to improve electrical conductivity
while eliminating the messy step of applying gel to the patient’s skin. The quality and consistency
of our custom EKG supplies help provide the most accurate readings, helping doctors and nurses
provide the best care to their patients.

CLOSE

### Prosthetic Devices

One of the biggest challenges in successfully fitting prosthetic devices is mitigating the abrasion
they can cause against the wearer’s skin. Merryweather can work with you to craft custom prosthetic
foam pads that fit between a device’s hard metal or plastic parts and the patient’s body to
alleviate discomfort and improve quality of life.

CLOSE

### Sound Dampening

Patient privacy is a primary concern in hospitals and other healthcare settings. Sound-dampening
foam solutions from Merryweather can help ensure that sensitive patient information and discussions
of delicate subjects remain as private as possible in doctor offices, clinics, surgical suites, and
other medical situations.

CLOSE

### Medical Positioning Devices

Medical positioning wedges help achieve limb or torso immobilization that can alleviate discomfort,
ensure proper healing, facilitate therapeutic procedures and more. Merryweather can help you design
and fabricate a custom medical foam wedge that meets your exact specifications.
CLOSE

# Team, Family and Customization: Three Core Values

[View All Blogs][21]

2015 is nearly finished. Before we say goodbye to the current year, we want to pause to say “Thank
You” to our clients, suppliers, and employees! From the beginning of our company history in 1948,
relationships have been the common thread that knit the fabric of our company values. For over 67
years, we have been fueled by three core values that have propelled the company for generations:

**We are Team Driven** – Staying competitive in world markets means maximizing resources. At
Merryweather Foam, that includes working diligently as a team. This team focus keeps us moving ahead
more efficiently. A large number of our team members, from the factory floor to sales offices have
been members of our team for several decades–allowing us to provide consistent results and solutions
to our customers. We not only work together as a team, but we partner with our clients to better
deliver the products they need.

**We are Family Owned** – Merryweather Foam began as a family owned business and remains family
owned to this day. In 1948, Merryweather Foam Latex Company was founded in a humble Akron, Ohio
suburb by Lloyd, Raymond and Gerald Merryweather. At the time, the trio lived next to an engineer
from Goodyear who was working on an air foam product. Gradually, the Merryweather’s were able to
grow their business, creating foam mattresses and foam hair curlers that were so popular from the
50’s through the 70’s. In the 1960s, steady growth led Merryweather Foam to expand to a 90,000
square foot facility in Barberton, Ohio. By the mid 70’s, with relationships with he support of
Whirlpool and other manufacturing companies, Merryweather had expanded its facilities to include the
main Akron plant, three Cincinnati facilities and were now building a plant in Sylacauga, Alabama.
By the mid 1980’s, under competitive pressure, Merryweather Foam was purchased by Carl R. McCune, an
accountant who was familiar with the company. By the 1990’s, the company was again on the grow, and
the company built a manufacturing plant near El Paso, Texas. Today, the family values, so prominent
in the founding of the company, still play a major part of our philosophy as Mr. McCune’s son, and
grandchildren actively operate the company.

**We are Customer Service Fanatics** – We have what it takes to partner with you on your next
flexible foam fabrication project–no matter how large or small. Through the years, we’ve had the
pleasure of working with small businesses and large corporations to offer flexible foam solutions as
well as pressure sensitive adhesive lamination. We’ve created custom products for Dr. Scholl’s and
Sears. We’ve partnered with Whirlpool and GE Medical. In our early days, we were even the supplier
of custom designed foam rubber pads on which two monkeys rode in one of the first space capsules in
the U.S. If you need a custom flexible foam fabrication, we invite you to contact Merryweather Foam.
Put our experience in custom flexible foam fabrication to work for you and bring us your next
challenge!
By maintaining the values of being team driven, family owned, and by focusing on customer solutions,
we continue to serve our worldwide clients with integrity and value. In this season of gratefulness,
it is an excellent opportunity for us to take a look back as well as to look forward. For those who
we have had the pleasure of serving through the years we are profoundly grateful. For those will be
working with soon, we welcome you. Thank you, and have a prosperous new year.

## About MerryWeather Foam

Since 1948, we have been industry leaders in fabricating unique foam components for customers in the
medical, sound absorption, automotive, and packaging industries. At Merryweather Foam, we pride
ourselves on our ability to combine experience, innovation, and excellent customer service. We have
the knowledge, manpower and equipment to help you get the job done. View our capabilities to learn
more.

## What if Surfaces Could Fight Back? The Power of Antimicrobial Tech

Antimicrobial technology is added to the product during the manufacturing process and works to
inhibit the growth and reproduction of bacteria, mold, and mildew on product surfaces. Unlike
standard disinfectants that provide only limited residual protection, integrated antimicrobial
technology works to continuously mitigate destructive microbes on treated products.

An antimicrobial product is a product or surface that, during manufacturing, is treated with an
active ingredient to protect it against microbial growth.

## Who We Are

PTI, LLC (“PTI”) was originally founded in 1983 as Plastic Technology, Inc., and began by extruding
low-density PE profiles for the furniture industry and filler rods for the fiber optic cable
industry. Over the years, PTI’s product offerings expanded to include foam pipe insulation, pool
noodles, foam packaging profiles, and custom-designed profiles in various sectors. With a focus on
innovation, PTI is an industry leader in new product development and product improvement. Our
policy at PTI is to meet all of our customer's requirements and exceed their expectations.

As a subsidiary of HSM, PTI invests each year to improve its processes and equipment and today
operates one of the most advanced facilities in the industry. In the fall of 2019, PTI expanded
operations and moved into a new 268,000-square-foot state-of-the-art facility in Hickory, N.C. to
more efficiently and effectively meet the needs of its customers.

## Who We Are

## Who We Are

PTI, LLC (“PTI”) was originally founded in 1983 as Plastic Technology, Inc., and began by extruding
low-density PE profiles for the furniture industry and filler rods for the fiber optic cable
industry. Over the years, PTI’s product offerings expanded to include foam pipe insulation, pool
noodles, foam packaging profiles, and custom-designed profiles in various sectors. With a focus on
innovation, PTI is an industry leader in new product development and product improvement. Our
policy at PTI is to meet all of our customer's requirements and exceed their expectations.

As a subsidiary of HSM, PTI invests each year to improve its processes and equipment and today
operates one of the most advanced facilities in the industry. In the fall of 2019, PTI expanded
operations and moved into a new 268,000-square-foot state-of-the-art facility in Hickory, N.C. to
more efficiently and effectively meet the needs of its customers.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Recticel Group is a leading insulation company with headquarters in Belgium and operations in eight countries across Europa and the US. It offers smart insulation solutions that advance a carbon-free economy and a better quality of life. Our Insulation Boards division provides high performance insulation solutions to meet the growing demand for energy efficiency and sustainability in buildings. The insulation boards are marketed by RECTICEL INSULATION, our vacuum insulated panels by TURVAC, and our bespoke solutions for tapered and flat roofs by GRADIENT. Our Insulated Panels division specialises in premium quality products for the building envelope sector. TRIMO enables the highest aesthetic standards and extends architectural capabilities with its mineral wool insulated panels and modular space solutions. Conventional mineral wool and PIR insulated panels are manufactured by REX PANELS & PROFILES. Our recently acquired MICLAR and KURAS focus on downstream services for the insulated panels market. Within our Acoustic Solutions division, SOUNDCOAT provides highly specialised acoustic engineering capabilities for the aerospace and aviation markets, as well as for OEMs and the heavy-duty and transport industries. At the end of 2025, Recticel Group employed 1,311 people and achieved sales of EUR 655.1 million. The Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) approved Recticel Group’s near-term targets for the reduction of Scope 1, 2 & 3 greenhouse gas emissions by 2030 (from base year 2021) and net-zero targets for 2050. The Group is on the CDP A List for Climate Change and holds an EcoVadis Silver medal. Recticel Group is listed on Euronext in Brussels (Euronext: RECT - Reuters: RECT.BR - Bloomberg: RECT:BB).
_crawl.key_brands_represented: Insulation Boards; Insulated Panels; Acoustic Solutions

_crawl.linkedin_about: NYSE:ROG – Rogers Corporation is a global technology leader in specialty engineered materials that enable high performance and high reliability in EV/HEV, wireless infrastructure, automotive safety and portable electronics. Three things characterize us – leadership in mission-critical reliability, commitment to market-focused innovation and our passion for delivering exceptional value that enables our customers’ success. The company was founded in 1832 as a paper mill in Manchester, Connecticut. Now headquartered in Arizona (USA), Rogers operates manufacturing facilities in the United States, Belgium, China, Germany, Hungary and South Korea, with joint ventures and sales offices worldwide. With over 190 years of knowledge in material science and process engineering, we are trusted business partners to many of the world’s most innovative and successful industrial technology providers. Our innovative material technologies help power, protect and connect our world while enabling a more sustainable future.

industrielle.] ][109]

Nous transformons des matériaux isolants thermiques et diélectriques ainsi que des matériaux coupe
feu pour des températures comprises entre -260°C et +1760°C.

haute température.] ][111]

températures de l’ambiance à +1370°C, à partir de tissus techniques, garnis de matériaux isolants
puis équipés de systèmes de fermeture.

# OPTIMISE L'ÉNERGIE INDUSTRIELLE

depuis plus de 90 ans

## Expert en isolation industrielle, ELIT conçoit et réalise des solutions d'isolation thermique sur
## mesure.

[ [Pièces usinées en matériaux isolants rigides pour isolation thermique et diélectrique
industrielle.] ][109]

## [ ISOLATION RIGIDE ][110]

Nous transformons des matériaux isolants thermiques et diélectriques ainsi que des matériaux coupe
feu pour des températures comprises entre -260°C et +1760°C.

[ [Matelas isolant souple démontable installé sur tuyauterie industrielle pour isolation thermique
haute température.] ][111]

## [ ISOLATION SOUPLE ][112]

Souples et facilement démontables, nos matelas isolants INSULFLEX sont réalisés sur mesure, pour des
températures de l’ambiance à +1370°C, à partir de tissus techniques, garnis de matériaux isolants
puis équipés de systèmes de fermeture.

[ [Isolation sur site d’équipements industriels avec calorifuge aluminium pour améliorer la
performance énergétique et protéger les installations.] ][113]

## [ ISOLATION SUR SITES ][114]

Nos équipes de monteurs, habilités MASE, interviennent pour isoler les installations de process
industriels en service de -160°C à +850°C, protéger des nuisances sonores...

Elit, au service des industries

NOTRE MISSION

## Répondre aux besoins d'isolation thermique industrielle

**Grâce à nos trois départements,** nous analysons vos besoins en **protections thermiques**,**
protections phoniques**, **protections incendie passives**, **réchauffages** et **maintien en
température** de vos installations.
Nous intervenons de l’étude à la conception d’équipements neufs, mais également pour l’amélioration,
la modification, la mise en conformité d’équipements anciens.
Nos études thermiques s’appuient sur des logiciels de calculs éprouvés et des référentiels de la
norme ISO.
Notre expérience ainsi que nos moyens de productions nous permettent de proposer **des solutions
d’isolations thermiques industrielles pour une gamme de températures de -260° C à +1760°C.**

*« L’énergie est notre avenir, économisons là » et pour cela l’isolation thermique industrielle est
un moyen simple et efficace d’y parvenir avec en plus un retour sur investissement inférieur à 1 an
dans la plupart des cas.
*[http://www.eiif.org][115]

# OPTIMISE L'ÉNERGIE INDUSTRIELLE

depuis plus de 90 ans

## Expert en isolation industrielle, ELIT conçoit et réalise des solutions d'isolation thermique sur
## mesure.

[ [Pièces usinées en matériaux isolants rigides pour isolation thermique et diélectrique
industrielle.] ][109]

## [ ISOLATION RIGIDE ][110]

Nous transformons des matériaux isolants thermiques et diélectriques ainsi que des matériaux coupe
feu pour des températures comprises entre -260°C et +1760°C.

[ [Matelas isolant souple démontable installé sur tuyauterie industrielle pour isolation thermique
haute température.] ][111]

## [ ISOLATION SOUPLE ][112]

Souples et facilement démontables, nos matelas isolants INSULFLEX sont réalisés sur mesure, pour des
températures de l’ambiance à +1370°C, à partir de tissus techniques, garnis de matériaux isolants
puis équipés de systèmes de fermeture.

[ [Isolation sur site d’équipements industriels avec calorifuge aluminium pour améliorer la
performance énergétique et protéger les installations.] ][113]

## [ ISOLATION SUR SITES ][114]

Nos équipes de monteurs, habilités MASE, interviennent pour isoler les installations de process
industriels en service de -160°C à +850°C, protéger des nuisances sonores...

Elit, au service des industries

NOTRE MISSION

## Répondre aux besoins d'isolation thermique industrielle

**Grâce à nos trois départements,** nous analysons vos besoins en **protections thermiques**,**
protections phoniques**, **protections incendie passives**, **réchauffages** et **maintien en
température** de vos installations.
Nous intervenons de l’étude à la conception d’équipements neufs, mais également pour l’amélioration,
la modification, la mise en conformité d’équipements anciens.
Nos études thermiques s’appuient sur des logiciels de calculs éprouvés et des référentiels de la
norme ISO.
Notre expérience ainsi que nos moyens de productions nous permettent de proposer **des solutions
d’isolations thermiques industrielles pour une gamme de températures de -260° C à +1760°C.**

*« L’énergie est notre avenir, économisons là » et pour cela l’isolation thermique industrielle est
un moyen simple et efficace d’y parvenir avec en plus un retour sur investissement inférieur à 1 an
dans la plupart des cas.
*[http://www.eiif.org][115]

NOS ACTIVITÉS

## Expertise technique en isolation thermique
## pour optimiser votre performance énergétique

Depuis plus de **90 ans**, **ELIT** accompagne les industries dans la **réduction des pertes
thermiques**, l’**optimisation énergétique** et la **mise en conformité des installations**.

Nos équipes sont composées de **chargés d’affaires et de techniciens spécialisés**, qui vous
conseillent à chaque étape : de l’**étude technique** à la **mise en œuvre des solutions
d’isolation**. Grâce à nos compétences et à l’utilisation de **logiciels de calcul thermique de
référence**, nous nous appuyons sur les **dernières normes européennes** pour garantir des solutions
conformes, durables et efficaces.

# OPTIMISE L'ÉNERGIE INDUSTRIELLE

depuis plus de 90 ans

## Expert en isolation industrielle, ELIT conçoit et réalise des solutions d'isolation thermique sur
## mesure.

[ [Pièces usinées en matériaux isolants rigides pour isolation thermique et diélectrique
industrielle.] ][109]

## [ ISOLATION RIGIDE ][110]

Nous transformons des matériaux isolants thermiques et diélectriques ainsi que des matériaux coupe
feu pour des températures comprises entre -260°C et +1760°C.

[ [Matelas isolant souple démontable installé sur tuyauterie industrielle pour isolation thermique
haute température.] ][111]

## [ ISOLATION SOUPLE ][112]

Souples et facilement démontables, nos matelas isolants INSULFLEX sont réalisés sur mesure, pour des
températures de l’ambiance à +1370°C, à partir de tissus techniques, garnis de matériaux isolants
puis équipés de systèmes de fermeture.

[ [Isolation sur site d’équipements industriels avec calorifuge aluminium pour améliorer la
performance énergétique et protéger les installations.] ][113]

## [ ISOLATION SUR SITES ][114]

Nos équipes de monteurs, habilités MASE, interviennent pour isoler les installations de process
industriels en service de -160°C à +850°C, protéger des nuisances sonores...

Elit, au service des industries

NOTRE MISSION

## Répondre aux besoins d'isolation thermique industrielle

**Grâce à nos trois départements,** nous analysons vos besoins en **protections thermiques**,**
protections phoniques**, **protections incendie passives**, **réchauffages** et **maintien en
température** de vos installations.
Nous intervenons de l’étude à la conception d’équipements neufs, mais également pour l’amélioration,
la modification, la mise en conformité d’équipements anciens.
Nos études thermiques s’appuient sur des logiciels de calculs éprouvés et des référentiels de la
norme ISO.
Notre expérience ainsi que nos moyens de productions nous permettent de proposer **des solutions
d’isolations thermiques industrielles pour une gamme de températures de -260° C à +1760°C.**

*« L’énergie est notre avenir, économisons là » et pour cela l’isolation thermique industrielle est
un moyen simple et efficace d’y parvenir avec en plus un retour sur investissement inférieur à 1 an
dans la plupart des cas.
*[http://www.eiif.org][115]

NOS ACTIVITÉS

## Expertise technique en isolation thermique
## pour optimiser votre performance énergétique

Depuis plus de **90 ans**, **ELIT** accompagne les industries dans la **réduction des pertes
thermiques**, l’**optimisation énergétique** et la **mise en conformité des installations**.

Nos équipes sont composées de **chargés d’affaires et de techniciens spécialisés**, qui vous
conseillent à chaque étape : de l’**étude technique** à la **mise en œuvre des solutions
d’isolation**. Grâce à nos compétences et à l’utilisation de **logiciels de calcul thermique de
référence**, nous nous appuyons sur les **dernières normes européennes** pour garantir des solutions
conformes, durables et efficaces.

## [ ISOLATION RIGIDE ][110]

Nous transformons des matériaux isolants thermiques et diélectriques ainsi que des matériaux coupe
feu pour des températures comprises entre -260°C et +1760°C.

[ [Matelas isolant souple démontable installé sur tuyauterie industrielle pour isolation thermique
haute température.] ][111]

## [ ISOLATION SOUPLE ][112]

Souples et facilement démontables, nos matelas isolants INSULFLEX sont réalisés sur mesure, pour des
températures de l’ambiance à +1370°C, à partir de tissus techniques, garnis de matériaux isolants
puis équipés de systèmes de fermeture.

[ [Isolation sur site d’équipements industriels avec calorifuge aluminium pour améliorer la
performance énergétique et protéger les installations.] ][113]

## [ ISOLATION SUR SITES ][114]

Nos équipes de monteurs, habilités MASE, interviennent pour isoler les installations de process
industriels en service de -160°C à +850°C, protéger des nuisances sonores...

Elit, au service des industries

NOTRE MISSION

## Répondre aux besoins d'isolation thermique industrielle

**Grâce à nos trois départements,** nous analysons vos besoins en **protections thermiques**,**
protections phoniques**, **protections incendie passives**, **réchauffages** et **maintien en
température** de vos installations.
Nous intervenons de l’étude à la conception d’équipements neufs, mais également pour l’amélioration,
la modification, la mise en conformité d’équipements anciens.
Nos études thermiques s’appuient sur des logiciels de calculs éprouvés et des référentiels de la
norme ISO.
Notre expérience ainsi que nos moyens de productions nous permettent de proposer **des solutions
d’isolations thermiques industrielles pour une gamme de températures de -260° C à +1760°C.**

*« L’énergie est notre avenir, économisons là » et pour cela l’isolation thermique industrielle est
un moyen simple et efficace d’y parvenir avec en plus un retour sur investissement inférieur à 1 an
dans la plupart des cas.

performance and sustainability while meeting the challenges of the decarbonization of the world of
construction and industry, the preservation of resources and rapid urbanization.

# What We Do

At SEKISUI Voltek, we develop, manufacture, and distribute cross-linked, closed-cell polyolefin
foams that bring your ideas to life. As a recognized leader with over 50 years of experience, our
foam products have helped create new and revolutionized product designs for medical, general
industrial, automotive and aviation markets.

We strive for excellence through the spirit of teamwork and are guided by the following principles:
**Service, Speed, and Superiority.** SEKISUI Voltek has manufacturing facilities in Michigan, and
sales offices located throughout the United States, making us the leading manufacturer of
cross-linked polyolefin foam in North and South America.

Our main product lines include Volara®, Volextra®, and VolaraBLOCK®. We also have the ability to
provide expanded offerings with our global network of SEKISUI companies, ask us how!

# Contributing To Society through Our Business Activities

We will continually improve our processes, including our Quality Management System, to ensure
customer satisfaction by providing products that meet or exceed our customer’s expectations in a
safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible manner.

Sekisui Voltek’s management with executive responsibility has defined and documented its policy for
quality, including objectives for quality and its commitment to quality. The quality policy is
relevant to our organizational goals, and the expectations and needs of its customers. We ensures
this policy is understood, implemented, and maintained at all levels of the organization.

# What We Do

At SEKISUI Voltek, we develop, manufacture, and distribute cross-linked, closed-cell polyolefin
foams that bring your ideas to life. As a recognized leader with over 50 years of experience, our
foam products have helped create new and revolutionized product designs for medical, general
industrial, automotive and aviation markets.

We strive for excellence through the spirit of teamwork and are guided by the following principles:
**Service, Speed, and Superiority.** SEKISUI Voltek has manufacturing facilities in Michigan, and
sales offices located throughout the United States, making us the leading manufacturer of
cross-linked polyolefin foam in North and South America.

Our main product lines include Volara®, Volextra®, and VolaraBLOCK®. We also have the ability to
provide expanded offerings with our global network of SEKISUI companies, ask us how!

# A Sustainable Future Through Innovation

We know that a better future starts with the actions we take today. We are committed to finding ways
to reduce our impact on the environment and improving the lives of people; from the way we work, to
developing sustainable product options and working towards our ESG management goals (Environmental,
Social and Governance) and SDGs (Sustainable Development Goals).

By developing sustainable practices, we help to protect the planet for future generations through
our manufacturing processes and procedures. We have identified processes that contribute to greater
efficiencies which in turn help reduce energy usage, decrease carbon emissions and eliminate scrap
foam ending up in a landfill.

Our parent company, SEKISUI CHEMICAL, has laid out a strong vision to guide where we are headed
today, and into the future. “Through prominence in technology and quality, SEKISUI CHEMICAL Group
will contribute to improving the lives of people of the world and the Earth’s environment, by
continuing to open up new frontiers in residential and social infrastructure creation and chemical
solutions.”

SEKISUI CHEMICAL was selected as one of the [2022 Global 100 Most Sustainable Corporations in the
World][29] for the fifth consecutive year and seventh time overall.

**Sustainable Product Development**

The development of sustainable options is a driving force for our future as we responsibly innovate
new solutions. Our Research and Development team has developed sustainable options which include:
* Recycled Resins
* Calcium Carbonate Filled Foam
* Non-Halogenated FR Foam
* Stearate-Free Options

[About Sekisui Voltek]

# What We Do

At SEKISUI Voltek, we develop, manufacture, and distribute cross-linked, closed-cell polyolefin
foams that bring your ideas to life. As a recognized leader with over 50 years of experience, our
foam products have helped create new and revolutionized product designs for medical, general
industrial, automotive and aviation markets.

We strive for excellence through the spirit of teamwork and are guided by the following principles:
**Service, Speed, and Superiority.** SEKISUI Voltek has manufacturing facilities in Michigan, and
sales offices located throughout the United States, making us the leading manufacturer of
cross-linked polyolefin foam in North and South America.

Our main product lines include Volara®, Volextra®, and VolaraBLOCK®. We also have the ability to
provide expanded offerings with our global network of SEKISUI companies, ask us how!

_crawl.linkedin_about: Sheela Foam Limited is India’s leading manufacturer of PU foam and mattresses, best known for its flagship brand Sleepwell. With over 50 years of excellence, the Company has built a strong legacy of technological innovation, quality manufacturing, and customer-centric solutions. Headquartered in India, Sheela Foam has a presence in Spain and Australia, and operates a network of 18+ advanced manufacturing plants across three continents. These facilities are recognized for their high standards in both quality and environmental sustainability. The Company’s diverse product portfolio is distributed through 20,000+ retail touchpoints across India, under trusted brands like Sleepwell and Kurl-on. Its extensive pan-India sales and distribution network, supported by highly qualified and professional management teams, ensures wide market reach and operational efficiency. Sheela Foam is also the first mattress and home comfort products company in India to be listed on the stock exchanges. A notable achievement includes a patented technology integrated across its product range — the latest in a line of ongoing innovations. These are further strengthened by the Company’s well-integrated operations and economies of scale. The Company is guided by its core values: Integrity, Humility, Innovation, Accountability, and Customer Orientation. Visit us at: www.sheelafoam.com

timeline

Half a century of growth and apsiration

[2.8.1 1971]

1971

**Sheela Foam was founded** in Sahibabad, Uttar Pradesh, by Mrs. Sheela Gautam, marking the
beginning of our journey.

[2.8.1 1994]

1994

**We launched our flagship brand, ‘Sleepwell’,** which has since become a favourite among urban
Indian households.

[2.8.1 1998-99]

1998-1999

**The Company introduced rubberised coir** products under the brand name ‘Starlite’.

[2.8.1 2001-03]

2001-2003

**We began operations at India’s largest PU** (polyurethane) foam-producing plant in Greater Noida.

[2.8.1 2005]

2005

**In a major move to expand globally,** Sheela Foam acquired the polyurethane and polystyrene
business of Joyce Australia.

[2.8.1 2008-10]

2008-2010

**Sheela Foam received prestigious**
**awards**, including the Nasscom CNBC-TV18 IT user award, Silver Edge Award.

[2.8.1 2016]

2016

**The Company received the Computer World Premier Award** and was listed on the NSE and BSE.

[2.8.1 2017]

2017

**We were recognised by PU Tech for Innovative** Technology in Vertical Variable Pressure Foaming.

[2.8.1 2018]

2018

**Sheela Foam won multiple awards, including** the Star SME of the Year by BS; a silver medal in
green manufacturing.

[2.8.1 2019]

2019

**Expanding our footprint in Europe, the Company** acquired Interplasp S.L. in Spain.

[2.8.1 2021]

2021

**We established a new Subsidiary, International Comfort** **Technologies**, to focus on key growing
sectors like E-commerce.

[2.8.1 2022]

2022

**Sheela Foam issued bonus shares in a 1:1 ratio.**

[2.8.1 2023]

2023

**We acquired Kurl-on, the market leader in Rubberised Coir Mattresses**, and bought a controlling
stake in Furlenco.

timeline

Half a century of growth and apsiration

[2.8.1 1971]

1971

**Sheela Foam was founded** in Sahibabad, Uttar Pradesh, by Mrs. Sheela Gautam, marking the
beginning of our journey.

[2.8.1 1994]

1994

**We launched our flagship brand, ‘Sleepwell’,** which has since become a favourite among urban
Indian households.

[2.8.1 1998-99]

1998-1999

**The Company introduced rubberised coir** products under the brand name ‘Starlite’.

[2.8.1 2001-03]

2001-2003

**We began operations at India’s largest PU** (polyurethane) foam-producing plant in Greater Noida.

[2.8.1 2005]

2005

**In a major move to expand globally,** Sheela Foam acquired the polyurethane and polystyrene
business of Joyce Australia.

[2.8.1 2008-10]

2008-2010

**Sheela Foam received prestigious**
**awards**, including the Nasscom CNBC-TV18 IT user award, Silver Edge Award.

[2.8.1 2016]

2016

**The Company received the Computer World Premier Award** and was listed on the NSE and BSE.

[2.8.1 2017]

2017

**We were recognised by PU Tech for Innovative** Technology in Vertical Variable Pressure Foaming.

[2.8.1 2018]

2018

**Sheela Foam won multiple awards, including** the Star SME of the Year by BS; a silver medal in
green manufacturing.

[2.8.1 2019]

2019

**Expanding our footprint in Europe, the Company** acquired Interplasp S.L. in Spain.

[2.8.1 2021]

2021

**We established a new Subsidiary, International Comfort** **Technologies**, to focus on key growing
sectors like E-commerce.

[2.8.1 2022]

2022

**Sheela Foam issued bonus shares in a 1:1 ratio.**

[2.8.1 2023]

2023

**We acquired Kurl-on, the market leader in Rubberised Coir Mattresses**, and bought a controlling
stake in Furlenco.

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and
production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and
production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

_crawl.linkedin_about: O singură platformă, Toate sursele de finanțare. Misiunea SMIS – Structural Management Innovative System este de a imbunatati accesul la informatie pentru orice persoana din Romania care doreste sa acceseze finantari nerambursabile, si oferirea de suport tehnic si consultanta (prin firme de consultanta partenere) in fazele de scriere si implementare. Motivatia este data de faptul ca nu exista un ecosistem informatic, de tip digital hub care sa reuneasca aceste informatii si sa le explice tuturor entitatilor interesate, intr-un format usor de inteles (user friendly). Totodata nu exista o platforma care sa reuneasca firmele de consultanta, astfel incat identificarea unui consultant sa se faca dupa criterii calitative si nu de cost. Dorim sa punem la punct un sistem de feedback si recomandari pentru a filtra consultantii cu experienta si cu rezultate povizitive. Pe termen lung dorim integrarea serviciilor oferite prin platforma SMIS in toate proiectele cu finantare europeana, printr-o colaborare administrativa cu Autoritatile de Management, Agentiile de plati si implementare, Ministerele Responsabile. Totodata ne dorim sa contribuim la simplificarea ghidurilor solicitantului, la modernizarea sistemului de aplicare, si implementare printr-o digitalizare progresiva, folosind inteligenta artificiala.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Smooth-On, Inc. is a pioneering leader in the development and manufacturing of advanced rubbers, plastics, foams, and other specialized materials. For over a century, we have been dedicated to providing top-quality products that cater to a wide range of industries and applications, from mold making and casting to special effects and architectural restoration. With a rich history of innovation, Smooth-On is trusted globally by professionals and hobbyists alike. Our materials are used in diverse fields such as: Entertainment and Special Effects: Creating realistic props, animatronics, and set designs. Architecture and Restoration: Crafting durable architectural elements and restoring historical structures. Medical Simulation: Developing lifelike medical training aids and prosthetics. What Sets Us Apart Our extensive product line includes silicone rubbers, urethane rubbers, liquid plastics, foams, and more, each designed to deliver exceptional performance and durability. We offer a wealth of how-to guides, video tutorials, and technical support to help our users achieve the best results with our products. Smooth-On products are utilized worldwide, from Hollywood studios to renowned architectural projects, ensuring superior outcomes and lasting results. Quality and innovation are at the core of everything we do at Smooth-On. We continuously strive to enhance our product offerings and support our customers in bringing their creative and functional projects to life. Whether you're an industry professional, a creative artist, or a DIY enthusiast, Smooth-On has the materials and expertise to support your projects. Connect with us to explore how our products can help you achieve your vision.

# Our on site machinery

#### Find out more about the range of machinery that is situated on-site at our factories in Milton
#### Keynes and Corby.

[Foam processing machinery]

[foam manufacturing machinery]

### Block splitter

Our range of stacking and heavy duty splitters enable us to cut polyurethane foams from 12kg/m3 up
to 200kg/m3 in thicknesses of 3mm upwards.

### Band Knife

Band knives cut foam into rectangular pads and strips. More complex parts can be template and angle
cut.

### Lamination booths

Laminating of foam, facings and self-adhesive. We select the most suitable method of lamination for
each product. Offering a range of self-adhesive and sprayable adhesive systems and processes.

### Auto Buffers

We produce one of the largest ranges of polishing and compounding pads; our buffing machines allow a
variety of edge profiles, radiuses, rebates, tear drop buffing and fluting. These machiens also
produce shaped bath sponges as well

### Die-cutting presses

Our range of presses include two travelling head presses, ideal for high volume components; the head
rotates to enable the most efficient yield from the material, often gaining in excess of 15%
improvement on conventional beam pressing. Stamping gap is reduced and the rate of pressing is much
higher than manual presses. However, there is still a place for our beam presses; they are suited to
larger and lower volume parts.

### Flashcut tables

A CNC die-less knife cutting system using an oscillating blade to cut components. The cutting
process gives a straight edge to the parts, avoiding the concavity theat die cut parts can exhibit.
Parts are nested within the material and cut without the need for expensive die cutting tools. Parts
can be modified by amending cutting programs avoiding additional tooling costs, often shortening the
timescale of the development and production process. Acoustic sets are nested and cut all at once if
packing in sets is required. Blade depth can be altered so the foam is not cut all the way through
if score lines or tear-off/knock out pieces are needed.

### Laser cutting

Our laser cutting faciity offers accurate processing of parts even very small components. We can
also add lettering and logos to the foam parts.

### Milling and grinding machines

A range of equipment that can mill, bore, plunge cut, turn and grind polyurethane foam, rubber and
polyethylene foams. We produce balls, wheels, cylinders, blind bored cylinders, print rollers, and
cones.

### Printing

We provide a range of printing services including silk screen printing, laser etching and transfer
film.

### Sewing Machine

Computer aided sewing machines to pruduce a range of sewn parts, often edge sealing or enhancing
bond strength.

### Horizontal CNC profiler

The horizontal CNC profiler produces 2 and 3 dimensional foam parts from the whole width or length
of the block, allowing parts to be produced over 1 metre in length. Optimal yield is achieved giving
cost effective products. Among the components we have produced are acoustic pyramid tiles, wave
profiles, cylinders, anechoic wedges, tubes, filter elements and chess pieces.

### Automated cutting line

Incorporates a splitter, conveyor system and vertical cnc profiler, ideal for large volume work from
rectangles to complex 2D shapes. A block is loaded on the machine which produces finished parts
without the need to move between different production stations. Improving efficiency and increasing
our ability to handle large volume orders at short notice.

### CNC Router

Our CNC router can produce complex 2D and 3D shapes that can’t be produced by die cutting and would
otherwise need to be moulded. Presentation case inserts and packaging fitments can be cut to suit
the shape of the component. Our machine also has an oscillating blade funtion, enabling it to cut in
a similar fashion to our Flash Cutters and to a greater depth.

### Egg box profiler

Produces interlocking pairs of foam in egg box profile. The base and rise of the foam can be varied
to suit specific requirements. The increased surface area created offers improved filtration and
acoustic properties. The sinusidal shape of the profile allows a gradual absorbtion of impact and
pressure making it ideal for cushioning applications in packaging.

### Drilling machine

A unique machine which produces ink rollers, paint rollers etc, all with totally straight sides and
within very tight tolerances (such as +/-0.25mm)

# Foam Design & Development

## Working with you to bring your foam design ideas to life

> We not only manufacture foam-based products, we can help design and develop your prototype.
> Duncan Geddes, Business Manager

## How does foam design work?

Due to our in-house expertise, we’re not just product manufacturers, we collaborate with people to
solve materials problems, develop their concepts and make them real.

For more than 20 years, we’ve been helping people take their ideas to market supported by
longstanding relationships with raw material suppliers, packaging firms and logistics providers. We
also understand the need for confidentiality, so we’re happy to sign NDAs so that we can have open,
honest discussions to help you to develop your new product to its full potential.

We can support you at every stage of product development from R&D to delivery, and we do it all
absolutely free-of-charge.

> It’s exciting to work with people who have an innovative new idea and we love building a team
> round the concept to help take it to market. Customers seem to enjoy our passion and expertise and
> we love being a part of the process – it’s one of the best parts of this job.
> Przemyslaw Gorecki, Operations Manager

## Expertise and advice we offer:
* Choosing the optimal foam or rubber grade for your product
* Sourcing raw materials
* The most suitable manufacturing processes
* Pricing (including material and labour costs, and retail margins)
* Retail packaging
* Logistics
* Launching and marketing your new product

# *Case study:* High-performance reticulated foam filters

## Client

A leading producer of high-performance filters for auto sport.*

## The challenge

The company was started by two engineers who left an iconic performance car brand to set up a
company providing high-performance air filters.

Standard engines use paper filter which get clogged and thrown away. The company wanted to create
better filters, that not only captured more particles to keep the engine cleaner for longer but were
washable as well.

The capturing of particles was an important aspect of the brief, as dust and dirt particles that
simply bounced off the filter would go back into the engine, potentially causing different problems.

They recognised that because foam has different porosities, it would make a great filtration media
for their application, and so looked at combining various pore size and densities to capture
different particles at different stages of the filter.

> We control our stock on a Kanban basis, which Technical Foam Services and Custom Foams manage
> diligently.

## Our solution

By using a range of [reticulated foams][144] from polyurethane and polyester- or polyether-based
foams with porosities that ranged from course 10ppi (pores per inch) foam up to 100pore per inch
foam which is very fine, we created a range of innovative, high-performance multi-layered filter.

And it was washable. This meant that racing drivers and their teams could wash the filters after
races and replace them afresh for the highest possible performance, every time.

A subsequent filter style we developed with them was carbon-impregnated foam. This process
eliminates odour from the dirty filter and made the filters more fire retardant – which is very
important in motor sport.

## How it worked

We worked closely with the company and four of our global suppliers to combine specific materials
and develop the multi-layered, multi-density foam filter technology.

They say: “TFS and Custom Foams took the time to learn about our business expectations and, as a
result, they are both highly efficient and very easy to work with.”

The course foam caught larger particles first, stopping them clogging or bouncing off finer foam.
The mid porosity foam caught the next size of particle down, and the fine foam stopped what remained
from getting through. This meant the air flowed stronger for longer.

The finished product delivered improved engine power and torque while giving the engine superior
protection from dirt as well as reduced fuel consumption and emissions.

Because the products were hardwearing and washable, the company was also able to offer a lifetime
product warranty with each one.

grades of foam, along with many more from elsewhere around the world. We have built up excellent
relationships with many global manufacturers of foam and rubber, so we can offer a more
comprehensive range of foams, which in turn benefits our customers.

### High-level hardware

Foam is light, soft and flexible – completely unlike rigid materials such as wood or metal.
Machining foam often requires skill, patience, and considerable knowledge of the raw materials and
machine capability. Our engineers and production operators are trained accordingly, and understand
the importance of producing a quality product.

While our factories have all the standard foam cutting and laminating equipment, from band-knives,
to die-cutting presses, we have developed our own unique range of machines to create different
shapes and profiles. For example, we can cut foam to within 0.25 of a millimetre! This is what makes
our company stand out in the foam industry: we can produce things that others can’t.

### Experience

Key members of our team have many years’ experience in the foam industry – some of our key
individuals have more than 30 years’ knowledge of foam!

### Skillsets

As such, we bring together extensive knowledge of the raw materials with high-level engineering
expertise. We know about technical foam materials, we know how to convert it to meet your needs, and
we can build and modify the machines to execute it.

### Bespoke

Each customer and their request is unique and we approach our business the same way with a bespoke,
tailored approach. That’s why we understand the importance of building close relationships with our
customers: we need to understand your precise needs so we can determine the right solution, every
time. Nothing’s off-the-shelf.

* Automotive Polishing Foam Sourcing Solutions

# *Case study:* Automotive polishing foam

> Technical Foam Services have continued to prove themselves as a first-class supplier of quality
> polishing and compounding foam pads.

## The client

A leading car care company*

## The challenge

“Our company is a manufacturer of high-quality polishing liquids, some of which are applied using
polyurethane foam pads,” explains our client. They were importing some of their foam from America as
well sourcing some from us at Technical Foam Services – as their UK foam converter.

The company wanted to change the way they worked and base operations solely in the UK. But how could
they do this when they needed materials from different places?

> We wanted a partner in the UK that met all of our performance requirements.

## Our solution

Technical Foam Services (TFS) supplied the complete range of finished products, sourcing the
composite parts from foam manufacturers in the USA and other countries, so our client only had to
deal with one supplier.

“Their understanding of our requirement from the outset was excellent,” say our client. “They
quickly proved themselves as a very knowledgeable, capable and reliable company to work with.”

## How it worked

We buy all the foam they need for their products from foam manufacturers and suppliers around the
world, giving them access to global materials through a single point of contact.

As well as the supply chain being changed, our relationship has grown into a thriving partnership.
TFS work directly with the client to test their waxes and other products, as well as helping to
develop new lines. We identify the best materials – often ones that are new to the market – source,
supply and convert them.

The client explains: “We transferred all our foam business to TFS much quicker than originally
anticipated. Since then they have continued to prove themselves as a first-class supplier of quality
polishing and compounding foam pads.”

## The results

TFS currently supply our client with 500,000 [foam applicator pads][144] a year. Our 10-year
relationship with this client continues to be a highly successful partnership.

What’s it like to work with us? They say: “We highly recommend TFS to anybody looking for a new
supplier of foam pads.”

# *Case study:* High density foam tablet holder

> TFS were prepared to listen to my hopes and correlate these with what was actually achievable,
> both in terms of quality and within budget.
> Aaron Bennett

## The client

Aaron Bennett is a web developer and product designer.

## **The challenge**

Aaron recognised a problem with using tablets such as iPads. If you’re sitting down, it’s difficult
to position and hold the tablet comfortably while touching the screen. As a furniture designer,
Aaron could see that trying to lean an expensive device against legs or furniture could result in
slippage and damage. Surely there was a simple solution…

And the concept of the Padprop was born.

Aaron developed a prototype by cutting a flat foam kneeling pad – the kind often used by gardeners –
with a knife. He created a shape which fitted around both sides of the tablet, with a wider section
at the rear. Further iterations led Aaron to the best profile, and he realised that this really was
a solution to the problem of tablet comfort and slippage.

The next challenge was to find a manufacturer with a suitable skill set in finding and working the
best materials for the job.

> The next challenge was to find a manufacturer with a suitable skill set in finding and working the
> best materials for the job.

## **Our solution**

Aaron searched for an appropriate partner and got in touch with us to explore how we might work
together to develop his invention. It quickly became clear to Aaron that we would not only be able
to help him with defining the best materials, but we could source and produce the Padprop as well –
offering end-to-end support.

Our experience in polyurethane and [polyethylene foams][144], learned since our inception in 1989,
has helped us become market leaders in the European foam industry. Combined with the many different
conversion processes at our disposal, we were quickly able to recommend the most suitable grade
of [high-density foam][145] required to make the Padprop.

“Technical Foam Services quickly understood exactly what I was looking for and invested a
considerable amount of their time and energy into my project,” says Aaron.

## **How it worked**

From the outset, Aaron had a retail price in mind, and all our development work focused on ensuring
we remained within the unit budget. The entire development process took less than three months, by
which time full-scale prototypes were available for market evaluation.

As well as the developing and manufacturing of the product itself, we were also able to design the
Padprop’s packaging – including shelf-ready packaging, bags, artwork, bar-coding and shipping
cartons.

> Technical Foam Services quickly understood exactly what I was looking for and invested a
> considerable amount of their time and energy into my project.
> Aaron Bennett

## **The results**

Padprop was launched at the Gadget Show Exhibition at the NEC in Spring 2012. With a retail price of
£14.99, Aaron’s new product quickly became a must-have for many tablet owners. Fantastic reviews
from MacWorld, Essential Mac and Expert iPad vindicated Aaron’s belief that Padprop was indeed a
great solution to a common problem. Since then, the Padprop has gone on to be stocked by major
retailers, such as Marks & Spencer.

“Technical Foam Services clearly have really good knowledge of the global foam industry,” says
Aaron. “They were prepared to listen to my hopes and correlate these with what was actually
achievable, both in terms of quality and within budget. I would certainly recommend them for product
development within the foam industry.”

# *Case study:* Water filtration foams

> We always recommend Technical Foam Services to peers within our industry.

[water filter foam]

## The client

Manufacturer of domestic products

## **The challenge**

The company approached us to create a component in their water filter jug. A foam filter acted as a
pre-filter to catch larger sediments, before the water went into the main filter made from some
fibrous material. They needed someone to manufacture the foam element from a WRAS-approved foam –
the drinking water standard.

The enquiry went out into the marketplace.

We knew there were only a limited number of grades of the required foam that had been tested to this
standard. Unfortunately, none of these were appropriate.

> In recent years, our business in the development of water filtration technology has grown beyond
> expectation. Such rapid growth has only been achieved with the assistance of key partners,
> Technical Foam Services being such a partner.

## **Our solution**

We also knew that there were some air filtration foams of the right grade. The German manufacturer
said they had not had the foam WRAS-tested, but that we were welcome to do so if we paid for it. We
were confident the foam would pass, and so invested several thousand pounds to have it tested to
deliver to our client.

## **How it worked**

The air filtration foam passed the WRAS test and we began working with the German manufacturer and
our customer to produce their WRAS-approved water filter.

Yes, we foot the bill of the testing. It was the difference between winning the business or not;
helping our customer solve their problem or not.

> TFS’ technical knowledge supported by ability to produce engineered prototypes to a wide variety
> of designs, is very important to us.

## **The results**

The water filter is a high-volume product and sales are growing as we continue to work with this
customer.

“In recent years, our business in the development of water filtration technology has grown beyond
expectation. Such rapid growth has only been achieved with the assistance of key partners, Technical
Foam Services being such a partner.

“We use their in-depth knowledge of [reticulated foams][144] as a core feature within our daily
work, and their technical knowledge supported by ability to produce engineered prototypes to a wide
variety of designs, is very important to us. We value their input, mindful that such knowledge and
expertise does not seem to be available elsewhere within the foam industry.”

This is just one example of how we use our extensive knowledge of materials and the industry to
solve our customers’ problems with foam. This allows our customers to break new boundaries and be at
the forefront of innovation to maintain a competitive edge.

“We always recommend Technical Foam Services to peers within our industry.”

# Case studies

## Automotive Polishing Foam Sourcing Solutions

“Our company is a manufacturer of high-quality polishing liquids, some of which are applied using
polyurethane foam pads,” explains our client. They were importing some of their foam from America as
well sourcing some from us at Technical Foam Services – as their UK foam converter.

Read more » ][143] [

## Bath Sponge Foam

"In 2007, I invented a new type of bathing sponge, which was to be produced in a specific type of
soft polyurethane foam and shaped in a particular style. I approached several UK foam companies,
none of whom seemed to be interested in my product, until I spoke to Technical Foam Services. They
were fantastic right from the outset."

Read more » ][144] [

## High-End Headphones: Audio Foam

Our London based design agency is recognised as being a leader in the development of innovation
marketing products. We were recently appointed by a major UK electronics company, who commissioned
us to design, develop and set-up the supply chain for a new, audio headset, entailing the use of
foam ear-pads.

Read more » ][145] [

## Padprop – High-density foam tablet holder

Aaron recognised that the main problem with using portable tablet devices (such as iPads), was that
if the user was sitting down it was difficult to safely hold the tablet whilst touching the screen.

Read more » ][146] [

## Reticulated Foam Filters

The company was started by two engineers who left an iconic performance car brand to set up a
company providing high-performance air filters.

Read more » ][147] [

## SwimFin – Closed Cell Polyethylene Foam

Invented several years ago by Kevin Moseley, he identified that traditional swimming aids did not
actually teach the child who was learning to swim, how to swim properly with the correct posture.
Kevin had been a swimming instructor for many years, and he became increasingly frustrated with this
issue, so decided to resolve the problem himself.

Read more » ][148] [

## Water Filtration Foams

"In recent years our business in the development of water filtration technology, has grown beyond
expectation. Such rapid growth has only been achieved with the assistance of key partners, Technical
Foam Services being such a partner."

# Sustainability

Working with multiple stakeholders, The Vita Group continues to be at the vanguard of using lower
carbon and more sustainable alternative raw materials.

[Waterfall]

Our ambition is to lead the ESG agenda within our industry because we see operating more
sustainably, being a solid commercial partner, being a responsible employer and neighbour in the
communities in which we operate as being good for our customers, our employees and everyone that
interacts with The Vita Group.

Throughout The Vita Group’s 70-year history, we have proven that we are a catalyst for positive
change. Click on the below links to find out more about our ambitious targets.

bodies, universities and suppliers.

# *Case study:* High-End Headphones: Audio Foam

> During the design period, their advice was invaluable, saving us time and enabling is to develop a
> quality product at a commercial price.

[mr gorecki foam engineer]

## **The client**

High-end audio equipment manufacturer

## **The challenge**

DJ headphones pose a real challenge for manufacturers. Like all headphones, they must be comfortable
to wear for extended periods while having high noise-cancelling properties for use in loud
nightclubs and home studios.

As such, our client wanted to introduce a range of headphones that were very soft, but also had
sound-deadening foam.

Unfortunately, sound-deadening foam is high-density, and therefore heavy, firm and not soft. While
effective, it would be uncomfortable to have hard foam pressed against your ears for a long time.

The challenge was to come up with a low-density foam that effectively absorbed sound.

> The challenge was to come up with a low-density foam that effectively absorbed sound.

## **Our solution**

We spoke to our network of suppliers and identified a low-density polyurethane foam from a
specialist in the USA.

The foam had a consistent cell structure, which meant it effectively absorbed sound and was also
soft.

## **How it worked**

Our client explains: “Our decision to appoint Technical Foam Services was based on their knowledge
of suitable foam grades available from their global manufacturing partners, as well as their
in-house production conversion capability.

Our customer’s DJ headphones were soft and sound-deadening. They fit around the ears, killed
external sound and were covered with a permeable vinyl, so they could be wiped clean.

**“**During the design period, their advice was invaluable, saving us time and enabling is to
develop a quality product at a commercial price.”

> Our decision to appoint Technical Foam Services was based on their knowledge of suitable foam
> grades available from their global manufacturing partners, as well as their in-house production
> conversion capability.

## **The results**

As DJ headphones, they needed a professional spec and without our foam, they wouldn’t have met that.

At the time, our customer said: “This project was a great success and we will certainly work with
Technical Foam Services on any foam-based products in the future.”

And they have.

Since then, we have built a great working relationship based on trust, expertise and great
communication. Today we continue to work with the company on a number of products and components 10
years on.
