# *Case study:* SwimFin - Closed Cell Polyethylene Foam

[Kids swimming with SwimFin]

## **The client**

Kevin Moseley: a swimming instructor turned inventor

## **The challenge**

Kevin Moseley could see a problem with armbands. As a swimming instructor he saw that a child’s
armbands make them float upright, with their arms and head out of the water. The rest of their body
and their legs hang downwards – below the water – making it harder to swim, not easier.

Kevin got a swimming float, cut it up and glued it into a shape resembling a shark’s fin. He
strapped it around a child’s back and realised that the weight of the float actually suspended the
child horizontally. This meant that the child’s arms were free, and they could learn to swim in the
right position – horizontally. This was a much better way to teach kids to swim than with inflatable
armbands.

Kevin came to us and we made him some samples – a little neater than what he had done with a carving
knife in his kitchen.

He took the fin to the National Swimming Association, who instantly understood the concept. They
said: “If you can develop this product, we will happily recommend it to all UK swimming instructors”
– which number in the thousands. From that point on it became a valid business opportunity, as he
knew he had a product he could sell in volume.

> If you can develop this product, we will happily recommend it to all UK swimming instructors
> The National Swimming Association

[hydrophillic foams][hydrophillic foams]

## **Our solution**

Kevin needed to determine the best global manufacturing route. He contacted Technical Foam Services’
MD, Duncan Geddes, and the two began working together. Duncan advised Kevin throughout the start-up
process, helping determine the exact grade of [closed cell polyethylene foam][144] required
(EVA-based).

## **How it worked**

As well as materials, we worked to define the best way of manufacturing each fin. At the time, we
were working with a company in Taiwan that produced moulded closed-cell foam, so we flew out to talk
to them about Kevin’s new product. Working with the Taiwanese factory, we could see that a moulded
loop would be the best way to produce the fins.

With his knowledge of the retail sector, Duncan was also able to give Kevin useful information about
appropriate retail packing, logistics and online sales.

[SwimFin composed of Closed Cell Polyethylene Foam][SwimFin composed of Closed Cell Polyethylene
Foam]

## **The results**

SwimFin has been endorsed by the ASA (Amateur Swimming Association) in the UK and is the only
swimming aid to win their approval. The ASAs swimming experts have examined and tested SwimFin
and classed it as ‘an outstanding product worthy of accreditation’. SwimFin also complies with
life-jacket standards and international safety (ISO) regulations EN13138 and EN71.

SwimFin has won many awards, such as UK Trade and Investments Exports Awards, and continues to grow
year-on-year.

# *Case study:* Bath Sponge Foam

## The client

Leading household beauty brand

## **The challenge**

Our customer had a unique idea.

“In 2007, we invented a new type of bathing sponge, which was to be produced in a specific type of
soft polyurethane foam and shaped in a particular style,” he explains. “We approached several UK
foam companies, none of whom seemed to be interested in my product, until I spoke to Technical Foam
Services.”

He had invented a sponge with a bar of soap inside. As the sponge got wet, so did the soap, which
dissolved and filtered through the sponge as a lather. This ingenious invention eradicated the issue
of slippery soap, as well as grimy soap dishes.

## The challenge

There were three challenges.

The first was determining the right grade of foam with the right cell structure. The soap had to
dissolve and filter through the sponge in a controlled way. This latter point was essential, so the
sponge didn’t just become a soggy, soapy mess all at once.

The second was how to create a void inside the sponge.

The final challenge was how to get a piece of soap *inside* a sponge leaving no hole and without
using glue or stitches.

> We approached several UK foam companies, none of whom seemed to be interested in my product, until
> I spoke to Technical Foam Services.

## **Our solution**

First, our experts researched, defined and sourced a foam grade that would let the soapy lather pass
through in a controlled way.

The second challenge was harder. We worked out a way of inserting a milling tool through a slit in
the sponge to hollow it out without damaging the outer structure. We milled the middle of the sponge
and then held the hole open so that the excess material from inside could be vacuumed out.

And the third solution involved a clamp with a rope handle, which solved two problems: how to seal
the soap inside, and how to store your soapy sponge.

[Bath sponge foam][Bath sponge foam]

## **The results**

“Technical Foam Services were fantastic right from the outset. As soon as I contacted them, they
immediately sent samples of suitable foam grades and gave me expert advice as to what was practical
from a foam-converting perspective.

“They were also very useful in terms of general advice with the costing and margins of retail
products, as they had been a supplier to Tesco’s for many years.

“Finally, they guided me through the process of retail packaging, which was very helpful. My product
is now firmly established in some major retailers, and I am truly grateful for their support.

“I continue to enjoy a fruitful relationship with Technical Foam Services and would certainly
recommend them to any other budding inventor of a foam-based product.”

## 7 reasons we stand out

### Quality

Quality is of paramount importance.

Technical Foam Services is the first UK-based foam converter to be [awarded all three ISO
certificates][147], covering quality, occupational health and safety, and environmental management.
We’re dedicated to setting high standards within the industry and delivering great products to our
clients. Custom Foams is accredited to ISO9001:2015.

We place great emphasis on manufacturing products to our customers’ specifications and are proud of
our continuing high performance in this area. TFS has BSI certification for our ISO9001:2015 Quality
Management System, ISO14001:2015 Environmental Management System, and ISO45001:2018 Occupational
Health and Safety. Custom Foams is accredited to the ISO9001:2015 standard.

Technical Foam Services is also a first-tier rated supplier to Tesco.

Both factories are happy to co-operate with any audit your quality department may want to carry out.

### Range

We stock more than 400 different grades of high-quality foam, including polyurethane foams,
polyethylene foams and rubbers.

Our comprehensive range of foams is imported from manufacturers around the world. It is a range to
which we are always adding as we search for new, innovative and high-quality foam grades.

### Pricing

We strive for competitive pricing.

We recognise the need to keep our prices competitive so we have a streamlined business that
prioritises quality and expertise. We also keep your costs down through our long-standing
relationships with the foam manufacturers, which means our raw material costs remain stable.

### Expertise

Our 70 years of experience is at the heart of everything we do.

The combined expertise of our two factories in different types and grades of foam and rubber, plus
the wider support of The Vita Group, is the best available in the UK. We have the experience to
understand your foam conversion project, and can offer the best and impartial advice on raw
materials.

With an extensive range of foam-converting machinery in our factories, we can band-knife, die-cut,
slit, rout, mill, lathe, bore, drill, laminate, contour cut, print and emboss our foams and
rubbers..

### Flexibility

We keep high levels of stock, so you never have to wait long for your order. Our teams also work in
shifts, the factories are open for 18 hours a day which means we can turn around your urgent order.

We can deliver daily, weekly or monthly. If you offer a Kanban or consignment stock system in your
warehouse we can tailor our deliveries to your own system.

### Innovation

Some products need new machines to be made or customised, so we develop suitable machinery and
tooling within our own engineering department for your project.

### Passion

We love what we do – from developing your concept to the hands-on work of building your products.
We’ve never veered from our goal of delivering high-quality, high-tech solutions with no-nonsense
guidance at competitive prices for complete customer satisfaction.

# Expertise in foam materials

## Foam knowledge and engineering expertise

### Quick facts
* 400+ grades of foam
* Imported from leading global manufacturers within Europe, US and the Far East
* Includes Polyurethane, Polyethylene, Cellulose, Visco-elastic, Reticulated, Impregnated, Graphite
foam, EPDM, Neoprene, PVC and many more!
* We hold huge stocks at our Corby and Milton Keynes factories for immediate production and delivery
of finished products
* Our expertise is in foam materials, AND how to engineer and convert them for specific
applications.

## Foam range

Our range of foams is not only extensive, but because we hold large amounts of stock, all of these
are available today! This means you often do not need to wait for raw material to be ordered, to
fulfil your order.

Click here to visit the foam library to see our full range of foams.

[View full product range][144]

Our range includes:
* Polyester polyurethane foams
* Polyether polyurethane foams
* Reticulated foams
* Memory foams
* Pre-polymer foams
* Chipfoam
* Impregnated foams
* Polyethylene foams
* Plastazote foams
* Evazote foams
* Ethafoam
* Jiffycell foams
* EPDM rubber
* Neoprene rubber
* PVC nitrile
* Graphite foam

### Applications

While we can source and engineer foam for any application, we have particular experience in foam
conversion for the following markets:
* Acoustic
* Sport
* Medical
* Military
* Heavy industry
* European manufacturing
* Automotive
* Aviation

### Processes

As well as materials, we are able to execute a number of processes to build what you need. This
includes:
* Horizontal slitting
* Vertical knifing
* Peeling
* Laser-cutting
* Die-cutting
* Kiss-cutting
* Profiling
* Laminating
* Drilling
* Grinding
* Milling
* Sculpture cutting
* Coating
* Printing

### Other materials

Foam may not be the only material within your product, which is why we have developed expertise in
combining foam with the following materials:
* Plastics
* Wood
* Solid Rubber
* Metals
* Velour
* Brush nylon
* PVC
* Fabric
* Cardboard

## Foam knowledge + engineering expertise

With such a comprehensive range at your disposal, it is essential that customers work with a foam
converter who fully understands their needs – and quickly.

We do this by combining our extensive knowledge of foam, with high-level expertise in engineering.
For example, we have designed, commissioned, built and modified machines to create products beyond
the reaches of many of our competitors. We can cut foam to within 0.25 of a millimetre!

Our expert foam engineers know how to convert your foam into the solution you need. We recommend
solutions, quickly and at the right price.

[Technical Foam Services employee holding foam product][Technical Foam Services employee holding
foam product]

## Why we're different

### Stock, speed and price

A major part of our success as foam converters comes from our ability to turn new orders round
quickly, often because we hold such high levels of stock. This means we have access to the wide
range of grades produced by our sister foaming plants. As we are integrated within the foam
industry, we also have direct access to many unique grades. This in turn allows our customers to
benefit from the full range of materials, competitive prices as well as prompt delivery..

### Touch and feel

Once we have identified the right grade, we can send samples and specification sheets for your
approval. We know that foam and rubbers are tactile materials, our customers often like to see and
feel the grade we are recommending.

### Access to the supply chain

Our suppliers often rely on us to find new applications and customers for their materials, so for
some larger projects we create a three-way relationship between the foam block manufacturer, us and
yourself. We recognise the value in such open relationships, enabling all parties to have better
access to information, better solutions, and ultimately stronger long-term relationships throughout
the supply chain.

# Foam Manufacturing for Engine Filters

[engine filters]

When people discuss engine performance, they usually refer to valves and horsepower. But engines can
only work to their full capability if the motor is kept clean and the engine’s environment is
maintained at an optimum level. This is where advanced engine filter foams become essential.

As the UK’s leading engineering-based [foam manufacturer and converter][144], we produce an
extensive range of permanent and replaceable engine filter foams.

Our products are available in a wide range of pore sizes, shapes and densities, to meet the specific
needs of the automotive, rail and bus industries – from bus compressors to high-performance sports
cars.

## **Precision and High-Performance Engine Filter Foams**

Manufactured in reticulated polyurethane (PU) foam with a high-tensile strength and precise
homogenous cell size, our engine filter products provide a superior level of dust absorption and
airflow compared with other products such as paper and gauze.

Thanks to our commitment to quality and innovation, our foams are the preferred choice for many
leading global filter manufacturers.

## **Benefits of our Engine Filter Foams**

Our engine filters are engineered for maximum performance and durability. Key features include:
* **Oil Resistance**
* **Ageing Resistance**
* **Temperature and Thermal Oxidation Resistance**
* **Chemical and Contaminant Resistance**
* **UV and Light Resistance**
* **Weldability for Strong Joints**
* **Fire Retardancy** (meeting FMVSS302 and UL94 standards)

Additionally, we offer carbon-impregnated foams for advanced odour and gas filtration when required.

### **Extensive selection of Densities, Sizes & Colours**

Our engine filter foams are not only high-performing but also cost-effective. Unlike disposable
paper filters, they are washable and reusable, offering a sustainable solution for many industries.

We provide the widest range of options, including:
* Densities and pore sizes tailored to your application
* Colour options: black, white, red, blue, yellow
* A variety of shapes and configurations, including:
* Die-cut forms
* Egg-box profiles
* Sewn constructions
* Ultrasonically-welded cylinders

**Custom Engine Filter Foam Solutions**

At Technical Foam Services & Custom Foams, we don’t believe in a one-size-fits-all approach. Our
true strength lies in creating bespoke engine filter foams engineered to match your exact
requirements.

Our services include:
* Custom tooling and prototype development

* Global shipping and support

Whatever your engine filtration challenge, we have the expertise and technology to deliver a

## **FAQs About Foam Manufacturing for Engine Filters**

**Why is foam used in engine filters?******

Foam is highly effective in trapping dirt, dust and contaminants while maintaining excellent
airflow. Its washable and reusable nature also makes it more sustainable and cost-effective compared
to paper or gauze filters.

**Are foam engine filters better than paper filters?******

Yes. Foam engine filters typically offer superior airflow, better dust-holding capacity and longer
service life. They are also reusable after cleaning, reducing replacement costs and waste.

**Can I customise the pore size and density of my engine filter foam?******

At Technical Foam Services & Custom Foams, we offer a wide variety of pore sizes, densities, colours
and shapes to meet your precise filtration needs.

**What industries benefit from custom engine filter foams?******

Automotive, bus and coach, rail, industrial machinery, marine engines and even motorsport industries
benefit from our precision-engineered foam filters.

**How do I clean and maintain a foam engine filter?**

Foam engine filters can be cleaned with mild soap and water, allowed to dry fully and re-oiled if
required. Regular maintenance ensures maximum performance and longer life.

# High Density Foam Manufacturer

When high-value heavier products and equipment need to be transported, selecting the correct
[packaging foam][144] is vital to ensure both protection and impact absorption. In such situations,
a high density foam provides the optimum solution. These [closed-cell foams][145] combine heavy duty
performance, superior high load-bearing (HLB) capacity and impact protection, all in a lightweight,
thin foam.

[CONTACT US][146]

## Applications of High Density Foams
* **[Medical equipment][147]** – including cushions and supports.
* **Impregnated-barrier foam ** – for acoustic modifications and aircraft engine bays.
* **Upholstery** – including cinema seating and domestic furniture.
* **Memory foam mattresses** for a better night’s sleep.

## Our Leading High Density Foam Solutions

Due to the uniform cellular structure of closed cell and high density foams, the products we
manufacture provide a high level of protection that lasts. Flexible and durable, these materials
continue to provide a superior level of shock absorption over a sustained period, recovering from
the impact each time while still providing complete protection to the goods inside.

## High Density Foam FAQs

### What are the properties of high density foam?

High density foam is anti-static, which is particularly relevant in the packaging of electrical
goods and components as well as for products that will be transported by air. High density foam is
also flexible, enabling precision shaping and a custom fit to be achieved, even for the most complex
goods. It is UV, chemical and moisture resistant.

Closed cell, high density foams also provide complete protection that far exceeds mere shock
absorption. They are also [fire retardant][151], non-corrosive and totally odourless, thus providing
a completely safe and neutral environment for light, moisture and chemically sensitive objects.

### How long does high density foam last?

On average, lower density foam tends to last about 4-6 years, while medium and high density foams
last upwards of 8-10 years, depending on use and care. As well as lasting a long time, high density
foam is reusable and recyclable so it’s a more environmentally-friendly and cost-effective option
compared with other solutions.

This foam is perfect for re-usable transportation packaging, even for the likes of
moisture-sensitive electronic components and state-of-the-art medical and military equipment.

### What shapes can be made in high density foam?

We are able to produce high density packaging foams in an array of sizes and shapes to meet the
precise requirements of a wide spectrum of applications. Take a look at our [product design
page][152] for further details.

### Who are the most recognised high density foam manufacturers?

While Technical Foam Services do not manufacture foam, we source and convert foams into finished
products, so we might be the solution to your problem – especially if you’re looking to develop an
idea or want a finished product that includes high-density foam. By using us instead of a
manufacturer, we can guide you on what foam you might need, rather than just sell you what you think
you need.

As the leading UK-based manufacturer and converter of high density protective packaging foams, we
stock a wide range of HLB high density foams in the most advanced closed-cell, cross-linked
polyethylene materials, including [Plastazote][153], Evazote and Alveolit. We also stock closed cell
high density foam. Why not give us a call today and we can discuss your specific needs.

# Hi-Fi Speaker Fronts & Speaker Foams

To many, Hi-Fi speaker foams are nothing more than a cover to keep the dust out. But in reality,
quality speaker fronts play an essential role in reducing unwanted noise and vibration while
maintaining and enhancing the acoustic performance.

As such, speaker front foams are complex products manufactured from specific acoustically
transparent foam materials, which are then processed to provide a precise fit and optimum
performance.

As the [major UK-based manufacturer][144] of precision engineered [audio foams][145] for the global
speaker foam sector, we offer the widest choice in terms of materials and performance capabilities.

## Leading Speaker Front & Foam Solutions

While there are many suppliers of Hi-Fi speaker foams around, what truly sets us apart from other
manufacturers is our unrivalled [engineering capabilities][146], which enable us to produce custom
products to meet even the most stringent of specifications.

With an [in-house engineering department][147], we have the experience, equipment and processing
systems in place to be able to produce a vast range of Hi-Fi speaker foams in an array of different
sizes, densities and patterns, from plain through bevelled and striped to criss-cross markings.

Furthermore, with a profound understanding of the necessary characteristics required in acoustically
transparent speaker fronts, if we don’t have the exact equipment required, our expert engineers will
design and manufacture bespoke tooling to meet your individual needs. We can then produce prototypes
and carry out testing to ensure we have created the optimal product for your needs before
manufacturing commences.

With [state-of-the art UK facilities][148], we can produce Hi-Fi speaker foam goods in almost any
conceivable shape or size, from the smallest of portable goods to large surround sound systems.

## Bespoke Audio Foam Solutions

As a recognised world leader in engineering-based audio foam products, the majority of the Hi-Fi
speaker foams that we supply are made to our customers’ own specific designs. In such a competitive
market, this means that the goods we supply are not only perfect in terms of pore size, pitch and
audio performance, but they also remain unique to that particular client.

Where required, we can also supply Hi-Fi speaker fronts complete with printed branding and logos,
thus providing an unrivalled service from design through to delivery.

With a global customer base in this sector, we understand the importance of confidentiality, and
will never release our customers’ bespoke designs onto the open market without their knowledge and
consent.

## **The finer details**

We not only excel in terms of our engineering and service, we also offer the widest choice in terms
of the materials we can supply.

As an established business we have superb relationships with the leading audio foam raw material
suppliers, so we can offer a vast range of acoustically transparent polyester foams covering the
spectrum of pore sizes, densities and even colours.

Lightweight and compact, the shipping costs involved in transporting Hi-Fi speaker foams are in no
way prohibitive and as a result of this and our unrivalled reputation, we export our products all
over the world.

# Foam Ink Pad Manufacturers

From crafts to commercial documents, ink pads for stamps and ink jet printers are used in a vast
range of environments, all of which demand precision performance to ensure the optimum level of
print reproduction.

Many end-users may believe that the foam used in ink-pads is just an absorbent material, which acts
as a reservoir. However, ink-pads are in fact highly sophisticated products, developed to enable
accurate ink handling and distribution – thus ensuring picture perfect results on every
application.

We lead the way in ink pad technology, where homogeneity and exactitude are vital, developing
bespoke solutions for many of the world’s leading names.

## **Precision Ink Pad Manufacturing**

As recognised UK-based leaders in [precision-engineered foam solutions][144], our technical
expertise plays a critical role in the ink pad sector where there is no margin for error when it
comes to density and pore size.

With a vast inventory of [superior quality compressed foams][145] in reticulated polyester and
polyether materials, we can supply ink pad foams spanning the full spectrum of densities and pore
sizes, ranging from just 30kg/m³ coarse cell 60ppi, to the highest density of 350kg/m³ with a fine
cell of 110ppi.

## Custom Foam Solutions

We develop and manufacture ink pad foam products to offer the optimum performance in terms of ink
storage capacity, handling and distribution to meet the bespoke requirements of each application.
All of which offer:
* Optimal void volume based on the specific application to enable precise ink storage capacity in
each ink pad
* Precise and uniform open-cell size to guarantee even distribution
* Narrow tolerance limits
* Completely lint-free reproduction

With a wealth of experience in this field, we also understand the importance of manufacturing foam
ink pads in a contaminant-free environment. With [established protocols in place][146] we produce
our inkpad products in a completely clean environment thus ensuring that they never come into
contact with contaminants that could react with substrates during the printing process.

## **Unmatched commitment to quality**

With [unrivalled equipment][147] and a [team of in-house engineers][148] we can produce bespoke
tooling to manufacture ink pad solutions tailored specifically for your individual needs, we can
produce custom products to meet your exact specifications in virtually any shape, size, porosity and
density imaginable.

From simple die-cut shapes to state-of-the-art 3D CNC cutting, uncoated foams to filmic-coated
products to enable smoother insertion into the cartridge, we pride ourselves on supplying bespoke
ink pad solutions that meet the precise needs of each and every customer.

If you would like to know more about our wide range of ink pad foam grades and products, or you
would like to discuss your individual requirements, please [contact our technical team.][149]

# **Foam Insert Manufacturer**

From protection to presentation, foam inserts are essential components in the packaging industry for
manufacturers, retailers and businesses. The exact size, density and grade of foam inserts can vary
significantly depending on the purpose of the insert.

**Foam inserts** are relied upon to ensure delicate and fragile items are safely secured in transit,
with bespoke shaping minimising vibration and movement to prevent irreversible damage. For end
customers, bespoke display cases, boxes and packaging foams can greatly influence perceived value
and brand experience. The colour, porosity and finishing of foam inserts help to present products in
the best light, thus encouraging consumers to purchase them.

At Technical Foam Services, we can provide the ideal solution for your foam insert requirements that
meets your needs perfectly, in terms of size, quantity, shape, materials and, importantly, your
budget. Whether you require thousands of inserts for earring displays or luxury ring boxes, or
bespoke flight case inserts for camera, audio or laboratory equipment, we have the expertise and
solutions to suit your needs.

### **Custom Foam Insert Enquiries:**

Our foam conversion specialists are available to discuss your foam insert requirements. From product
design and prototyping to full-scale manufacturing services backed by our in-house engineering
department we tailor our services to your precise needs.

## Foam Insert FAQs

### Can you cut foam inserts to size?

Yes, we are able to develop and produce foam products in any shape or size, allowing us to meet even
the most detailed of specifications and ensure the ideal fit and level of protection for your needs.

Using custom inserts will allow both easy access and hold items securely. With our [in-house
expertise][153] and extensive foam knowledge, we enjoy collaborating with our clients to solve
problems and help to produce the ideal solutions.

### What materials are used to make foam inserts?

To ensure we can create the ideal insert, we produce die-cut foam from both open-cell polyurethane
and water jet cut closed-cell polyethylene.

Find out more about the differences between open-cell and closed-cell foams [here][154].

### What are the main uses of foam inserts?

Most commonly, foam inserts are used to secure items in hard cases or packages and protect them
while they are in storage or being transported. Depending on the material used, inserts can also
help to protect goods from extremes of temperature. Other uses can include display boxes for
delicate items or jewellery.

### Do you supply black foam inserts?

Dedicated to supplying high performance goods that meet our customers’ precise specifications, we
are one of the few foam manufacturers that can convert and supply black foam inserts.

While many foam manufacturers are only able to offer the more readily available dark grey inserts,
we can supply grey and black die-cut foam inserts in both polyurethane and polyethylene varieties.

# Fire Retardant Foams

As the [leading engineering-biased foam converter][144] in the UK, we understand there is far more
to converting foam than just precision cutting and forming. In some applications, the foam must not
only be a perfect fit, it must also comply with all the stringent fire safety standards.

At Technical Foam Services and Custom Foams, we manufacture and supply a wide selection of fire
retardant foams and products. Our fire retardant foams are made using non-burning polyurethane and
melamine based materials that meet globally recognised standards, such as. FMVSS302, UL94 HF1 and
Class O (including black Pyrosorb and Basotect foams) These fire resistant foams are widely used
across sectors such as:
* Building and construction
* Automotive and transportation
* Industrial Machinery (e.gcompressors and generators)
* Furniture
* Bedding

Each product is tested and certified to meet demanding flame retardant regulations, to give you
confidence in safety and compliance.

## **Building a safe environment with Fire Retardant Foams**

[Class O foams ][145]are a key solution in the building and construction industry where both g noise
reduction and non-flammable properties are essential. These high performance fire retardant foams
are ideal for:

* HVAC linings
* Ceiling tiles
* Wall panels
* Suspended sound absorbers

Thanks to their sound absorption, thermal insulation and fire-resistant capabilities, these foams
contribute to safer and quieter indoor environments.

## **Our Fire Retardant Foam Solutions**

We stock both [polyurethane][146] and melamine Class O rated foams to offer customers the optimal
product to meet their specific needs and budget.

Our polyurethane Class O fire rated foam products are manufactured from black Pyrosorb, which are
easily cut for a perfect fit and are incredibly durable and fire retardant.

We are also a leading supplier of Basotect melamine Class O rated foam products, which are
recognised for their outstanding flame resistance and fire retardancy. These products do not melt or
drip when exposed to flames. Combined with their lightweight structure, they are a popular choice
for products such as ceiling tiles and wall panels.

As well as supplying custom cut and shaped fire retardant foams, including profiled products and
pyramid tiles, we also manufacture UL 94 and Class O foams with coatings and composites such as oil
dispersing and heat reflecting coatings, foil and film-based composites, aluminium sheet
inter-layers and self-adhesive backing.

## Your Trusted Custom Foam Specialists

[Contact us][147] today to discuss your fire retardant foam requirements.

## **Fire Retardant Foam FAQs**

**What is fire retardant foam?******

Fire retardant foam is a material treated to resist fire and slow its spread, made from materials
like polyurethane or melamine that meet safety standards.

**What are the benefits of fire retardant foam?******

It helps prevent fire spread, provides sound and thermal insulation, and meets safety regulations,
making it ideal for various industries.

**How does fire retardant foam work?******

It slows combustion, preventing flames from spreading quickly, and some foams are designed not to
melt or drip when exposed to heat.

**What industries use fire retardant foams?******

Industries like construction, automotive, furniture, bedding and machinery use fire retardant foams
for safety, insulation and noise reduction.

**What are the fire safety standards for fire retardant foams?******

Our foams meet standards like FMVSS302, UL94 HF1 and Class O, ensuring compliance with fire safety
regulations.

**Are your fire retardant foams customisable?******

Yes, we offer custom cutting, shaping and coating options to suit your specific needs.

**What is the difference between polyurethane and melamine-based fire retardant foams?******

Polyurethane foams are durable and easy to cut, while melamine foams are lightweight, highly
flame-resistant and ideal for high-performance applications.

# Ethafoam Supplier

Ethafoam is a versatile closed-cell [polyethylene foam][144] known for its durability, flexibility
and exceptional shock absorption. Available in a range of densities, Ethafoam is most commonly used
for bespoke packaging where its shock absorbing and cushioning properties are vital.

Thanks to its moisture resistance and being impervious to most chemicals, mildew and rot, Ethafoam
is also ideal for protecting and preserving delicate, valuable, or sensitive items.

[CONTACT US to discuss your Ethafoam requirements.][145]

## Applications of Ethafoam

As a trusted ethafoam supplier, we provide versatile solutions across a range of industries,
including:
* **[Packaging][146]** – including cushioned protection and shock absorption
* Electronics – including antistatic properties which can be further enhanced for use in the
protection of electrical goods
* Buoyancy – including use in personal floatation devices (PFDs) and life jacket applications
* Preservation – including the storage and packing of delicate, sensitive or historic items due to
its water resistance and impervious properties

## **Our Ethafoam Manufacturing Solutions**

We’re expert Ethafoam manufacturers and boast an advanced understanding of its suitability for
different applications. Thanks to years of expertly converting Ethafoam and other closed-cell foams,
we’re highly experienced in finding the ideal, bespoke solution for your business.

Choose us for high quality Ethafoam conversion by specialist foam engineers. We stock sheets and
rolls of Ethafoam in our warehouse, ready to be shaped, repurposed and delivered to you, all within
an impressive turnaround time.

## Ethafoam FAQs

**What is Ethafoam?**

Ethafoam is the trade name for non-cross-linked, closed-cell polyethylene foam. It is a durable foam
that has a wide range of uses due to its flexibility, shock absorption and impervious properties.

**Is Ethafoam waterproof?**

The closed-cell structure of Ethafoam makes it moisture resistant and impervious to most types of
chemical, however, the density of the foam will affect whether it is waterproof or not. Higher
density Ethafoam will achieve improved waterproof properties.

**What densities do you offer in Ethafoam?**

We offer Ethafoam in a variety of densities and can manufacture it in a range of strengths and
thicknesses to suit the specific needs of your business too. It’s because of this versatility that
Ethafoam can be tailored for its protective properties, and can be used in the packaging of
lightweight, delicate items right up to intricate heavier pieces.

# **Foam Laminated Fabric Solutions for Protection and Presentation**

At Technical Foam Services and Custom Foams, we create foam laminated fabric inserts that do more
than just protect your products. They help to market them by making them stand out. We offer a wide
choice of colours and finishes which makes it easy to deliver the complete package when it comes to
presentation, protection and brand appeal – but a little harder to make a decision.

[fabric faced foams][fabric faced foams]

## **Quality Laminated Foam That Looks the Part and Does the Job**

By bonding high quality fabrics – usually brushed nylons – to the foam before cutting, we can
produce laminated foam case inserts that offer practicality, performance and visual appeal. It’s a
great way to give your packaging a polished look while staying true to your brand.

We offer a full spectrum of colours, from pastels to vibrant tones. We appeal to consumers across a
huge range of markets, so whether you’re packaging baby products, natural skincare, high-tech gear
or luxury goods, there’s a shade and style to suit your audience and help your brand shine.

### Not just a pretty face: Our commitment to quality

Our fabric faced foam inserts are built for more than just their good looks, they are built to
perform. Every product is made with quality and durability in mind, whether that’s a classic black
insert or colourful custom finish.

We don’t believe in cutting corners. You’ll always get a product that not only looks the part but
delivers reliable protection where it matters most.

### Made Just for You

Need something specific? We can tailor our foam laminated fabric to suit your exact needs. From soft
open-cell polyurethane to heavy-duty high impact absorbing closed cell polyethylene foams we can
produce fabric faced foams to meet your exact requirements. In terms of the protection needed for
the product you are packaging and your budget – we got you covered.

We also offer moisture-resistant and fire-retardant options. And thanks to our in-house engineering
team, we can design and manufacture completely bespoke inserts in any shape or size, whether you
need one piece or thousands.

# Engineered Foam

Both lightweight and incredibly strong, engineered foam is used for a wide range of industries
thanks to its affordability, versatility and ease of manipulation for even the most complicated
projects.

Engineered foam is typically made from polystyrene, flexible polyurethane or polyethylene, available
in a range of densities, colours and sizes. These adaptable materials make them ideal for
applications ranging from insulation sheets, to bespoke packaging for protecting delicate items,
such as electronics – offering excellent scratch and vibration protection.

Other common uses include:
* Car polishing pads
* Industrial sponges
* Filter elements
* Sanding pads
* Microphone windshields

With the expert support of our leading foam engineers, your engineered foam project is always in
safe hands.

[CONTACT US][144]

## **CAD, CAM & CNC in Foam Manufacturing**

The ‘engineered’ element refers to the material’s ability to be intricately shaped to a client’s
specific requirements.

The techniques we use include:
* CAD (Computer-Aided Design)
* CAM (Computer-Aided Manufacturing)
* CNC (Computer Numerical Control) Machining
* Waterjet Cutting

This exceptional versatility and ease of manufacture means that complicated shapes can be produced
at a range of densities, affordably and with a short lead-in time.

[**Contact Us**** to discuss your foam engineering project.**][145]

## **Applications of Engineered Foams**
* Automotive – for components including headrests
* Construction – including insulated floor and wall panels
* Packaging – protective packaging for transport and storage of fragile items
* Filters – for the construction of filter elements

## Engineered Foam FAQs

**What are the key properties of engineered foam?******

Engineered foam offers a unique combination of properties such as insulation, buoyancy, flexibility,
durability, and filtration efficiency.

**What are the benefits of engineered foam?******

Some of the main benefits of using engineered foam include:
* The wide range of structural properties available (densities, finishes, colours)
* Low cost
* Tooling and finishing are simple, making complex shapes achievable.
* Recyclable

**What types of foam is engineered foam made from?**

Common materials include flexible polyurethane (FPU), polyethylene (PE), polystyrene (EPS), expanded
polypropylene (EPP) and expanded polyethylene (EPE).

**Are engineered foams eco-friendly?**

Yes. Both polyurethane and polyethylene foams can be recycled, helping reduce environmental impact.

# EVA Foam Supplier

EVA foam, or Ethylene-vinyl acetate copolymer foam, is a highly-versatile thermoplastic elastomer
which is used across a variety of industries. Its flexibility, durability and resilience make it a
reliable alternative to materials like rubber, polyurethane and PVC foam.

The closed-cell structure of EVA foam provides excellent impact absorption and long-term resistance,
making it ideal for a wide range of applications. With its ability to recover quickly from
compression and maintain its shape over time, EVA foam is a smart choice for both functional and
creative projects.

[CONTACT US][144]

## EVA Foam Applications
* [**Medical Use**][145] – Resistant to chemicals and biocompatible, making it ideal for medical
applications.
* [**Retail products**][146] – Used in flotation boards and children’s swimming aids, due to its
buoyancy and UV resistance.
* **Sports footwear** – Provides shock absorption during athletic activities.
* **Cosplay** – A key favourite for cosplay projects due to its versatility and ease of working.

### Custom EVA Foam Solutions

We supply EVA foam in various densities, colours and formats, including sheets, mats, blocks and
tiles.

Our selection includes the Zote range of PE and EVA foams, which offer cell sizes ranging from
0.3-0.5mm and meet rigorous industry standards:

BS EN ISO 7214:2012
BS EN ISO 8067:2008
BS EN ISO 868:2003
ISO 2896:2001
In addition, we offer EVA copolymers from other manufacturers, allowing us to tailor material
selection to your specific project requirements.

## **Advantages of EVA Foam Over Other Materials**

EVA foam stands out when compared to alternative materials such as rubber and polyurethane. Some key
benefits include:

* Lightweight Yet Durable – Strong enough for industrial use while remaining lightweight.
* Water & Moisture Resistance – Ideal for outdoor and marine applications.
* Shock Absorption – Provides excellent impact resistance for protective gear and packaging.
* Temperature Resilience – Performs well in both hot and cold environments.

### Why choose us?

Expertise in Foam Materials – Extensive industry knowledge to recommend the right solutions.
Bespoke Foam Design & Development – Support from concept to production.
High-Quality Solutions – Precision manufacturing, competitive pricing, and customer satisfaction
guaranteed.
Sustainable & Safe – We provide eco-friendly, non-toxic EVA foam solutions.

[CONTACT US][147]

## EVA Foam FAQs

### What are the key properties of EVA Foam?

The popularity of EVA foam is down to the wide range of properties it holds, allowing it to be an
alternative to a wide range of materials. The key benefits include:
* Strength and durability
* UV resistance
* Water resistance and buoyancy
* Chemical resistance
* Vibration absorption

### How easy is EVA foam to work with for cosplay?

In addition to being lightweight and inexpensive, EVA foam is incredibly easy construction material
to work with. It can be cut, shaped, sanded, engraved and heat moulded to fit even the most complex
[props, costume and cosplay projects][148]. For beginners, a heat gun, paint and a craft knife could
be all you need!

Due to its durability, EVA foam can withstand stress without cracking, which is ideal in both the
production and wearing of costumes. Once the pieces are cut, decoration will be aided by the fact
that EVA takes colour well and can be engraved or detailed.

Are EVA Foams eco-friendly?

Yes. EVA foams are non-toxic and BPA free, meaning they are considered to be safer and more
eco-friendly than many alternative materials.

### How long do EVA foams last?

EVA foam can last in excess of 10 years, dependent on storage and application.

In ideal conditions with no wear and tear, the material could last decades without showing signs of
degradation.

# Egg Crate Foam Supplier

Choosing the right packaging medium is vital for OEMs and suppliers to make sure products arrive
safely at their destination. Damaged goods not only cause financial losses for the manufacturer, but
also lead to customer dissatisfaction and a damaged reputation. When transporting irregularly shaped
items, standard packaging materials often fail to provide adequate protection.

This is where egg crate foam packaging excels. With its unique convoluted design, egg crate foam
sheets offer superior cushioning and impact protection compared to flat foam or alternative
packaging materials. Whether used for egg box foam packaging or protective inserts, this
high-performance solution is ideal for a vast range of applications.

[CONTACT US][144]

## **Applications of Egg Crate Foam**
* **Protective Packaging** – Ideal for securing non-standard shaped items during transit.
* **Hard Cases & Storage** – Minimises movement within storage containers, preventing damage.
* [**Egg Box Soundproofing**][145] – Used in domestic and commercial settings for noise absorption.
* **Comfort & Domestic Use** – Including mattress toppers for improved comfort and support.

[Egg box profiler machinery]

## **Our Egg Crate Foam Solutions**

We manufacture and supply egg crate foam sheets using high-cushioning, open-cell polyurethane foam.
This design consists of continuous peaks and troughs, increasing surface area and enhancing shock
absorption. As a result, even fragile and uniquely shaped goods remain securely in place, reducing
the risk of damage.

As leading UK-based engineering foam manufacturers, Technical Foam Services and Custom Foams offer a

## Egg Crate Foam FAQs

### What is egg crate foam?

In addition to its protective and impact absorption properties, egg crate foam is also soft and
non-abrasive thus providing the perfect packaging solution for even the most delicate and sensitive
goods. As a result, it is often the material of choice for packaging electronic goods and components
and other technical equipment.

Our egg crate packaging foams are a lightweight, flexible and cost-effective packaging solution, and
are available in a wide range of grades, densities and profile shapes; therefore, we can ensure that
we can always provide the optimum grade to meet your exact needs for a wide variety of packaging
applications.

### How should egg crate foam be used?

Egg crate foam is often used in a “sandwich” solution, whereby products are packed between two
sheets of egg crate foam. The protective surface interlocks around the product to improve stability
and reduce movement even further, thus providing a flexible wall of protection that literally
envelops the goods.

### Can you provide a bespoke packaging solution?

With our outstanding [in-house engineering capabilities][153] and profound understanding of the
performance levels of different foam grades and densities, we can produce bespoke egg crate foam
packaging solutions to meet your precise criteria and requirements.

Based on the products for which you require a packaging solution, our expert in-house technical
staff can specify the optimum egg crate foam for your needs in terms of thickness, density and the
level of profiling. Our engineers can then, where necessary, design and manufacture bespoke tooling
to produce profiled egg crate foam that meets your exact needs in terms of shape and size.

## FAQs

### What is polyethylene foam?

Polyethylene (PE) foam is a lightweight yet durable material. PE foam has a closed-cell structure,
meaning it is formed from tiny bubbles which are closed off from each other. This structure gives
the foam its buoyancy, as well as making it ideal for shock absorption, cushioning and even
insulation uses.

### What is crosslinked polyethylene foam?

Polyethylene foam comes in either physically or chemically cross-linked versions. Physically
crosslinked PE foam has naturally occurring bonds, whereas chemically crosslinked polyethylene has
bonds that form under heat or pressure. Chemical crosslinking tends to offer a foam with increased
strength and durability.

### Is PE foam waterproof?

Polyethylene foam is moisture-resistant due to its closed-cell structure. However, only high-density
PE foam is considered fully waterproof.

### Is PE foam flammable?

Flammability depends on density and treatment. Lower-density PE foam is more flammable, while
high-density versions or those treated with flame retardants offer better heat resistance.

# Medical Foams Manufacturer

Developing, processing and manufacturing foams for [medical applications][144] is a specialised
field with many factors to consider – including performance, bio-compatibility, sterilisation and
the potential for skin irritation.

With over two decades’ experience of supplying a wide range of medical grade foams, we have an
outstanding reputation in the production of sterilised PVA, reticulated polyurethane (PU) and
hydrophilic foams for a varied range of medical applications.

[CONTACT US][145]

## Applications of Medical Foams
* [**HME Foams**][146] – heat and moisture exchange foams for medical application
* [**Wound Dressing Foam**][147] – for hydrophilic dressings, PVA foams and negative pressure wound
dressings
* [**Hydrophilic Foam**][148] – for wound, anti-scar and post-operative dressings
* [**Rubber Foams**][149] – including neoprene for medical supports and braces
* [**PVA Foams**][150] – for specialist medical wound treatment products

## Our range of medical foam solutions

Our medical foams are available in a range of colours and densities, whether you need [durable
neoprene rubber][151] for medical supports or soft hydrophilic wound dressings. We can provide a
variety of sterilised foam supplies for any medical or scientific field, such as sterilised foam
saliva swabs. We cater our products to fit your needs, ensuring that you receive the highest quality
products for the job.

Used in a range of filter applications, we produce specialised heat and moisture exchange (HME)
foams in both dry and calcium chloride impregnated forms. We can also supply composite HME foams
with additional oxygen permeability, bacterial barriers and fluid management. If required, we can
even develop a new [specialised grade of HME foam][152] to ensure you receive the best foam product
for your project.

In addition to [wound dressings][153] and HME foams, we also develop and manufacture a multitude of
other medical foam products, such as splints and supports. We are committed to developing,
processing and manufacturing medical foams which can be specified for various needs.

With a great understanding of the standard required for medical foam applications, Technical Foam
Services is the ideal partner for all of your medical foam requirements. So, whether you need
medical foams for performance or skin irritation, or sterilised foam and bi-compatibility foam
products, we can help.

## Medical Foam FAQs

### Why is medical-grade HME foam useful?

Manufactured in medical grade [reticulated polyurethane (PU)][157], heat and moisture exchange (HME)
foam is produced by blowing the cells open to a consistent and exact size. This is one of the
reasons that HME foams are ideal for use in medical breathing and anaesthesia equipment and systems,
and are a vital component for controlled oxygen and gas intake.

### What makes PVA foam suitable for medical applications?

[PVA foam][158] is commonly used in wound dressings due to a wide range of beneficial properties.
When damp, PVA foams are flexible and absorbent, helping to remove moisture and bacteria from a
wound. Once dried, they become more rigid. This means they both help to protect and are easy to
remove.

### What is medical grade polyurethane?

Polyurethane is used in a wide range of medical applications including tubing, bedding and
dressings. Due to its high strength, durability and ease to work with, new medical applications
continue to be found for the material as an alternative to both silicone and metals.

Medical polyurethane also benefits from bio-compatibility, making it ideal for use in the creation
of implants.

## Cellulose Sponge FAQs

### What shapes can be cut in cellulose sponge?

Cellulose foam is a versatile foam product, suitable for manufacturing to a vast range of shapes. We
have the ability to manufacture and supply custom cellulose foam products to a range of densities
and shapes, from traditional square mop sponges to intricately shaped products.

We can cut cellulose sponges to any 2D outline you require. From squares, footballs and hearts to
animals, ovals and circles, we are able to manufacture custom shaped cellulose foam goods with
precision and affordability.

We can also apply a four-colour print to the surface to enable you to get your message across in an
innovative and vibrant way, making cellulose sponge the ideal platform for branded and promotional
items. Promotional cellulose sponge products can come in branded packaging where desired.

### Is cellulose sponge eco-friendly?

Because our cellulose sponge solutions are produced from natural materials, they are fully
biodegradable as well as being lightweight, compact and versatile.

### What is compressed cellulose sponge?

Compressed sponges are also known as expanding, swelling or pop-up sponges. They are formed using
dry cellulose foam which is compressed under high pressure and heat.

Because compressed cellulose sponges are much smaller in volume than standard cellulose sponge, our
compressed products take up far less space in transit and on the shop shelf. However, once immersed
in water, they return to their original size, offering the same level of performance to the
end-user.

### Is cellulose sponge appropriate for marketing assets?

In recent years, with the development of compressed cellulose sponge, the possibilities for using
these materials in promotional and marketing products have expanded enormously. Lightweight and
small in volume, cellulose foam sponge is the perfect low-cost, high-impact medium on which to
advertise a range of products and brands.

# Audio Foams

[audio foams][audio foams]

To the uninitiated, audio foams are little more than aesthetic items that are used to cover
microphones, headsets and speakers. In actuality, audio foams perform a vital role in shaping the
quality of music/audio consumption and recording.

From [blocking unwanted noise][144] and vibrations to ensuring the transmission of sound across the
frequency spectrum, audio foams are integral to our relationship with music and audio.

At Technical Foam Services and Custom Foams we produce and convert an extensive range of high
standard foams for music and audio applications. Our technical expertise, product prototyping
services, and state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities enable us to deliver a true end-to-end
solution for your audio foam requirements.

As the leading UK-producer of specialist acoustic and audio foams, we supply some of the world’s
largest brands in the professional recording, music consumption and audio equipment industries.

### **Audio Foam Enquiries**

From CNC turning for precision foam manufacturing to an extensive library of audio foams in ranging
foam porosities and densities, we have the experience, expertise and solutions to deliver bespoke
audio foam products and components.

Our audio foam specialists work with you to select the most appropriate foams and manufacturing
processes to deliver high-quality, cost-effective solutions to your product design, budget and
volumes.

**[Contact our specialist team today to discuss your foam product development requirements.][145]**

## Audio Foam Applications

We have an enviable reputation as the leading UK-based [producer of specialist audio foams][146] for
music recording, consumption and audio equipment. Equipped with full-scale CNC lathe, milling and
sculpting machinery, we are able to respond to high-volume, high-complexity and time-sensitive audio
foam manufacturing with ease and unrivalled affordability.

We supply a wide range of stock and bespoke audio foam products across the globe. Our product
development expertise include:
* [Microphone windshields][147]
* Speaker foam covers
* Ear defender mufflers
* Headset ear cushions
* Acoustic foam windscreens
* [Foam audio speaker fronts][148]
* Sound meter mufflers

At Technical Foam Services, we are committed to delivering high-quality, high-tech foam solutions
with 100% satisfaction to all of our customers. We build close working relationships with our
customers, developing novel, bespoke solutions to your precise needs, every time. For specific,
specialised audio foam requirements, contact our team today to discover how our foam conversion
solutions can support you.

[Explore Acoustic Foam Products][149]

## **Audio Foams: Custom manufactured to meet your needs**

Depending on the function of the music/audio equipment, specific characteristics of audio foams may
be required to maximise suitability for their intended purpose; microphone windshields/pop-shields,
speaker fronts, headphone ear cushions and foam liners all require different levels of noise
isolation and insulation to influence the quality of audio consumption and recording.

We supply and convert an unrivalled collection of audio grade foams, with a range of polyester audio
foams available in precise pore sizes and densities to your product and component requirements. Our
products ensure the highest standard of performance and quality for each specific situation with no
sound distortion.

From design and product prototyping to full-scale foam engineering services, we simplify your
product development, delivering end-to-end foam conversion solutions to your exact volume, budget

# **Acoustic Soundproofing Domestic Foam**

Acoustic soundproofing foam performs an essential role in the construction of domestic and
residential properties. From semi-detached and terrace houses to flats and apartments, acoustic
insulation foam is a vital component of residential insulation that helps to maintain peace and
privacy from neighbours and external sources of noise.

At Technical Foam Services and Custom Foams we are equipped with the expertise and product
portfolio to design, manufacture, and supply custom soundproofing foam products for domestic
acoustic insulation and noise dampening.

We manufacture both [**polyurethane**][144] and [**melamine foams**][145] which meet FMVSS302 or
UL94 HF1 and [**Class 0 fire-retardant grades**][146]. We also supply many composite forms including
oil dispersing, heat reflecting, foil and film-based mixtures, as well as with self-adhesive backing
and aluminium sheet inter-layers where required.

### **Domestic Acoustic Soundproofing Foam Enquiries**

Whether you require acoustic treatment solutions for a new residential development or for an
existing building, we can create tailored acoustic treatment solutions for your residential property
requirements.

[**Contact our specialist team today to discuss your acoustic treatment requirements.**][147]

## **Domestic Soundproofing Foam Applications**

Acoustic treatment and soundproofing foams can be installed for a range of purposes in domestic and
residential properties. From wall, ceiling and floor treatment to reduce noise transmission between
homes to soundproofing of residential utilities such as HVAC systems and generator and compressor
rooms, the exact soundproofing foam requirements of domestic properties may vary significantly per
application.

At Technical Foam Services, we ensure our foams provide high-performance sound and vibration
absorption, and adhere to noise pollution and fire-retardation regulations. These include solutions
developed specifically for:
* Wall panels
* Roofing panels
* Ceiling panels and tiles
* Door panels
* Flooring solutions
* HVAC systems
* Ducts lining and pipes
* Generator and compressor rooms
* Home cinemas
* Office panels and screens
* Making the grade

The specific requirements of each soundproofing and acoustic treatment project can vary widely,
meaning there is no single acoustic foam that will meet the needs of each situation or application.
As a result, we offer a vast [range of different foam grades][148] in various thicknesses,
densities, composite forms and shapes, to ensure that each product we supply is ideal for its
specific application.

## **Enquire about our Domestic Acoustic Treatment Foams**

For expert advice and support regarding your acoustic foam treatment for domestic and residential
buildings, [**contact our specialist team today to discuss your project enquiries in detail.**][149]

**Can’t find what you’re looking for?**

Our experienced team is available to assist with your exact requirements; to speak to one of our
foam manufacturing and conversion specialists, call us on [01536 443000][150] or [fill out our
contact form for further assistance][151].

## **Acoustic Foam Conversion Specialists**

With an unrivalled [engineering department][152] and conversion facilities, we can also cut acoustic
foams to fit perfectly in any situation, with many different shapes including flat sheets, CNC-cut
shapes, egg-box and pyramid profiling.

We deal with each customer on an individual basis, specifying each product we manufacture on three
major factors: where the acoustic foam will be used; how much noise and vibration reduction is
required; the noise’s source (for example, whether it’s produced by music, machinery or people). We
can then develop an ideal solution for your needs.

With advanced working knowledge in acoustic treatment and building safety regulations, our team of

## Acoustic Foam Tile Applications

Acoustic foam tiles and panels are used extensively to treat and influence the acoustic properties
of a room or building to a given purpose. Depending on the use, dimensions and construction of a
room, the quantity, design and composition of acoustic panelling required may vary significantly to
deliver expert and appropriate acoustic treatment.

For recording studios and music performance spaces, acoustic tiling may be configured to reduce
sound reverberation which may negatively impact musical performances and the quality of mixing
processes if left untreated. Alternatively acoustic treatment panels may be installed in commercial
and industrial environments to reduce and control noise pollution. At Technical Foam Services, we
have extensive experience in developing custom acoustic treatment products for a range of
applications, including:
* Recording studio acoustic treatment – various shapes and sizes for acoustic enhancement in
recording and performance spaces
* Reverb and echo elimination – sound control for large lecture halls, sports hall and conference
rooms
* Ceiling sound absorption – reducing noise pollution and sound travel through buildings in offices,
industrial and domestic spaces

## What Are Acoustic Tiles?

Acoustic foam tiles are squares of foam made to cover a surface, usually a wall or ceiling, to offer
sound dampening or acoustic treatment. The tiles can be used to:
* Reduce echo and noise interference in recording and performance
* Enhance sound quality in recording studios or commercial spaces.
* Soundproof a room against external noise pollution or unwanted noise.
* Reduce the noise that escapes from a room.

All acoustic panels and tiles effectively work by making the surface softer, boosting sound
absorption. This reduces the echo and reverberation that hard surfaces produce.

Acoustic foam panels can be fitted on suspended ceilings as sound diffusers – which will also help
to reduce vibrations traveling through floors – or fitted directly to surfaces. This is often the
case with large performance spaces where the primary aim is to reduce echo, rather than provide
soundproofing.

Foam panels should remain unpainted, as paint recreates the harder surface that the tiles are
designed to overcome. Sound insulation tiles are also generally non-washable because soap residue
can fill in the tiny pores and crevices that make the tile work.

In office and industrial spaces, acoustic foam tiles are installed to [provide noise control][154]
and improve sound quality, potentially boosting employee focus. Acoustic treatment can also offer
benefits in domestic settings, as people seek higher quality audio from home speakers and
entertainment systems.

## FAQs

### What is Basotect foam?

Made from melamine resin, Basotect foam is a lightweight, open-cell material that is easy to install
and ideal for locations where sound absorption is crucial – this could include offices, exhibition
centres, HVAC and even the automotive sector.

### Are Basotect products resistant to heat?

As a result of the high nitrogen content in melamine foams, Basotect products are highly retardant
to flames and heat. This ensures they are efficient and cost-effective in environments where
specific standards are in force, such as in building, construction and automotive applications.

### Do Basotect products have a fire rating?

Our Basotect materials are all [Class-0 rated][163] and do not melt or drip when exposed to naked
flames, nor do they emit toxic smoke or fumes. This makes them particularly appropriate for ceiling
and wall panels, as well as HVAC products.

With a cross-linked structure, Basotect also provides a superb level of natural chemical resistance
in a wide range of environments. Resistant to all organic solvents, Basotect provides a durable and
effective solution even in harsher environments.

### What is the difference between soundproofing and sound absorption?

When sound waves bounce around a space they will come into contact with objects such as furniture
and walls. When this happens the sound can either be absorbed or reflected back.

Sound absorbing panels will prevent the sound waves from bouncing back into the room, reducing echo.
However, it does not block sound. Soundproofing will deaden the sound and prevent it entering or
leaving a space.

# Soundproof Foam

Our soundproofing foam is created from [polyurethane][144] and [melamine foams][145]. These foam’s
open-cell structure increases air resistance and helps stop sound waves effectively, providing the
highest level of noise reduction. However, the way we process and convert these foams is what makes
the real difference in the level of sound insulation.

From engine protection to soundproofing buildings, we offer a diverse range of soundproofing
solutions for commercial and domestic purposes.

[CONTACT US][146]

## Popular Applications
* **[Acoustic tiles][147]** – for studio, lecture hall and domestic acoustic treatment
* **[Acoustic Basotect foam][148]** – used for automotive noise dampening and sound absorption in
large spaces e.g. cinemas, theatres, offices.
* **[Domestic soundproofing][149]** – A range of wall, floor and ceiling panels to reduce noise
pollution.

## What We Offer

As two of the UK’s leading soundproofing foam manufacturers, we provide the widest range of acoustic
foam options on the market. We have produced soundproofing foam for a variety of industries, from
recording studios and performance spaces to solutions in the [automotive and rail industries][150].

Our soundproofing foam is created to your exact specifications by our in-house team of technical
foam experts, offering effective noise reduction that’s built for your environment. Whether you
require sound deadening for a neutral studio space, automotive acoustic insulation or wall
soundproofing for construction, we can create a custom solution that ticks every box.

Choose from a variety of grades, compositions and thicknesses, including [fire-retardant foams][151]
and non-rotting types such as PVC, all with unique sound absorption properties, and work with us to
create a truly bespoke solution.

## FAQs

### How does soundproofing foam work?

When sound waves are produced, the energy travels out from the source and causes objects in its path
to vibrate. This can lead to echo and reverb caused by the sound waves reflecting from surfaces in
the space.

The aim of soundproofing foam is to attenuate the amount of sound and stop it spreading through the
air or physical surfaces. This is done by deadening the vibrations to prevent sound from escaping.
Depending on the type, [using foam for sound treatment][155] can help to improve the sound quality
in a space or minimise the amount of sound bleeding out.

### What types of soundproofing foam can TFS supply?

Our expert in-house engineering department and custom tooling capability enables us to produce
soundproof foam in straight sheets, cut parts, egg crate panels, pyramid profiled panels and much
more.

As your foam supplier, every soundproof foam panel, part and sheet is developed and cut to meet your
unique requirements.

### How do I soundproof a space?

To learn more about soundproofing foam and how to treat a noisy space, click through to our full
article on [how soundproofing foam works][156], or read our [tips on soundproofing a room][157].

# Hydrophilic Foams

Hydrophilic foams are the ideal flexible foam solution for applications in which moisture
absorbency, breathability and softness are vital properties.

Hydrophilic foams have been adopted for a varied range of wound, anti-scar and post-operative
dressings with great success. As a [leading manufacturer in this field][144], we supply a wide
selection of hydrophilic foam grades for a range of uses.

[CONTACT US][145]

## Applications of Hydrophilic Foams
* **[Medical applications][146]** – including high quality wound dressings
* **[Cosmetic purposes][147]** – such as foam applicators and removers
* **[Packaging][148]** – particularly for moisture-sensitive goods

## Our Hydrophilic Foam Solutions

We manufacture a range of hydrophilic [polyurethane foams][149] and products in a wide variety of
grades, to meet even the most stringent specifications.

Providing a superior level of absorbency and high strength – combined with breathability,
biocompatibility, softness, and flexibility – our hydrophilic foam solutions provide an effective
non-linting, non-adhering, latex-free protective wound-healing environment. These water-absorbent
foams are perfect for a range of [medical applications][150]. Our in-house engineering team and
superior technical capabilities mean that our range of hydrophilic foam products is second to none.

With an established customer base in the medical sphere, we have a written protocol and sterilising
services in place, therefore allowing us to offer a comprehensive, one-stop service.

## Hydrophilic Foams FAQs

### What is hydrophilic foam dressing used for?

While foam is used for a wide range of [wound dressings][154], hydrophilic dressings are
specifically used when moisture absorbency and breathability is required when wounds are healing.

As well as producing medical grade hydrophilic foam, we can also manufacture composite hydrophilic
solutions, which can add anti-fungal and anti-microbial properties to the dressing.

### What are the main properties of hydrophilic foam?

Hydrophilic Foam is primarily known for its absorbent properties, but the combination of
breathability, biocompatibility, softness, and flexibility means it is a material ideal for numerous
purposes.

Outside of medical applications, it is widely used in [cosmetic applicators][155] due to its
durability and resistance to oil. Another common use is packaging – for both consumer and moisture
sensitive goods.

### Why is hydrophilic foam used in cosmetics?

Hydrophilic foam is non-crumbling, durable and oil resistant. Being washable and re-usable it offers
a cost-effective solution for moisture-sensitive cosmetic products, and can be used with liquids,
solids and powders.

All of our hydrophilic cosmetic foam grades are odourless, latex-free and non-toxic.

# Polyurethane Foam Material Supplier

With our extensive experience in manufacturing and converting polyurethane foam, we can create a
range of products to meet your specific needs and requirements. Polyurethane foam is a versatile
material, more resistant to oxidation and other ageing than rubber or latex foam, and as a result,
is suited to a wide range of potential uses.

[CONTACT US][144]

## Popular Applications
* **[Automotive components][145]** – from engine filters to polishing pads
* **[Acoustic absorption][146]** – including acoustic tiles, soundproofing and office screens
* **[Medical equipment][147]** – foams for specialist equipment are made using medical grade
reticulated polyurethane
* **[Protective packaging][148]** – polyurethane foam inserts for products of all sizes
* **[Supersoft foams][149]** – for use in skincare and baby products
* **[Filtration][150]** – PU foam is used in water and air filters

## What We Offer

As a leading UK converter of polyurethane foam, we have experience in manufacturing PU foam products
for a wide range of industries. Whether you need flexible or rigid polyurethane foam, we offer a
broad choice of grades, compositions and thicknesses that can be developed into completely bespoke
foam solutions for your business.

In-house engineering teams use state-of-the-art laser and die cutting techniques to transform uncut
foam sheets into whatever your needs require. From[ egg crate foam][151] panels to medical-grade[
heat and moisture exchange foams][152], our in-depth understanding of different foam grades and
densities means we are always able to recommend the best option for your requirements.

## FAQs

### Is polyurethane foam durable?

The impressive durability of PU foams is just one of the reasons why this type of foam is such a
popular choice. Polyurethane foam is lightweight, versatile and cost-efficient, as well as boasting
greater durability than many other materials.

There are two main categories offered by polyurethane foam suppliers: polyester foam and polyether
foam. Different grades and flexibilities of these foams can be used to meet different needs, but
each is capable of maintaining a high quality over periods of extended use.

As a result of their hard-wearing potential and ability to withstand the effects of water ingress
and air circulation, polyurethane foams are ideal for use in long-life items like sofa fillings, car
seats and mattresses.

### What is flexible polyurethane foam?

Flexible polyurethane foams are indispensable in everyday life, and it’s flexible, open-cell PU foam
that’s typically used in seat padding and mattresses.

More lightweight flexible polyurethane can be used for the specialist medical foams found in
breathing and anaesthetic equipment, as well as in hypersoft foams that are perfect for[ cosmetic
items][156] and baby sponges.

Flexible PU foam is also perfect for use in [microphone windshields][157], where open-cell foam can
offer wind noise attenuation and moisture resistance while keeping high-frequency sound loss to a
minimum.

The hydrophilic properties of an open-cell, flexible polyurethane foams make them ideal for
specialised use, and we manufacture densities from as low as 30kg/m3 up to 150kg/m3, in porosities
spanning 60ppi to 150ppi.

### Is polyurethane foam the same as memory foam?

The main material used in memory foam is polyurethane foam, which is processed with additional
chemicals to ensure that it has the right amount of viscosity and density to serve the intended
purpose. Other names for memory foam include viscoelastic polyurethane foam and low-resistance
polyurethane foam.

[Memory foam][158] is a type of PU foam which is sensitive to pressure and temperature, and is used
in mattresses and pillows to mould to the shape of the user’s body. After compression, this type of
foam can quickly recover its original, un-moulded shape.

As one of the UK’s leading PU foam suppliers, we offer more than 20 densities and rigidity levels of
memory foam, all created using expertly engineered polyurethane foam as the base.

# Foam Ink Roller Manufacturers

Precision is vital to ensure clear and crisp reproduction in both domestic and commercial printing
applications, and ink rollers play an essential role in ensuring high quality printing is achieved.

[ink rollers]

Therefore, the manufacture of ink rollers, which produce consistent, top quality results, is a
highly specialised field in which even the slightest discrepancy in pore size or density can have a
hugely detrimental impact on performance.

As the [leading UK-based engineering-biased manufacturer][144] of high specification [foam ink
rollers][145] for both home and professional printing applications, we have the enviable reputation
as the foremost producer of precision-engineered, technically advanced ink roller foam solutions in
the world.

## Market Leaders in Ink Roller Foam Solutions

While many companies may claim to be the “leader” in their field, we truly are. As the only ink
roller [foam manufacturer][146] with the technical and engineering capabilities to produce rollers
within a tolerance of +/-0.25mm, we lead the way in this sector. As a result, we export our ink
roller products all over the world and have supplied many global brands such Epson, Lexmark and
Hewlett Packard.

In addition to the superior precision of our products, we also pride ourselves on stocking the
widest selection of ink roller foam materials to ensure that we can always to provide our customers
with the perfect foam to meet their unique and specific requirements. Produced from specially
developed [thermo-compressed polyether and polyester reticulated foams][147], we supply ink roller
foams in a wide spectrum of densities ranging from as low as 30kg/m³ coarse cell 60ppi, to high
density 350kg/m³ foams with a fine cell of 110ppi.

With outstanding manufacturing facilities and access to the latest state-of-the-art reticulated foam
grades, we are able to produce ink roller foam solutions with the finest of pore sizes, thus
ensuring consistent ink dispersion that is both precise and uniform.

## Precision Foam Manufacturing

When it comes to ink roller foams, not only do they have to offer exact and precise densities and
pore size, they also need to be kept totally clean and pure throughout the manufacturing process to
ensure that contaminants are not present, which could react with the printing substrates.

As an established and recognised ink roller foam supplier, we have a great deal of experience in
handling these materials and have tried and tested written protocols in place to maintain a
completely pure environment during processing.

## Enquire about our Bespoke Ink Roller Foam Solutions

We supply ink roller foams in a vast range of foam grades and in almost every conceivable shape and
size, but we never offer ‘standard’ products. We take an individual approach to each and every one
of our customers, supplying ink roller foams to meet their precise specifications.

A large number of the ink roller foams we produce are bespoke, and this is where our engineering
expertise comes to the fore. With state-of-the-art conversion facilities and an [expert in-house
engineering department][148], we can develop and produce custom tooling to manufacture even the most
complex of ink roller foam products to meet your specifications.
