# Heat & Moisture Exchange (HME) Foams

[HME foams][HME foams]

Heat and moisture exchange (HME) foams are an essential component in a range of vital medical
breathing and anaesthesia systems and equipment, playing an integral role in consistent and
controlled oxygen and gas intake while also ensuring that sterile conditions are maintained.

With such a vital role to play, the precision of the pore size and the level of performance are
paramount in HME applications, where a sub-standard product could have potentially catastrophic
effects.

As the recognised [UK-based leader in engineering-biased precision manufactured foam products][144],
we have the experience and expertise in the field of HME to provide highly effective products that
always perform.

## **A matter of protocol**

With a vast experience in producing a wide range of foam solutions for [medical applications][145],
we have established an outstanding reputation in the field of [HME foams][146] for the quality and
performance of the products we manufacture, and the conditions in which they are produced.

We have tried and tested written protocols in place for handling and processing medical grade HME
foams. We also have a close and long established relationship with accredited laundering and clean
room sterilisation providers [Micronclean][147], which assures a reliable and comprehensive HME
solution for our customers around the globe.

## Precision Foam Engineering

With an enviable reputation built on the superior standards of our facilities, engineering
capabilities and the materials we use, all of our HME products are manufactured to highest
specifications possible.

Produced in medical grade [reticulated polyurethane (PU) foams][148] that has been specifically
developed for use in HME applications, each and every filter is produced to the highest standard,
thus ensuring exact and consistent pore size and density and therefore precise permeability and
control every time.

## Bespoke HME Foam Solutions

Unlike some HME foam converters, at Technical Foam Services we do not supply off-the-shelf solutions
to our customers; we [develop and manufacture bespoke HME foams][149] in a range of sizes, porosity
levels and composite forms to offer precise solutions that meet each individual customer’s
requirements. We even work with our trusted raw material suppliers to develop new grades for
specific applications where necessary.

As a result, we offer the widest range of HME foam solutions you will find in both dry and calcium
chloride impregnated variations.

While all of our HME products offer outstanding performance in terms of sterilisation, skin and
biocompatibility, we also offer an extensive range of composite HME solutions. These include HME
foams with additional anti-microbial and anti-bacterial characteristics, increased oxygen
permeability and enhanced fluid management as desired.

## **A unique approach**

At Technical Foam Services, we work in partnership with each and every client to deliver unique
products to fulfil individual requirements. This combines our unrivalled engineering and technical
HME foam expertise with our clients’ knowledge of their specific medical field.

We also believe in building long-term and trusting relationships with all of our clients, and are
willing to sign any necessary confidentiality agreements required.

team][150].

## About Trimoorty Foamtech Limited

Pioneers in Foam Conversion – Trimoorty Foamtech Limited, recently honored by the Indian Ministry
for Best Innovation under the Make in India initiative, proudly holds OHSAS 18001 and IATF 16949 QMS
certifications. As a renowned brand in manufacturing and foam conversion services, we’ve established
ourselves as a trusted partner for numerous OEM giants in the automotive industry and diverse
non-auto sectors.

Expanding our expertise into the Indian toy-making industry, Trimoorty Foamtech Limited emerges as a
leading manufacturer of foam products, featuring puzzles, squishy toys, play mats, yoga mats, and
board games – each adorned with captivating vinyl prints, BOPP prints, and stamping. Ensuring
eco-friendliness, non-toxicity, and child-friendliness, every toy crafted at Trimoorty’s facility
reflects our commitment to quality and safety.

## About Trimoorty Foamtech Limited

ourselves as a trusted partner for numerous OEM giants in the automotive industry and diverse
non-auto sectors.

_crawl.linkedin_about: We are a company of engineers, scientists, sharp manufacturing folks, and careful logistics planners, each of us dedicated to helping companies who need to sustainably protect vaccines, critical medical supplies, and food deliveries. With lots of customers in a variety of categories, we work to protect what is important and valuable to millions of people. Lifoam has been in the protection business since the 1950s, building and innovating in our plants and among our partnerships all over the world to better serve our customers and your consumers. Our culture is one that values mutual gains and growth with each partner-customer. To create win-win answers, we have and always will develop leading-edge thermal protection products, while working with labs, hospital groups, and companies to engineer their cold chain logistics — removing thermal risk from their world. As a division of Altor, we carry the strength and infrastructure to deliver great answers to even the most difficult thermal challenges. Talk to us. We can help.

ABOUT US

What we do

Welcome to Woodbridge INOAC Technical Products (WITP). We are a global company focused on innovation and partnerships. We strive to meet today’s demands through technological product and process innovations.
We are leaders in custom-engineered polyurethane (PUR) foam products and solutions to a variety of industries. We use state-of-the-art technology to drive design development on all levels, not just responding to change but anticipating it.

WITP is a joint venture partnership between award-winning Woodbridge and INOAC with over 50 production and manufacturing facilities located in over 10 countries.
Leveraging the power of our network, we participate in scientific development, technological advances, and sustainable manufacturing practices on a global scale. Once we have created the ideal solution, our supply chain confidently delivers:
Product quality
Availability
Delivery
With us, you will find a trusted and experienced partner in technical foam products. From custom design and manufacturing to finished products in padding, packaging, sealing, filtration, and more.

3 KEYS

Foundations

Innovation

We pride ourselves on leading product development from “innovation in action”.

Sustainability

Through engagement in our workplaces and communities in a socially responsible way.

Partnership

Global partnerships have been a key to our success in developing foam products.

Why Us?

Solutions for

Everyday and Far Away

Our Industries

Transportation

As leaders in developing customized products to the transportation industry including light weight vehicles, marine and mass transit, our foam solutions can improve acoustics, comfort, light-weighting and craftsmanship.

Filtration

Our series of filter foams offer solutions to a variety of industries including transportation, manufacturing, foundry, industrial water treatment, industrial heating, ventilation, air conditioning, medical, and more.

Medical

Aiding in patient care with unique foam solutions including foam wedge support, ventilator air filtration, instrument protection kits, and negative pressure wound care products among others.

Military

Our explosion suppression foam material is used in fuel tanks on military aircrafts and professional competition race car vehicles.

Industrial

Technical foam products are at work in a range of industrial applications globally. Our scope and breadth of experience in design and development have equipped our teams with a working knowledge of industrial processes. We partner with your team to custom design products for any application.

Consumer Goods

We work with our customers to deliver exceptional foam products that are fit for use in consumer goods.

Explore

Need a custom foam solution for your unique application?

Woodbridge INOAC Technical Products will work with your team to provide custom PU foam to meet your specific requirements.

### ABOUT US

# Leaders in foam manufacturing technology and innovation

We are on a global quest for continuous improvement delivering added value and efficiency to our
customers worldwide. With a linear focus on polyurethane foam and our combinative approach to
invention, we embrace growth and discovery as we encounter new frontiers.

Woodbridge and INOAC entered into a joint venture in 2018 to supply a range of industries with
specialty engineered polyurethane foam products for a variety of applications.

### Leadership and Innovation in Action

## Forging Ahead

## [Transportation][62]

We are global leaders specializing in advancing engineering and design possibilities for
transportation.

## [Military][63]

Mitigating risks with cost effective, zero maintenance, high-performance solutions for the most
trying circumstances.

## [Medical][64]

Accelerating healing with specially formulated foam products to meet the demanding needs of the
medical industry.

## [Filtration][65]

Thermally reticulated foams with filtration properties that surpass traditional filtration
materials.

## [Industrial][66]

Versatility for customized applications that drive production and efficiency across a range of
industries.

## [Consumer Goods][67]

Advancing value and comfort into the everyday with durable, quality products for people.

## Leaders in Foam Manufacturing Technology and Innovation

U.S. based WITP is a 50/50 joint venture between Woodbridge and INOAC Corp. Our team of global
experts are dedicated to developing new technologies, processes, and foam products to suit any
application. Scientists, designers, and engineers work collaboratively to drive innovation and
anticipate market needs. Woodbridge is an innovator in urethane and particle foam technologies,
INOAC is a world leader in polyurethane foam technology. Together at Woodbridge INOAC Technical Foam
Products our combined knowledge and experience delivers quality products and custom solutions via an
extensive supply chain.

### OUR CAPABILITIES INCLUDE:
* Polyurethane Development
* Property Testing
* Looping
* Peeling
* Lamination (Flame, Adhesive & Hot Oil)
* Reticulation
* Sheeting/Slitting
* Spooling
* Felting/Embossing

### [Woodbridge][69]

Woodbridge’s manufacturing facilities provide products such as seat cushioning, seat frame
components, interior soft trim, occupant safety components, noise/vibration/harshness solutions,
cargo management products, composite sheet foam products, engineered technical foams, and assembly
services.

In addition, Woodbridge offers chemical research and development, product and process engineering,
tooling, technical support, accredited laboratory testing and product development.

Woodbridge products are developed with a focus on five key functions offering comfort, acoustics,
safety, structural and insulation properties.

### [INOAC Innovation in Action][70]

U.S. based, WITP is a 50/50 joint venture between Woodbridge and INOAC. As a member of the World
Polyurethane Alliance, we are part of an extensive partner network with locations around the world.

Our team of global experts are dedicated to developing new technologies, processes, and foam
products to suit any application. Scientists, designers, and engineers work collaboratively to drive
innovation and anticipate market needs.

Woodbridge is an innovator in urethane and particle foam technologies, INOAC is a world leader in
polyurethane foam technology. By working together, Woodbridge INOAC Technical Foam Products combines
the knowledge and experience to deliver quality products and custom solutions throughout an
extensive supply chain.

# Re-imagining foam solutions with products and process

With us, you will find a trusted and experienced partner in technical foam products. From custom
design and manufacturing to finished products in padding, packaging, sealing, filtration, and more.
[rocket-icon]

## Innovation

We pride ourselves on leading product development from “innovation in action.”

Our approach to embracing change is rooted in our culture. We invest in new technologies for
industry 4.0 allowing us to continually expand into new industries and create truly custom solutions
offering to give a true competitive advantage.

Our commitment to continuous improvement includes talent and leadership development programs. We
bring scientists, engineers, and designers all working together to create products for today and
tomorrow.
[people-icon]

## Partnership

To meet the demands of changing and emerging markets, global partnerships have been a key to our
success in developing foam products.

Through our partnerships, we have access to data from around the world. We can identify emerging and
industry trends. Combining technical expertise with deep market experience, we utilize this
knowledge to develop polyurethane foam products that meet the needs of a dynamic global marketplace.
[grass-icon]

## Sustainability

We provide products globally that continuously improve the consumer experience through superior
comfort and appearance in a socially responsible way.

Our sustainability measures are built upon a foundation of Environmental, Community, Conduct &
Ethics, and Supply Chain.

[WB CSR report][62]
[INOAC CSR report][63]

We recently introduced [ECOLOCEL][64] polyurethane foam composed of over 50% plant-based raw
materials in response to an increasing demand for environmentally sustainable materials.

### ABOUT US

# Leaders in foam manufacturing technology and innovation

We are on a global quest for continuous improvement delivering added value and efficiency to our
customers worldwide. With a linear focus on polyurethane foam and our combinative approach to
invention, we embrace growth and discovery as we encounter new frontiers.

Woodbridge and INOAC entered into a joint venture in 2018 to supply a range of industries with
specialty engineered polyurethane foam products for a variety of applications.

### Leadership and Innovation in Action

## Forging Ahead

## [Transportation][62]

We are global leaders specializing in advancing engineering and design possibilities for
transportation.

## [Military][63]

Mitigating risks with cost effective, zero maintenance, high-performance solutions for the most
trying circumstances.

## [Medical][64]

Accelerating healing with specially formulated foam products to meet the demanding needs of the
medical industry.

## [Filtration][65]

Thermally reticulated foams with filtration properties that surpass traditional filtration
materials.

## [Industrial][66]

Versatility for customized applications that drive production and efficiency across a range of
industries.

## [Consumer Goods][67]

Advancing value and comfort into the everyday with durable, quality products for people.

## Leaders in Foam Manufacturing Technology and Innovation

U.S. based WITP is a 50/50 joint venture between Woodbridge and INOAC Corp. Our team of global
experts are dedicated to developing new technologies, processes, and foam products to suit any
application. Scientists, designers, and engineers work collaboratively to drive innovation and
anticipate market needs. Woodbridge is an innovator in urethane and particle foam technologies,
INOAC is a world leader in polyurethane foam technology. Together at Woodbridge INOAC Technical Foam
Products our combined knowledge and experience delivers quality products and custom solutions via an
extensive supply chain.

### OUR CAPABILITIES INCLUDE:
* Polyurethane Development
* Property Testing
* Looping
* Peeling
* Lamination (Flame, Adhesive & Hot Oil)
* Reticulation
* Sheeting/Slitting
* Spooling
* Felting/Embossing

### [Woodbridge][69]

Woodbridge’s manufacturing facilities provide products such as seat cushioning, seat frame
components, interior soft trim, occupant safety components, noise/vibration/harshness solutions,
cargo management products, composite sheet foam products, engineered technical foams, and assembly
services.

In addition, Woodbridge offers chemical research and development, product and process engineering,
tooling, technical support, accredited laboratory testing and product development.

Woodbridge products are developed with a focus on five key functions offering comfort, acoustics,
safety, structural and insulation properties.

U.S. based, WITP is a 50/50 joint venture between Woodbridge and INOAC. As a member of the World
Polyurethane Alliance, we are part of an extensive partner network with locations around the world.

Our team of global experts are dedicated to developing new technologies, processes, and foam
products to suit any application. Scientists, designers, and engineers work collaboratively to drive
innovation and anticipate market needs.

Woodbridge is an innovator in urethane and particle foam technologies, INOAC is a world leader in

the knowledge and experience to deliver quality products and custom solutions throughout an
extensive supply chain.

# Our Partners

[][56]

As 3M’s authorized distributor in North America, we bring 3M’s science to help our customers meet
their challenges. We carry a wide array of 3M’s pressure sensitive adhesives for every applications.

[[Zotfoams][Zotfoams]][57]

Worldwide Foam is proud to be a platinum distributor of Zotefoams. The combination of superior
products and convenient logistic locations makes Zotefoams easily accessible for fabricators across
North America.

[[Armacell][Armacell]][58]

Armacell is the inventor of flexible foam for equipment insulation and a leading provider of
engineered foams.

[][59]

Avery Dennison is a global materials science company specializing in the design and manufacture of a
wide variety of labeling and functional materials.

[[Sealed Air Extruded PE Planks][Sealed Air Extruded PE Planks]][60]

Sealed Air helps to enhance commerce through fulfillment and packaging solutions to protect the
worldwide movement of goods.

[[WM T. Burnett][WM T. Burnett]][61]

For more than 60 years, Mactac has been a leader in the pressure-sensitive adhesive (PSA) industry.
They are a full adhesive provider equipped with acrylic and rubber adhesive chemistries and all
adhesive technologies, including hot melt, solvent, emulsion, and UV.

# Our Brands

[][62]

Jacobs & Thompson has been in business since 1947, making us one of the most established and
vertically integrated foam suppliers in North America. We are your dedicated source for customized
Foam, Adhesive and Textile components.

[][63]

The Aqua Lily Pad is all about maximizing your fun on-the-water. Whether the boat stops for serenity
or you’re ready to float off the dock, the Aqua Lily Pad provides a safe and comfortable environment
for your kids, friends, and grandparents to play, run and relax on. It’s a floating playground that
will bring the entire family together!

[][64]

At Polar Bear Products we believe that some of life’s greatest moments happen at home; that’s why we
designed our product line to continuously keep your family comfortable so that life can carry on
without *gaps*. Cold drafts, heat waves, leaky pipes

# Our Commitment to Sustainable Business Practices

At Worldwide Foam, we recognize that our business activities have an impact on the environment and
society, and we are committed to sustainable business practices.

We are dedicated to promoting economic growth while protecting the environment and improving the
well-being of our stakeholders. We believe that these efforts will not only help to protect the
planet but will also create long-term value for our customers.

## Reduce
* We offer crosslinked polyethylene (XLPE) materials in a wide variety of sizes for customers to
choose from. Customers have the flexibility to choose the best yielding size to maximize their
profitability and minimize production scraps.
* The Looping process allows us to create custom length rolls, which increases our customers’
production throughput and decreases material waste.
* High precision heat laminators and pressure sensitive laminators are used to achieve better edge
alignment, which translates to more usable materials and less material waste
* Silao, Mexico warehouse incorporated our first skylight building to reduce energy consumption by
utilizing nature light to illuminate the workspace. The rest of our warehouse buildings are
planned to follow suit in the near future.
* All WF warehouse buildings are equipped with motion sensor activated lights to reduce unnecessary
energy waste.

[Sustainability - Reduce][Sustainability - Reduce]

## Reuse
* Laminate falloff foam sheets to create usable buns
* Our customers repurpose XLPE skins as sacrificial materials to minimize the effects of splash back
* In house pallet repair shop to fix and reuse old pallets

## Recycle
* Recycle XLPE trim and end-of-life components from our customers to be repurposed.
* Scrap collection hubs in Indiana and Georgia locations.
* Foam shredder in our Indiana facility to increase the efficiency of our recycling process

[Explore More][56]
[Sustainability - Recycle][Sustainability - Recycle]
[Extruded polyethylene foam][Extruded polyethylene foam]
[Closed cell crosslinked polyethylene foam][Closed cell crosslinked polyethylene foam]

## Materials With Recycled Content

### XLPE
* BEST material for returnable packaging. XLPE foam found in containers, totes, trays, and dunnage
can withstand the rough handling of a typical logistics system. On average, returnable/reusable
packaging using XLPE foam has a lifecycle of 5-7 years. This means there are no new packaging
materials introduced in circulation during this lifespan
* We offer multiple collection points to recycle scraps, trims, and end of life components
* 30% recycled content XLPE in single stage materials available

[Explore More][57]

### Zotefoams
* EcoZote is made out of 30% recycled content
* Proprietary foaming process that does not content chemical foaming agents
* We offer multiple collection points to recycle scraps, trims, and end of life components

### Pressure Sensitive Adhesive (PSA)

Our top three rubber-based PSAs have been recognized as USDA Bio Preferred, achieving the minimum
24% bio-based content.

### Sealed Air

A wide array of Recycled Content and High Recycled Content PE materials

## Shipping and Logistics

Worldwide Foam recognizes the impacts carbon emissions from freight cause on the environment and is
dedicated to being a leader in finding greener ways to handle the logistics of material handling.

* Optimize shipping efficiency with multiple strategic locations across North America
* Multi-shipment consolidation, which combines multiple orders going to the same destination into
one convenient shipment.
* Partner with sustainability conscious carriers that participate in shared truckloads where
possible to lower carbon emissions
* Digital first approach to paperwork and documentation with a goal of being 100% paperless where
possible

[Explore More][58]

## Continuous Improvement

We are continuously improving our operations to achieve carbon neutralization and conserve natural
resources. We invest in renewable energy sources and implement energy-efficient practices to
minimize our greenhouse gas emissions. Since 2018, we have achieved ZERO XLPE scrap to landfill.

# Heat Lamination

Heat lamination combines different materials, densities and colors to create multi-layer composite
sheets.

Worldwide Foam offers a variety of add-on services to supply our customers press ready materials. To
see our full capabilities chart, please click [here][56].

Worldwide Foam currently offers heat lamination service in Elkhart Indiana, Ontario California, and
Silao Mexico. By pushing the materials through a heated blade, the heat melts the surface of the
foam, turning it into a tacky substance that essentially acts as an adhesive and creates a permanent
bond. It is more cost effective and better performance when compared to glue or adhesive. We can
combine different materials, densities and colors to create multi-layer composite sheets.

We have recently added a new and more advanced heat laminator to our Indiana facility. This new
laminator is designed to heat bond a variety of foams planks including lower density PE.

By feeding foam planks through a hot air blade, the heat melts the surface of the foam, turning it
into a tacky substance that essentially acts as an adhesive and creates a permanent bond. The
computer-controlled rollers achieve better edge alignment, which translates to quicker uptimes and
more usable materials. This new system accommodates PE planks up to 50” wide, and 6” thick, at a
maximum rate of 16” per second.

# Looping

Our looping service turns sheets into continuous rolls to increase your production efficiency.

Worldwide Foam offers a variety of add-on services to supply our customers press ready materials. To
see our full capabilities chart, please click [here][56].

We operate the industry’s largest piece of splitting equipment at 86″ wide. Our state-of-the-art F&K
Loop splitters skive custom roll thicknesses and lengths unique to your equipment, application and
customer demands. The looping process creates longer rolls that translates to lower costs, faster
speeds and improved sales dollars per hours worked. The F&K Loop splitters also allow us to convert
sheets into continuous rolls by butt welding the materials together using heat or glue.
Additionally, our splitters are equipped with laser measuring sensors to ensure our production team
has live data available throughout each run and maintains consistent tolerances.

The cost advantages of longer rolls
* Lower freight costs.
* Less material handling.
* Less roll changeovers during lamination.
* Less roll changeovers during slitting and die cutting.
* Faster throughput.
* Improved service times and customer retention.

# Roller and Vacuum Skiving

Roller and vacuum skiving cut materials to your desired thickness.

Worldwide Foam offers a variety of add-on services to supply our customers press ready materials. To
see our full capabilities chart, please click [here][56].

With over 10 skivers across all its facilities in North America, Worldwide Foam has the capability
to skive materials ranging from low density extruded PE to high density XLPE.

**Roller Splitting/Skiving** operates by compressing the material between two rollers in order to
push it through a fixed ultra sharp knife edged blade. Thickness is controlled by the relative
distance of the rollers from the blade and the amount of compression required to push the foam
through the blade. Roller splitting/skiving can process large quantity job faster and handle higher
density materials.

Roller skiving Characteristics:
* Cuts with compression
* Faster for large quantities
* Can handle higher density foam

Drawbacks and limitations:
* Less accurate
* Larger potential variation within a sheet and between sheets

**Vacuum Table Skiving** operates by holding material flat to a table through the use of air
suction, and the table is passed through an ultra sharp knife edged blade. Thickness is controlled
by the relative distance of the blade from the table. Since the material is not compressed, the
thickness is consistent across the sheet. Typically, vacuum skiver is used for thinner gauges and
limited to material up to 4lb. However, the process time is slower when compared to roller skivers.

Vacuum Skiving Characteristics:
* Material is not compressed during the skiving process
* Tighter tolerances

Drawbacks and limitations:
* Maximum density in most cases of 4lb
* Slower process speed
* Limited to 1” maximum

# Roll Slitting

Our roll slitting service turns master rolls into custom width strips.

Worldwide Foam offers a variety of add-on services to supply our customers press ready materials. To
see our full capabilities chart, please click [here][56].

The slitting process involves feeding roll goods through a set of sharp blades that slit the
materials into smaller strips. This allows us to produce a wide variety of adhesive and non-adhesive
tapes, including polyethylene, EPDM, Neoprene, and NBR foams.

Our roll slitting machine is capable of slitting master rolls into narrower rolls ranging from 0.07”
to 62” in width, with a maximum outside diameter of 24”. The maximum and minimum width we can
process would depend on the materials and roll diameter.

spooling equipment. This state-of-the-art production line transforms master rolls of materials into
customized prole shapes, at varying widths and continuous lengths. This new spooler can make rolls
in multiples of 9 and is dedicated to our material converting customers across North America, so
please let us know what we can transform for you today!

## Company Timeline

#### 2008

Founded

#### 2011

Purchased First Building

#### 2013

Leased current location in Ontario, CA
Leased original location in Atlanta, GA

#### 2014

Purchased 3rd building, 57,000 sq.ft. in Atlanta, GA
Added Irriadiated and chemically crosslinked rolls
Introduced industrial first production 6” thick XLPE bun

#### 2015

Introduce industrial first production 8” thick XLPE bun
Added Gong Young vacuum table skiver
Added PSA Lamination capability (Elkhart Only) and became authorized distributor for 3M
Purchased 4th building, 115,000 sq.ft in Elkhart, IN

#### 2016

Added ability to heat laminate polyolefin materials

#### 2017

Moved the headquarters office to a larger building with 10+ loading docks

#### 2018

Accquired by Jacobs & Thompson
Become Zotefoams Platinum Distributor in North America
Become Sealed Air Preferred Distributor

#### 2019

Open The 7th Location in Brantford, Canada

#### 2020

Open Silao Location to better serve Mexican market

# Our People

## Our People

WT Burnett is a company of doers, problem-solvers, and forward-thinkers—people who take ownership
and rise to a challenge. Our leaders empower teams to think creatively and take pride in their work.
From engineering and operations to customer service and beyond, every team member is encouraged to
share ideas and push what’s possible.

### People First. Always.

As a family-owned company, WT Burnett believes in the power of personal relationships—whether it’s
managers supporting employees, employees supporting one another, or all of us showing up for our
customers. We work hard to create an environment where everyone feels respected, valued, and
empowered to do their best. Our people-first culture extends to all aspects of our organization,
shaping how we work and win together.

### Safety & Responsibility

Workplace safety is a shared priority at WT Burnett. We invest in the health and well-being of our
employees and maintain safety protocols across all five of our manufacturing facilities. Our
teams—from leadership to the factory floor—take collective responsibility for safety through
transparent communication, ongoing training, and proactive maintenance.

## What Our Team Is Saying

Our team is passionate about the work, and embodies an entrepreneurial spirit.

> “WTB is known for quality, but [even moreso] for always being a partner, not just a supplier.
> Face-to-face relationships matter here.”

**Director of Manufacturing**

> “The customers I work with know that we are cheering for their success, whether they are
> multi-million dollar customers or very small businesses just starting out.”

**Account Executive**

> “We adapt, change, and evolve quickly to new opportunities. We also have the ability to adjust
> when there is a problem and find another way when [we encounter] challenges that aren’t easily
> overcome.”

**Product Manager**
* #### Discover a Place to Belong & Grow

We’re always looking for talented people who want to make an impact. Explore opportunities and
apply now to join our team.

[ Careers ][60]
* #### Giving Back to Our Communities

For decades, we’ve invested in the communities where our employees live and work. We support both
national and local nonprofits that advance economic opportunity, education, health, and housing.
In times of crisis, we also step up with emergency relief efforts.

# Our Legacy

## Our Legacy

For more than 140 years, WT Burnett has helped define what’s next in polyurethane foam and nonwoven
technologies. Our legacy is one of continuous improvement—driven by technical expertise and a
relentless commitment to solving challenges.

Our original plant in Baltimore, Maryland was the location for the first continuous pouring machine
for flexible polyurethane foam in the world, beginning production in 1954. Since then, we have
extended our legacy of innovation in many directions, receiving our first patent in 1966, through
advanced materials and smarter manufacturing processes.

WT Burnett products have delivered performance, durability, sustainability, and safety for
industries ranging from aerospace and automotive to bedding and building materials.

### **Innovation Never Stops**

Here are a few examples of how we’ve taken our best and made it better.

### Nonwoven Flame-Retardant Material (2019)

Thermoformable and compliant with stringent UL94 V-0 and ASTM E84 flammability standards.

### Oxidation Discoloration-Resistant Polyurethane Foam (2013)

A flexible polyurethane foam with improved resistance to discoloration from oxidation. It’s composed
of high levels of reactive and nonreactive phosphite esters that improve color stability without
compromising on quality.

### Lightweight Nonwoven Fire-Retardant Barrier (2008, 2010)

Prepared from low denier, charring fibers and substantially free of polymers made from halogenated
monomers.

### Fragrance-Emitting Polyurethane Foams (1986)

A novel integration of sensory experience and material science.

## Committed to Better Materials & A Better Future

At WT Burnett, our commitment to product sustainability means integrating environmentally and
socially responsible practices throughout our products’ lifecycle. We minimize environmental impact,
design products and processes with sustainability in mind, conserve resources, and create economic
efficiencies.

# Our Legacy

## Our Legacy

For more than 140 years, WT Burnett has helped define what’s next in polyurethane foam and nonwoven
technologies. Our legacy is one of continuous improvement—driven by technical expertise and a
relentless commitment to solving challenges.

Our original plant in Baltimore, Maryland was the location for the first continuous pouring machine
for flexible polyurethane foam in the world, beginning production in 1954. Since then, we have
extended our legacy of innovation in many directions, receiving our first patent in 1966, through
advanced materials and smarter manufacturing processes.

WT Burnett products have delivered performance, durability, sustainability, and safety for
industries ranging from aerospace and automotive to bedding and building materials.

### **Innovation Never Stops**

Here are a few examples of how we’ve taken our best and made it better.

### Nonwoven Flame-Retardant Material (2019)

Thermoformable and compliant with stringent UL94 V-0 and ASTM E84 flammability standards.

### Oxidation Discoloration-Resistant Polyurethane Foam (2013)

A flexible polyurethane foam with improved resistance to discoloration from oxidation. It’s composed
of high levels of reactive and nonreactive phosphite esters that improve color stability without
compromising on quality.

### Lightweight Nonwoven Fire-Retardant Barrier (2008, 2010)

Prepared from low denier, charring fibers and substantially free of polymers made from halogenated
monomers.

### Fragrance-Emitting Polyurethane Foams (1986)

A novel integration of sensory experience and material science.

## Committed to Better Materials & A Better Future

At WT Burnett, our commitment to product sustainability means integrating environmentally and
socially responsible practices throughout our products’ lifecycle. We minimize environmental impact,
design products and processes with sustainability in mind, conserve resources, and create economic
efficiencies.

# About

## Precision-engineered

WT Burnett is the oldest specialty foam and nonwovens manufacturer in the world, delivering
precision-engineered materials and custom solutions for more than 140 years. With a steadfast
commitment to quality and innovation, we partner with the world’s leading brands to bring their
visions to life and push entire industries forward.

Our technical foams and high-loft nonwovens have been used in products around the world and in
nearly every major automotive platform over the years. Our materials are everywhere—quietly
performing in products people rely on every day.

### Our Purpose, In Practice

We approach every challenge with a spirit of curiosity, collaboration, and craftsmanship—creating
better solutions by listening closely, thinking boldly, and delivering with care.

### Quality

WT Burnett operates an A2LA-accredited laboratory with a scope of accreditation in tests applicable
to polyurethane foam. Our Specialty and Technical Foams and Nonwovens divisions have designed and
implemented Quality Management Systems compliant with the international ISO 9001-2015 standard. Our
Quality Control Laboratory has achieved and maintained ISO/IEC 17025:2017.

### Process Control

From ideation to product launch, our research and development team partners with customers and
suppliers to create innovative products. We manufacture polyurethane foam every day using a
closed-loop process for total control. We test each lot for accreditation and certification, and can
perform additional tests—physical, analytical, or acoustical—based on our customers’ needs.

## Over a Century of Proven Performance

Explore the milestones, recognitions, and certifications that have shaped who we are today. [ Our
Legacy ][59]

## Five Facilities. One Standard of Excellence.

WT Burnett operates five manufacturing and distribution facilities in three locations across the
United States. From our historic roots in Maryland to our growing presence in the Southeast and
Southwest, each facility is powered by a team of dedicated employees who bring our commitment to
innovation, customization, and quality every day. As a service-oriented company, WT Burnett is built
for responsiveness. We’re structured to deliver quick turnarounds and the flexibility to ship
multiple product types on a single truck—because helping you succeed is about meeting your goals, on
your timeline.

# About

## Precision-engineered

WT Burnett is the oldest specialty foam and nonwovens manufacturer in the world, delivering
precision-engineered materials and custom solutions for more than 140 years. With a steadfast
commitment to quality and innovation, we partner with the world’s leading brands to bring their
visions to life and push entire industries forward.

Our technical foams and high-loft nonwovens have been used in products around the world and in
nearly every major automotive platform over the years. Our materials are everywhere—quietly
performing in products people rely on every day.

### Our Purpose, In Practice

We approach every challenge with a spirit of curiosity, collaboration, and craftsmanship—creating
better solutions by listening closely, thinking boldly, and delivering with care.

### Quality

WT Burnett operates an A2LA-accredited laboratory with a scope of accreditation in tests applicable
to polyurethane foam. Our Specialty and Technical Foams and Nonwovens divisions have designed and
implemented Quality Management Systems compliant with the international ISO 9001-2015 standard. Our
Quality Control Laboratory has achieved and maintained ISO/IEC 17025:2017.

### Process Control

From ideation to product launch, our research and development team partners with customers and
suppliers to create innovative products. We manufacture polyurethane foam every day using a
closed-loop process for total control. We test each lot for accreditation and certification, and can
perform additional tests—physical, analytical, or acoustical—based on our customers’ needs.

## Over a Century of Proven Performance

Explore the milestones, recognitions, and certifications that have shaped who we are today. [ Our
Legacy ][59]

## Five Facilities. One Standard of Excellence.

WT Burnett operates five manufacturing and distribution facilities in three locations across the
United States. From our historic roots in Maryland to our growing presence in the Southeast and
Southwest, each facility is powered by a team of dedicated employees who bring our commitment to
innovation, customization, and quality every day. As a service-oriented company, WT Burnett is built
for responsiveness. We’re structured to deliver quick turnarounds and the flexibility to ship
multiple product types on a single truck—because helping you succeed is about meeting your goals, on
your timeline.

### Product Description

## Features
* Secondary pressurization ensures accurate material proportion, improving product consistency and
yield.
* Compact and lightweight design with low failure rate, easy operation, and reliable performance.
* Adjustable feed rate with time and quantity settings, ideal for batch casting and higher
efficiency.
* Advanced ventilation, leakage protection, and emergency stop system ensure safe and stable
operation.
* Optimized spraying with anti-clogging design and high-ratio lifting pump, suitable for
high-viscosity materials even in cold conditions.

## Equipment Applications

Insulation & Coating: external wall insulation, internal wall insulation, roof, cold storage, ship
cabin, cargo containers,trucks, refrigerated trucks,tank, etc.

Casting applications cover insulation for solar water heaters, storage tanks, refrigerators and
freezers, insulated panels, security doors, pipes, walls, prefabricated cabins, packaging
protection, and road construction and ground stabilization.

## Designed for Entry-Level & Small Contractors

The JYYJ-3D is specially developed for customers who need a reliable PU spray machine without
complex operation or high investment.

It delivers consistent spraying performance while keeping operation and maintenance costs low.

Ideal users include:
* Small insulation contractors
* Start-up spraying teams
* Building maintenance companies
* DIY or local construction service providers

### Product Description

## ****What risks worry you most when purchasing a PU seat production line?****

We interviewed procurement managers from over **200 automotive component factories**. These are
their main concerns and our solutions.

### ****1. Uneven Foam Density & High Scrap Rate****

Incorrect material ratio and unstable mold temperature may cause hard spots, voids, and customer
complaints.

**Solution:**
* High-pressure precision metering pumps
* Ratio accuracy: **±0.5%**
* Independent temperature control channels
* Mold temperature stability: **±1°C**

### ****2. Difficult Mold Change & Poor Mixed Production Efficiency****

Customers often run multiple vehicle models. Traditional mold changes may stop production for over
two hours.

**Solution:**
* Quick-connect mold change design
* Mold replacement time: **<20 minutes**
* Independent carrier control for seamless mixed production

### ****3. Equipment Downtime Causes Delivery Delays****

Imported spare parts may require months of waiting.

**Solution:**
* Local spare parts inventory
* On-site response within **72 hours**
* Remote PLC diagnostics and monitoring

### ****4. Flame-Retardant Requirements for EV Seats****

Traditional formulations may not satisfy:
* FMVSS 302
* GB 8410

**Solution:**
* [Multi-component formulation support][66] (up to 6 components)
* Flame-retardant polyol solutions
* Process validation within **30 days**

### ****5. Hidden Costs in Equipment Quotation****

Many suppliers exclude molds, installation, training, and spare parts.

**Solution:**
Turnkey quotation including:
* [Equipment][67]
* [Molds][68]
* Installation
* Training
* One-year spare parts package

### ****6. Difficult Operation & Labor Shortage****

Complex equipment requires skilled operators.

**Solution:**
* 7-inch touchscreen HMI
* One-button startup
* Formula storage system

Operator training completed within **3 days**

Step 1. Pillow Feeding:Finished PU pillows are placed onto the conveyor.

Step 3. Rolling:The rotating shaft rolls the pillow into a compact cylinder.

Step 4. Bagging:The rolled pillow is automatically pushed into a PE or PVC bag.

Step 5. Vacuum Sealing (Optional):The package can be vacuum sealed and packed into cartons.

# Innovation

At Zahonero, we firmly believe that the keys to forging new routes and advancing toward our
long-term objectives are innovation and passion. These are a few of our innovations that came about
as a consequence of research done in our own facilities.

## Creativity and passion as the key to innovation_

## Standardization, traceability and transparency_

We provide the customer with control and information about each material through a QR, where he can
see the following information: item properties, lot number and traceability details, sustainable
seals, and certifications of the origin of the raw materials.

## Naked 360 insole

A single material. Total circularity.

The naked 360 insole surpassed the competition after 160 km of running, according to test results,
while the original insoles lost performance. The naked 360 insole met and exceeded the competition’s
thermal and dynamic properties. And best of all, since it is made of a single material, it is 100%
recyclable, keeping its qualities practically intact.

_crawl.linkedin_about: At Zahonero, we engineer comfort through the design, development and manufacture of technical polymer foam solutions. Our materials have become standards for comfort in the footwear, foot care, sporting goods and building acoustics industries. Since Zahonero’s founding in 1965 till the present, we have grown and evolved, changing with the times and responding to market demands. Most importantly, we remained faithful to the values with which Zahonero was founded upon more than 50 years ago. Our guiding principles of commitment, innovation and sustainability have been key to providing the most advanced solutions for over 3,000 customers around the world. We have accumulated over half a century of experience and knowledge in the sector, which has allowed us to develop six proprietary technologies for leading brands in the different industries we work with. These solutions, produced by the compression of materials, have not only met the needs of our customers, but have prepared for them in advance. Today we can say loud and clear that Zahonero's culture of comfort has reached more than 30 countries around the world. We have 8 production units in key markets in Europe, Asia and America. These figures are the result of the hard work and dedication of the more than 600 professionals who make up the Zahonero team. They are the true essence of Zahonero.

About us_

# Our process

Since we produce specialized foams for a variety of markets, we are able to suggest novel concepts
and cutting-edge innovations.

Furthermore, we carry out testing to verify your product and guarantee optimal production
efficiency.

## We adapt to every industry and need_

## Idea

We** analyze each instance individually to develop a value proposition** that fits the requirements
of your project.

Our technical team weighs aspects such as location, purpose, and final price of the product to offer
**the best performance for each use** and optimize manufacturing processes.

## **Naked 360 insole**

## Project

We offer a fully realized project that includes all product specifications, **from concept to actual
delivery**, along with a technical data sheet.

## Laboratory analysis

We have our own laboratories where we **analyze the technical characteristics** of the foams and
their materials, in an effort to suggest enhancements and **guaranteeing compliance with the
regulations** of each market.

## Proximity production

Through our subsidiaries, we manufacture goods globally and provide our consumers with the same
product **wherever in the world.**

We operate inside a system of standardization that allows us to achieve production excellence and
maintain the **same quality in all our factories.**

## Seals and certifications

We also provide the assurance of dealing with a reliable partner, as we are part **of international
organizations that ensure social and environmental sustainability:** Sustainable Development Goals
(SDG), HiggIndex, and Ecochain.

On a product basis, we guarantee the quality, properties and content of our materials with
**international certifications such as RCS and GRS** for recycled foams and zerowaste;** and USDA**
for Bio-based foams.

## About usZAHONERO

We have been producing high-performance, environmentally friendly technical foams for sporting
goods, footwear, footcare, and building acoustics for more than 50 years.

[ > ][70]

## Comfort certified in ourLABORATORY

At Zahonero, we rely on our own laboratories to test all of our materials and products and ensure
that they meet the necessary standards for quality and the most recent laws.

[ > ][71]

## Our porgress inINNOVATION

Since we produce specialized foams for a variety of markets, we are able to suggest novel concepts
and cutting-edge innovations.
Furthermore, we carry out testing to verify your product and guarantee optimal production
efficiency.

# Rolling

## COMFORT FOR ALL TYPES OF FOOTWEAR

Rolling is our line of **high-performance technical and sustainable foams** for the manufacture of
footwear components. Available in **rolls or sheets**, they cover the full range of performance to
provide the best comfort for **all types of shoes**, from sports footwear to dress footwear.

## Attributes_

## Static comfort

Based on static tests conducted on the insole´s individual components

Hardness and Compression/Deflection Load Tests

## Dynamic comfort

Based on tests measuring comfort during use.

Cfw, Cfr and resilience test

## Thermal comfort

Based on metrics that assess the materials’ breathability.

Water absorption and desorption test

## Durability

Attests to the material´s resilience in harsh circumstances.

Compression set and dynamic compression test

## Footwear

High impact foot areas should be as comfortable as possible, and all styles of footwear should
employ extremely soft materials.

# Breathaprene

## A REVOLUTION IN THERMAL COMFORT

Breathaprene is a revolutionary foam fabric solution for applications requiring **high breathability
and elasticity**. Breathable material that functions as **a second skin**, assisting the body in
controlling its own temperature and reducing sweat retention.

## Attributes_

## Elasticity

Its ability to resist breakage or deformation remains intact even when handled or stretched.

Elongation and traction test

## Breathability

Serves as a permeable barrier that encourages sweating, keeps the body from being too hot, removes
moisture, and preserves the equilibrium between the environment and the body.

Water Absorption and Desorption Test

## Sustainability

Are recyclable and biodegradable, which helps to lower pollution.

## Footwear

Encourages sweating of the skin, resists moisture, and offers support and flexibility.

## Goalkeeper gloves

Because of its great flexibility, it is incredibly cozy. It conforms to any anatomy and permits
perspiration because of its superior adhesion.

## Sports protections

Keep their shape for the ideal body fit while offering comfort, lightness, and resistance for the
toughest situations.

Foams for goalkeeper gloves_

# Gripping

## MAXIMUM BALL CONTROL WITH MINIMUM IMPACT

Our assortment of Gripping foams is specifically made to enhance the durability, grip, and shock
absorption needed for **goalkeeper gloves.** We conduct performance tests on our foams to make sure
they fulfill the requirements for professional use, including **shock absorption and wet and dry
grip.**

## Attributes_

## Shock absorption

Increased shock absorption means more ball contact time with the palm, improved ball control, better
grip and reduced impact on joints.

Shock Absorption test

## Wet grip

Enhances the ball’s ability to grip in damp situations. developed through the measurement of the wet
static coefficient of friction, or grip.

Wet grip test

## Dry grip

It entails maximizing ball grip in arid climates. This is accomplished by measuring the grip, or
static coefficient of friction, at room temperature and without the presence of humidity.

Dry grip test

## Durability

Prepared for wear and tear under heavy use because of their higher abrasion resistance.

Abrasion resistance test

## Breathability

Prevent sweat from condensing, allowing the skin to breathe.

Water Absorption and Desorption Test

## Goalkeeper gloves

Meet the level of performance required for professional use and are designed in accordance with our
own regulations adapted to international reference standards.

# dB Cover

## ACOUSTIC SOLUTIONS AGAINST NOISE

dBCover is a leading manufacturer of high-performance materials to improve the acoustic environment
in homes, buildings, offices and commercial spaces. Specializes in cutting-edge approaches to sound
absorption, airborne noise, and impact sound insulation.

## Attributes_

## Low thickness and high performance

Enable greater noise reduction with reduced thickness

## Fire behavior

Materials whose composition satisfies the strictest fire safety requirements without introducing any
environmentally hazardous components.

## Durability

Provides high long-term performance without detriment to its physical or chemical properties.

## Sustainability

Production is carried out without emitting environmentally harmful components and its composition
allows for easy recycling.

## Sound absorbing panels

Uniquely designed recycled PET panels that lessen reverberation and enhance sound clarity in busy
settings. Conference rooms, recording studios, businesses, dining establishments, and other settings
are perfect for using them.

## Impact sound insulation

Latex insulation pads for impact noise improvement. Highly effective, significantly reducing the
transmission of noise generated by footsteps, furniture movements and other sources of impact.

## Airborne sound insulation

Efficiently controls the transmission of unwanted noise between adjacent rooms or spaces.

# Zahonero Group_

## Driven by comfort

Manufacturers of technical foam solutions for more than half a century.

We create high-performance and sustainable materials for footwear, foot care, sporting goods, and
building acoustics.

## Engineering comfort since 1965_

## We define comfort and comfort defines us_

Since you are unable to quit, neither of us can. For almost 50 years, we have been creating and
producing high-performance foam technology to meet the needs of the most exacting customers.

Our expertise lies in identifying and verifying comfort through the creation of tailored solutions
for certain uses.

Comfort is a quantifiable reality that we build on a daily basis, not simply a feeling.

[img_pies_nino.jpg]

### International presence_

We started out in 1965 and have continued to expand ever since.

In addition to our headquarters in Alicante (Spain), we have our own factories in Brazil, Mexico,
Canada, India, Indonesia, China, and Vietnam, and sales offices in Portugal and the USA.

## Innovation

To offer additional value to the market, we search for creative ideas that go against the
conventions of the market.

We explore new components, develop new technologies, **design new processes and find new uses for
our materials,** putting our commitment to comfort to the test every day.

## Good for you and good for the planet

At Zahonero we know that it is our responsibility to make a **positive impact** on people's lives
and on the planet.

That is why we work every day to achieve better and more sustainable materials, incorporating new
ways to manufacture **more efficient and environmentally friendly products** that generate less
waste and consume fewer resources.

## Dynamism and flexibility

A solution for each case.

We develop high-performance technical foams designed for comfort and well-being that meet the
highest quality standards and **combine them to create more sophisticated products** for our
customers.

From the initial idea to the final product, our team focuses on offering **customized solutions for
each specific need.**

## Our progess in INNOVATION

At Zahonero, we firmly believe that the keys to forging new routes and advancing toward our
long-term objectives are innovation and passion. These are a few of our innovations that came about
as a consequence of research done in our own facilities.

## Comfort certified in ourLABORATORY

At Zahonero, we rely on our own laboratories to test all of our materials and products and ensure
that they meet the necessary standards for quality and the most recent laws.

## About our work,OUR PROCESS

Since we produce specialized foams for a variety of markets, we are able to suggest novel concepts
and cutting-edge innovations.

Furthermore, we carry out testing to verify your product and guarantee optimal production
efficiency.

## Our commitment to **Sustainability**

Shifting to environmentally friendly materials and manufacturing techniques for foam solutions in
order to minimize our impact on the environment.

# Laboratory

At Zahonero, we count on our own laboratories where we test all our products and materials to
guarantee that they comply with the required quality and the current regulations.

## Rolling & Walkintech_

### Static comfort

#### **CLD - Dynamometric hardness | UNE EN ISO 20344**

Measures the compressive strength of the material under pressure from the sole of the foot during
walking.

### Dynamic comfort

#### **Comfort Properties - Walking | SATRA TM159**

Measures the material's ability to distribute energy over a concrete surface.

#### **Comfort Properties - On the Run | SATRA TM159**

Measures the material's ability to distribute energy over a concrete surface.

#### **Resilience | SATRA TM142**

Measures the ability of a material to return to its original state.

### Thermal comfort

#### **Water absorption | UNE EN ISO 20344**

Validates the amount of sweat it is capable of absorbing.

#### **Water desorption | UNE EN ISO 20344**

Validates the time it takes to dry.

### Durability

#### **Compression Set | ASTM D3574 TestD (70℃-50%)**

Attests to the material´s resilience in harsh circumstances.

#### **Impact Absorption | SATRA TM156**

establishes the material's service life while preserving its properties to the maximum extent
possible.

## Breathaprene_

### Elasticity

**Tearingt | UNE 53-184-90**
Attests to the material´s resilience in harsh circumstances.

**Traction at break | UNE 53-184-90**
establishes the material's service life while preserving its properties to the maximum extent
possible.

**Elongation at break | UNE 53-184-90**
Measures how much a material stretches before it tears

### Breathability

**Water absorption | UNE EN ISO 20344**
Validates the amount of sweat it is able to absorb.

**Water desorption | UNE EN ISO 20344**
Validates the time it takes to dry.

**Permeability | UNE EN ISO 20344**
Calculates the ability of the surface to allow air to pass through.

### Durability

#### **Abrasion resistance | ASTM D3389-94 MB**

That the substance can endure a specific amount of friction before cracking

# Walkintech

## I+D APPLIED TO FOOT COMFORT

Our collection of orthopedic components, inserts, and shoe insoles, Walkintech, was developed using
a **biomechanical analysis of the foot. ** We make insoles with the intention of **preventing health
issues, reducing foot discomfort,** and enhancing athletic performance. Our foam solutions serve to
prolong the life of footwear and **enhance the distribution of stresses and friction** produced by
walking.

## Attributes_

## Static comfort

Defined on the basis of static tests performed on the components of the insoles.

Hardness, compression/deflection load and shock absorption tests

## Dynamic comfort

Calculated on the basis of tests that measure comfort during use.

Cfw, Cfr and resilience test

## Thermal comfort

Based on metrics that assess the materials’ breathability.

Water absorption and desorption test

## Durability

Attests to the materials´ resilience in harsh circumstances.

Compression set, dynamic compression and delamination test

## Footwear

Maximum comfort for high-impact foot areas made of any kind of material to be used with any kind of
footwear..

## Daily and sports footcare

Delays and lessens the appearance of illnesses that could develop from regular use of shoes or from
practicing sports.

## Footcare for medical conditions

By spreading pressure properly and enhancing body balance, you may maximize protection and avoid
joint pain.

# Yogamat

## THE BALANCE BETWEEN SUSTAINABILITY AND HIGH PERFORMANCE

Yogamat is our line of yoga mat foams with the perfect balance between **sustainable and high
performance** materials. The** stability, cushioning, durability, and absorption** needed for yoga
practice are provided by the foam solution. Its technical foam is designed to **absorb impact** and
thanks to its open cell structure, it is a highly breathable foam.
[ EXPLORE OUR YOGA MAT CATALOG ][70]

## Attributes_

## Stability

Allows a high adherence to the mat and from the mat to the ground, essential for a stable and safe
practice.

Upper and lower Grip Test | GZ020 - SATRA TM 35

## Cushioning

Your wrists and joints are shielded during practice by good padding. Sufficient thickness provides
the posture with security and stability.

Resilience Test | GZ024 - ASTM D2632
Index | GZ027- IN HOUSE METHOD

## Absorption

Good sweat absorption improves grip and, consequently, stability in the most taxing poses, such as
hot yoga.

Absorption Test | UNE EN ISO 20344

## Durability

Made to withstand tearing and wear. More durability equates to higher sustainability because
extending the mat’s life reduces waste and benefits the environment.

Compression set Test | GZ010 - ASTM D 3574-03 TEST D
(22h / 70 ° C / 50% comp) Abrasion | GZ023 - ASTM D3389-94 MB
(1000 cycles / Wheel CS 17 "Taber")

## Travel mats

A narrower line to make it easier to move and more compact.

## Mats for everyday use

Solutions with a 4 mm standard thickness that guarantee comfort during prolonged use.

## Extra strength mats

With a thickness of 6 mm, our thicker option offers a solution for applications that need more
strength and stability.

# Zahonero Group_

## Driven by comfort

Manufacturers of technical foam solutions for more than half a century.

We create high-performance and sustainable materials for footwear, foot care, sporting goods, and
building acoustics.

## Engineering comfort since 1965_

## We define comfort and comfort defines us_

Since you are unable to quit, neither of us can. For almost 50 years, we have been creating and
producing high-performance foam technology to meet the needs of the most exacting customers.

Our expertise lies in identifying and verifying comfort through the creation of tailored solutions
for certain uses.

Comfort is a quantifiable reality that we build on a daily basis, not simply a feeling.

[img_pies_nino.jpg]

### International presence_

We started out in 1965 and have continued to expand ever since.

In addition to our headquarters in Alicante (Spain), we have our own factories in Brazil, Mexico,
Canada, India, Indonesia, China, and Vietnam, and sales offices in Portugal and the USA.

## Innovation

To offer additional value to the market, we search for creative ideas that go against the
conventions of the market.

We explore new components, develop new technologies, **design new processes and find new uses for
our materials,** putting our commitment to comfort to the test every day.

## Good for you and good for the planet

At Zahonero we know that it is our responsibility to make a **positive impact** on people's lives
and on the planet.

That is why we work every day to achieve better and more sustainable materials, incorporating new
ways to manufacture **more efficient and environmentally friendly products** that generate less
waste and consume fewer resources.

## Dynamism and flexibility

A solution for each case.

We develop high-performance technical foams designed for comfort and well-being that meet the
highest quality standards and **combine them to create more sophisticated products** for our
customers.

From the initial idea to the final product, our team focuses on offering **customized solutions for
each specific need.**

## Our progess in INNOVATION

At Zahonero, we firmly believe that the keys to forging new routes and advancing toward our
long-term objectives are innovation and passion. These are a few of our innovations that came about
as a consequence of research done in our own facilities.

[ > ][69]

## Comfort certified in ourLABORATORY

At Zahonero, we rely on our own laboratories to test all of our materials and products and ensure
that they meet the necessary standards for quality and the most recent laws.

[ > ][70]

## About our work,OUR PROCESS

Since we produce specialized foams for a variety of markets, we are able to suggest novel concepts
and cutting-edge innovations.

Furthermore, we carry out testing to verify your product and guarantee optimal production
efficiency.

[ > ][71]

## Our commitment to **Sustainability**

Shifting to environmentally friendly materials and manufacturing techniques for foam solutions in
order to minimize our impact on the environment.

# Our three-stage manufacturing process

Zotefoams manufactures a wide range of lightweight, cross-linked block foams using variations of our
unique nitrogen expansion manufacturing process.

**Our core foaming technology remains a key differentiator** and is highly applicable across the
industries we serve, where our scale and automation offer efficiencies and consistency at industrial
volumes.

**A unique manufacturing process**
Zotefoams produces high-performance, closed cell, crosslinked foams from common and engineering
polymers using temperature, pressure and nitrogen borrowed from the atmosphere. The combination of
foaming process and polymer performance delivers unrivalled uniform, pure, low toxicity and durable
materials with excellent fire resistance, high-temperature stability, toughness and insulation.

[Stage 1]

## Polymers and granules

### Stage 1

**Extrusion and crosslinking**
Polymer and any additives (colours, fire retardants, conductive agents) are extruded into a
continuous solid plate. The plate passes through an oven, which activates the crosslinking process.
The plate then cools and is cut into slabs.

[Stage 2]

## Semi-solid structure

### Stage 2

**Nitrogen saturation**
Slabs are loaded into a high-pressure autoclave. Operating at temperatures up to 250°C, the material
is heated above its melting point and pressurised with pure nitrogen gas. Over a long period of
time, the nitrogen gas diffuses into the slabs. A rapid depressurisation destabilises the absorbed
nitrogen nucleating cells in the slab. The slabs are then cooled under pressure in the autoclave,
locking the nitrogen in the unexpanded slabs before they are unloaded.

[Stage 3]

## Foam sheets

### Stage 3

**Expansion**
The nitrogen-charged slabs are loaded into a large lower-pressure autoclave and, under moderate
pressure, are heated to above their melting point. When the pressure is reduced, the nitrogen
expands, turning the slab into larger foam sheets. This expansion process is unconstrained and so
uniform in each dimension.

View the process

More about three-stage manufacturing

Watch the video to view each step of our unique three stage process. The combination of temperature,
pressure and nitrogen borrowed from the atmosphere ensures that our products are durable with
excellent fire resistance, and high temperature stability among other key properties.

### Our brands

### AZOTE®

Closed cell, crosslinked polyolefin high-quality foams made from different base polymers.

[AZOTE®] [Read More][116]

### Evazote®

Closed cell crosslinked ethylene copolymer foam available in a range of densities, colours and
grades.

[Evazote®] [Read More][117]

### Plastazote®

Closed cell crosslinked polyethylene foam available in different polymer combinations, densities and
colours.

[Plastazote®] [Read More][118]

### Supazote®

Closed cell crosslinked ethylene copolymer foam available in different polymer combinations,
densities and colours.

[Supazote®] [Read More][119]

### ZOTEK®

The world’s lightest closed cell crosslinked high-performance foams with outstanding Fire, Smoke and
Toxicity (FST) properties.

[ZOTEK®] [Read More][120]

### ZOTEK® F

Inherently flame retardant high-performance closed cell crosslinked fluoropolymer foam with high
dielectric strength.

[ZOTEK® F] [Read More][121]

### ZOTEK® F OSU

Lighter, cleaner more efficient foams offering unique advantages for aviation and aerospace
interiors.

[ZOTEK® F OSU] [Read More][122]

### ZOTEK® T

Tough, flexible with supreme cushioning that is ideal for high-impact military protection apparel
and high-performance sports.

[ZOTEK® T] [Read More][123]

### Ecozote®

LDPE foams with 30% recycled content. Closed cell crosslinked and low-density, the foams have
product sustainability at their core.

[Ecozote®] [Read More][124]

### T-FIT®

Unique insulation technology for cleanrooms, aseptic areas and high-temperature processing
environments.

[T-FIT®] [Read More][125]

# Our three-stage manufacturing process

Zotefoams manufactures a wide range of lightweight, cross-linked block foams using variations of our
unique nitrogen expansion manufacturing process.

**Our core foaming technology remains a key differentiator** and is highly applicable across the
industries we serve, where our scale and automation offer efficiencies and consistency at industrial
volumes.

**A unique manufacturing process**
Zotefoams produces high-performance, closed cell, crosslinked foams from common and engineering
polymers using temperature, pressure and nitrogen borrowed from the atmosphere. The combination of
foaming process and polymer performance delivers unrivalled uniform, pure, low toxicity and durable
materials with excellent fire resistance, high-temperature stability, toughness and insulation.

[Stage 1]

## Polymers and granules

### Stage 1

**Extrusion and crosslinking**
Polymer and any additives (colours, fire retardants, conductive agents) are extruded into a
continuous solid plate. The plate passes through an oven, which activates the crosslinking process.
The plate then cools and is cut into slabs.

[Stage 2]

## Semi-solid structure

### Stage 2

**Nitrogen saturation**
Slabs are loaded into a high-pressure autoclave. Operating at temperatures up to 250°C, the material
is heated above its melting point and pressurised with pure nitrogen gas. Over a long period of
time, the nitrogen gas diffuses into the slabs. A rapid depressurisation destabilises the absorbed
nitrogen nucleating cells in the slab. The slabs are then cooled under pressure in the autoclave,
locking the nitrogen in the unexpanded slabs before they are unloaded.

[Stage 3]

## Foam sheets

### Stage 3

**Expansion**
The nitrogen-charged slabs are loaded into a large lower-pressure autoclave and, under moderate
pressure, are heated to above their melting point. When the pressure is reduced, the nitrogen
expands, turning the slab into larger foam sheets. This expansion process is unconstrained and so
uniform in each dimension.

# Executive Leadership Team

## Dan Lumpkin

## Managing Director, North America

## Joined Zotefoams

June 2022

## Skills

A seasoned leader in North American operations with expertise in customer partnerships, operational
scalability, and premium product delivery. Adept at enhancing lead times and product quality, while
driving growth through deep customer relationships and excellence in service delivery.

## Experience

Dan Lumpkin joined Zotefoams in June 2022 as Managing Director, North America. He leads operations
from key facilities in Walton, Kentucky, and Tulsa, Oklahoma overseeing all aspects of regional
responsibility, from production and distribution to customer experience and strategic engagement.
Dan’s focus is on expanding capabilities to deliver premium foams in new forms, with shorter lead
times, and consistently high-quality output.

Prior to Zotefoams, Dan held senior leadership roles in manufacturing and materials businesses. He
was Vice President of Operations at Pregis Corporation, a leader in packaging and protective
solutions, where he drove operational excellence, scaled capacity, and improved supply chain
performance. Earlier in his career, Dan worked at GE Aviation, gaining experience in highly
technical, regulated manufacturing environments and developing a strong foundation in process
discipline, quality, and team leadership.

Across his career, Dan has built a reputation for strengthening customer partnerships, leading
organisational growth, and delivering operational improvements that enhance both service quality and
profitability.

## Responsibilities
* Leading our North American business, with operations based in Walton, KY and Tulsa, OK
* Driving growth through partnerships with our customers and a world class customer experience and
partnerships
* Expanding our capabilities to deliver our premium products in new forms with shorter lead times
and best in class quality

# Our History

## 100 Years of Innovation
## 100 Years of History

Zotefoams has a rich and vibrant history spanning more than 100 years that starts in the uk with
tyres and rubber and moves through innovation into new products and global markets.

[Placeholder]

### Zotefoams is the direct descendant of onazote limited, which was founded by charles marshall in
### 1921 when he patented a process to manufacture hard and soft expanded rubbers.

He was inspired by the work of three Austrian brothers - Hans, Fritz and Herman Pfleumer - who
conceived the concept of filling tyres with an expanded lightweight material, rather than air.

Although the concept of the puncture-proof automotive tyre was unsuccessful, the experimentation
highlighted the potential of this novel material for a multitude of applications.
