## 1920s - 1930s

### The search for optimal materials

The letter is from Charles Marshall to T Wall and Sons, who were developing their ice cream
business.

Marshall registered the trademark Onazote in Great Britain and the USA. The name is believed to be
derived from the words ebonite – hardened rubber – and **azote**, the French word for nitrogen.

In 1925, the company was renamed The Expanded Rubber Company Limited, with Onazote remaining as a
brand name. That same year saw the first recorded use of Onazote for refrigeration.

In 1927, the company moved from its original north London home to the 50,000sq.ft Palace of Arts in
Wembley, which was originally constructed for the 1924-25 British Empire Exhibition.

Early picture of Mitcham Road, Croydon. And, Henry Neal Shelmerdine (above) was put in charge of the
company re-organisation in 1938.

#### Success Beckons

In 1935 the company moved to a former cable works in Mitcham Road, Croydon, where Zotefoams
headquarters and main manufacturing site are still located today.

With commercial success still proving elusive, ownership of the company passed to the St Helens
Cable and Rubber Company in 1938. This marked a turning point, with a new Managing Director, Henry
Shelmerdine, entrusted with reorganising and equipping the business.

Within a year, production was steady at half a ton (over 500kg) per week of Onazote and Rubazote -
hard and soft expanded rubber. Insulation in food industry applications and seals and gaskets were
key markets.

Prosperity followed, and the new management team was able to convince government departments that
the company and its materials were to be relied upon.

## 1940s - 1950s

### Innovation and Expansion in support Of the nation

During the 1940s, the Expanded Rubber Company produced 1.5 million m2 of Aerozote, used to line
self-sealing fuel tanks. Opening of Expanded Rubber Company Dundee factory, by the late Sir Stafford
Cripps 1945.

**Wartime saw a rapid increase in demand for Onazote and Rubazote, primarily in marine buoyancy and
aviation applications.**

Shelmerdine's drive and initiative was fully tested in the service of the nation. New processes were
developed for making a special soft rubber - Aerozote- used for self-sealing aircraft fuel tanks.

New factories were opened in Slough and Dundee, to manufacture defence products such as booms and
trailing cables, insulation for military containers and, most intriguingly, superstructures for
midget submarines.

With global supply chains impacted by the conflict, the company's most vital raw material, natural
rubber, was in desperately short supply.

That challenge was a driver for innovation and an early indicator of the search for optimal
materials that is the hallmark of modern-day Zotefoams.

Granules of FUF, driven by studio wind machines, provided the realistic blizzard effects for the
iconic film, Scott of the Antarctic.

Developments included Formvar, an expanded vinyl with great impact strength, and FUF - expanded
urea-formaldehyde resin. This looked like snow and was used to create the blizzard effects in the
famous 1948 adventure film Scott of the Antarctic.

This early work in exploring the potential of expanded plastics attracted the interest of BX
Plastics Limited, which acquired the Expanded Rubber Company in 1943, subsequently transferring
ownership in 1948 to parent company the British Xylonite Company Limited.

Onazote lifejacket approved by the Ministry of Transport. Vickers Valiant with nose radome made from
Onazote.

#### A World Of Applications

In the early 1950s the Expanded Rubber Company was the largest company in the world completely
engaged in the manufacture of expanded materials.

The Sales Department was expanded, new equipment and a new laboratory installed and agents appointed
in all major industrial nations.

With a secure supply of rubber now available, Onazote and Rubazote were once again the main
products, but growth was also supported by innovation. A sponge rubber - Zote - was promoted
alongside a microcellular shoe soling material, while Rubacurl (a complementary product to Rubazote)
bonded lightweight latex with hair to give extra strength in product protection applications.

## 1960s - 1970s

### Introducing Plastazote^{®} and Evazote^{®}
### - and the end of rubber

Jensen Company specified Plastazote^{®} for its impact/energy absorption.

**In 1962, Plastazote^{®} was launched. This now-iconic brand, the foundation of the AZOTE^{®}
polyolefin foams, is produced from polyethylene and used in a vast range of applications.**

In its infancy, Plastazote was in great demand for medical and healthcare applications, such as neck
and body splints, orthotics and limb supports. This was thanks to the purity of the materials,
derived from the unique three-stage manufacturing process.

1968 saw the introduction of Evazote^{®} EVA copolymer foam, a further world-class product, boasting
additional toughness and resilience.

Plastazote was specified by famous brands such as the Jensen Company, which used the material for
impact and energy absorption in its revered Interceptor.

Rubazote was discontinued

The success of Plastazote and Evazote, together with difficult trading conditions, led to the
decision in 1974 to cease production of rubber materials. The expanded polystyrene business was also
sold, enabling BXL to focus on the potential of Plastazote and Evazote.

By the end of the 1970s, demand for these materials resulted in four-shift working. The company was
acquired by British Petroleum (BP) in 1978 and remained part of the Chemicals division for the next
15 years. This was a period of significant investment in modern production machinery to meet
increasing demand and broaden the product range. Plastazote LD24, at the time the lightest foam of
its type in the world, was launched in 1984, opening up many new applications.

When Rubazote was finally discontinued, it had been in production for nearly 40 years.

## 1980s - 1990s

### A New Era And The Birth Of Zotefoams Plc

In 1981 Platazote was singled out for special recognition when the Duke of Edinburgh (right)
presented the company with a gold medal in recognition of the contribution made by Plastazote foam
in the service of mankind.

**1981, Plastazote^{®} achieved royal recognition when it received the Prince Philip Award for
polymers in the service of mankind. The Award was presented by its namesake, a champion of British
technology and industry.**

The next decade saw continuing growth and success on the global stage, firmly establishing
Plastazote and Evazote^{®} as the world's leading technical foam brands.

In 1992 a management buyout established Zotefoams Limited; this was followed by a flotation on the
London Stock Exchange (ZTF:LON) in 1995, which gave birth to Zotefoams plc.

International growth continued following the flotation, with the establishment of a North American
sales subsidiary, Zotefoams Inc, to meet rapidly growing demand with local service.

## 2000s

### The High-Performance Decade

New headquarters, manufacturing and R&D buildings were built in the UK.

**As the new millennium dawned, opportunities and optimism were abundant - but on the night of
October 22, 2000, a fire at the Mitcham Road site caused damage running into millions of pounds and
destroyed a third of the factory.**

No cause was ever identified but, as the company rebuilt, safety was, and remains to this day, the
primary consideration.

In the aftermath of the fire, the management team, then led by Group CEO David Stirling, reassessed
the prospects for the business. The development of the ZOTEK^{®} High-Performance Products (HPP)
portfolio traces its origins back to that time, with the decision to leverage the capabilities of
the three-stage process for new, advanced materials. These unique materials would meet demanding
regulatory and application requirements, using Zotefoams' technology and knowhow.

Rebuilding in the UK, the company completed new headquarters, manufacturing and R&D buildings.

# INNOVATION IS IN OUR DNA

EXPANDING OUR INNOVATION CAPABILITIES

### **Innovation in advanced foam materials has always been at the heart of the Zotefoams business
### model.** For over 100 years, we have pioneered the development of uniquely sustainable materials
### using supercritical fluid foaming technology.

**What is supercritical fluid foaming?**
The principle of foaming using supercritical fluids is simple: we borrow an inert gas from the
atmosphere and turn this into a supercritical fluid which we dissolve into a polymer. Then, under
controlled conditions, we allow the fluid trapped in the polymer to return into a gas state which,
in doing so, expands the polymer into a foam. This process requires significant know-how around both
the equipment and the materials to produce good-quality foams efficiently. Both nitrogen (N2) and
carbon dioxide (CO2) can be used as the supercritical fluid because they are inert, non-toxic and
easily recoverable. This eliminates the need for chemical foaming agents, produces products of
equivalent performance using less raw material and consumes fewer resources, while also creating
lighter, more durable foams. We primarily use nitrogen in our processes – not only is it the most
environmentally friendly option, but it also produces unparalleled product performance
characteristics.

**A hub-and-spoke approach to innovation**
To accelerate the impact of innovation, we are adopting a hub and spoke model:

_UK Innovation Centre of Excellence (hub)a dedicated centre focused on developing platform
technologies that drive long-term innovation
_ Market-focused Innovation Centres (spokes): embedded centres tailored to specific industries,
ensuring that innovation is customer-centric and directly aligned with market needs.

This model ensures that our innovation pipeline is both strategic and agile, combining cutting-edge
technology development with real-world applications in key markets.

## Picking the right projects

The key to successful innovation lies in choosing the right opportunities. By embedding our
market-focused Innovation Centres within strategic growth areas – Consumer & Lifestyle, Transport &
Smart Technologies, Construction & Other Industrial Applications – we ensure that our effort is
targeted where we have a deep expertise and a strong right to win.

Working alongside academic institutions, raw material suppliers and equipment manufacturers, our UK
Innovation Centre of Excellence will develop breakthrough technologies that can be efficiently
implemented through our market-specific Innovation Centres.

## Footwear Innovation Centre

One of our most exciting innovations is in footwear technology, where we are redefining performance,
efficiency and sustainability.

To support this, the first Innovation Centre that we will launch will be our Footwear Innovation
Centre in South Korea, located near our key customer and their Tier 1 manufacturing partners. This
proximity will allow us to work directly with customers, implementing new developments into specific
shoe models.

**Breakthrough technologies**
By combining localised innovation with cutting-edge materials science, we can collaborate more
effectively to develop sustainable footwear solutions across a range of polymers.

**Recent major advancements include**:
3D foam midsole: eliminates over 90% of waste compared with traditional processes.

## Expanding our capabilities

Our UK Innovation Centre of Excellence, independent from production facilities, will drive our
technology leadership while safeguarding our intellectual property.

With over 100 years of supercritical fluid foam experience, we are now expanding our capability
beyond raw materials to deliver fully engineered solutions to our customers.

## Digital Transformation and Sustainability Focus

**Digital Transformation**

We are harnessing the power of AI to accelerate development cycles, reducing time to market for our
next generations solutions.

**Sustainability Focus **

Our focus is on sustainable innovation – both enhancing existing technologies and developing new
solutions to reduce energy consumption, emissions and waste across the entire value chain. Shaping
the future of foam technology At Zotefoams, innovation is not just about staying ahead; it’s about
leading the way. Our investment in sustainable, high-performance materials ensures that we remain
the preferred partner for industries looking to push the boundaries of lightweight, durable and
sustainable materials.

By placing innovation at the heart of our business model, we don’t just respond to market shifts; we
define them.

Thriving in a lower carbon economy

### Four aspects of our business enable us to **support our customers in meeting their
### sustainability goals**.

[Efficient use of raw material]

Efficient use of raw material

Our technology and innovation deliver foam products that have a better performance per unit of
weight. We use less material with integrity and durability that do not need to be frequently
replaced.

[Avoiding emissions]

Avoiding emissions

Zotefoams products are used in ways that reduce emissions and conserve scarce resources. These
include thermal insulation, and lightweight packaging to protect products in transit and replace
heavier alternative materials.

[Natural nitrogen-based process]

Natural nitrogen-based process

Our core high-pressure autoclave foaming process uses nitrogen borrowed from the atmosphere. Energy
and raw material become the only environmental impact.

[New Product Development]

New Product Development

We develop lighter, more efficient, less wasteful, longer life products – including the world’s
lightest closed cell crosslinked foam. We continuously innovate and design sustainable products that
support circular models.

Development Goals

### **Zotefoams** supports the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and have aligned a
### number of our processes and activities to these.

[Good Health & Wellbeing]

#### Good Health & Wellbeing

Zotefoams promotes Health and Well-being throughout our business practices, with strong Health &
Safety metrics that are monitored using the SASB risk management framework and robust HR policies
and programmes around mental health and well-being.

[Quality Education]

#### Quality Education

Zotefoams believes in continuous education and development which are reflected in a number of our
programmes, such as our Apprenticeship Levy, Graduate scheme and Summer placements.

[Clean Water & Sanitization]

#### Clean Water & Sanitization

Zotefoams works on best practices to ensure we sustainably manage our water and sanitation methods.
We have implemented a number of processes to improve the water quality in our operations to ensure
that no water with chemicals seeps into the environment, and we run a number of initiatives like our
Rainwater harvesting system.

[Decent Work & Economic Growth]

#### Decent Work & Economic Growth

Zotefoams have strict auditing processes to ensure we uphold decent and fair standards of work
across our Group and our supply chain, including identifying risks of modern slavery and child
labour, and fair wage and worker rights.

[Industry, Innovation & Infrastructure]

#### Industry, Innovation & Infrastructure

Our innovative products support our customers sustainability goals and the markets they operate in.
Zotefoams have strict practices in place to ensure fairness in Gender Pay and Diversity & Inclusion.
This is reflected in our ESG report.

[Climate Action]

#### Climate Action

Our business model is centred around sustainability. Our approach centres on two areas: (i)
minimising the use of natural resources through a series of internal measures aimed at reducing our
carbon footprint; and (ii) operating in markets where we offer a unique sustainable advantage to
benefit society through resource efficiencies.

[Climate Action]

#### Climate Action

Zotefoams are focused on minimizing our impact on the environment. We annually submit to the Carbon
Disclosure Project (CDP) and comply to the TCFD framework. We have conducted our TNFD analysis for
2024 and have a Carbon Reduction Plan in place based on a 2024 baseline.

Zotefoams embed ESG practices throughout the business, from our operations and innovation, to how we
engage with our employees, and throughout our supply chain.

Managing our responsibilities towards ESG issues contributes to our long-term commitment to creating
value for our customers, while safeguarding the future of the business.

# Executive Leadership Team

## Emma Woollard

## General Counsel & Company Secretary

Emma leads the Group’s legal, governance and regulatory compliance activities, advising the Board
and Group Executive Team and overseeing the management of legal and regulatory risk. Her role
focuses on supporting effective decision‑making and maintaining a robust legal and governance
framework aligned with the Group’s strategic priorities and long‑term value creation.

## Joined Zotefoams

December 2025

## Skills

Accomplished Chartered Company Secretary with extensive experience supporting UK listed companies
through complex governance, regulatory and strategic matters. Highly skilled in corporate reporting,
Board and Committee operations, shareholder engagement, UK Market Abuse Regulations, and the design
and oversight of robust risk, compliance and ESG frameworks.

## Experience

Emma brings deep experience as a senior company secretarial professional, having supported boards
and executive teams across listed company environments. Prior to joining Zotefoams, she served as
Group Company Secretary at Debenhams Group, where she led governance activities and oversaw an
FCA-regulated subsidiary. Her background spans corporate reporting, effective Board and Committee
governance, shareholder engagement and the application of UK MAR, with a strong focus on embedding
high standards of transparency, integrity and regulatory compliance aligned to business strategy.

## Responsibilities
* Managing our corporate governance and regulatory compliance
* Supporting the Group executive team in fulfilling its obligations

# Executive Leadership Team

## Brandon Thomas

## Managing Director, Asia

Brandon leads the Group’s Asia strategy, supporting the development and scale‑up of manufacturing,
innovation and commercial capability in the region. He plays a central role in executing the Group’s
growth plans across Asia.

## Joined Zotefoams

July 2025

## Skills

A strategic leader with deep experience in manufacturing partnerships and international operations,
particularly across the athletic footwear sector. Skilled in building supplier relationships,
scaling global operations, and delivering commercial value through innovation and efficiency. Brings
a unique perspective from both customer and supplier sides of the footwear industry.

## Experience

Brandon brings a wealth of international experience and a unique customer-side perspective that
strengthens Zotefoams’ position in the global athletic footwear industry and reinforces the
company’s foothold in Asia for future growth opportunities.

Before joining Zotefoams, Brandon served as General Manager, Asia at Nike, based in Vietnam. In this
role, he played a central part in shaping Nike’s manufacturing partnerships across Asia, with a
strong focus on supplier collaboration and unlocking mutual value. His earlier career spans senior
roles in finance and strategic planning within the biotechnology and entertainment industries,
including time with The Walt Disney Company, where he developed expertise in global business
operations and commercial strategy.

## Responsibilities
* Lead the development, construction, and scale up of the future Vietnam manufacturing site focused
on serving our consumer & lifestyle market.
* Support in servicing our key footwear customers.
* Support in the establishment of the Korea footwear development centre.

# Executive Leadership Team

## Oliver Ridd

## Group Commercial Director

Oliver leads the Group’s global commercial organisation, aligning sales, marketing and application
engineering resources around priority markets. He is responsible for strengthening customer
relationships, pipeline quality and commercial execution across regions.

## Joined Zotefoams

November 2024

## Skills

A decisive commercial leader with strong market acumen, driving customer-centric strategies across
global markets. Skilled in aligning revenue growth with strategic innovation and industry-specific
solutions.

## Experience

With a solid technical background in materials science, Oliver advanced to senior director level in
a FTSE 250 PLC, holding commercial and transformational leadership roles that have enabled global
market access, boosted sales performance, and increased market share. He has a proven record of
turning around underperforming businesses through top-down transformation, introducing sales
excellence initiatives, alternative operating models, and organisational restructuring while
achieving multimillion-pound EBITDA uplift and record regional profits.

Experienced in managing culturally diverse teams across multiple territories, Oliver places strong
emphasis on developing people, fostering integrity and transparency, and driving positive
behavioural change. He is a committed advocate of product innovation, working closely with sales and
operations to connect market needs with development opportunities. His extensive international
network and strategic insight have supported business scaling, transformation, and the attainment of
ambitious commercial objectives throughout his career.

## Responsibilities
* Leading the global commercial organisation, capturing growth opportunities across our priority
industries
* Driving a customer-centric business model to enhance our customer experience
* Developing a best in class commercial function, with a unified global approach

# Executive Leadership Team

## Simon Jones

## Managing Director, North American & EMEA + Global Supply Chain Director

Simon leads the Group’s operations across Europe, the Middle East and North America, with
responsibility for operational performance, customer delivery and supply chain execution. He plays a
key role in aligning manufacturing capability with market demand and supporting consistent execution
across regions.

## Joined Zotefoams

January 2025

## Skills

Strategic operational leader with deep expertise in supply chain management, quality assurance, and
new product introduction. Adept at ensuring health and safety across regional operations while
enhancing customer service and market delivery across North America and EMEA.

## Experience

Prior to joining Zotefoams, Simon built a career as an executive operations leader in highly
technical medical, chemical, and industrial markets, holding senior positions with full global P&L
responsibility in organisations with sales exceeding £100m. He has extensive experience in shaping
business strategy and transforming performance across complex, multi-site operations and supply
chains of over 700 people, as well as leading B2B commercial organisations generating more than £30m
in sales.

Recognised for his ability to deliver across diverse challenges, Simon has scaled start-ups to
commercial success, executed turnarounds in underperforming businesses, and driven step-change
improvements in culture and performance. His leadership track record includes building
high-performing teams, embedding operational discipline, and delivering sustainable improvements in
profitability and customer service across international markets.

## Responsibilities
* The delivery and growth of the North America & EMEA region across our regional and global customer
base from our manufacturing sites in the US, UK, Poland and China.
* Our global focus on ensuring the health and safety of everyone at Zotefoams
* The continuous improvement and global efficiency of our Global Supply Chain functions
incorporating Quality, Procurement and New Product Introduction (NPI)

# Who we are

Pioneers in supercritical foams

About Zotefoams

We deliver optimal solutions for the benefit of society. Produced with our unique manufacturing
process, our materials are used in diverse markets worldwide.

[Discover Our Markets][114]
[The Zotefoams Difference]

The Zotefoams Difference

Advanced materials that deliver enhanced performance and safely while using less foam.

[World leader]

World leader

A long history of more than a century and a legacy of working with our customers to develop
innovative and unique products.

[Global presence]

Global presence

An international business with manufacturing facilities and commercial operations in the UK, Europe,
North America and Asia.

Our unique process

Three-stage manufacturing

High-performance closed cell crosslinked foams are formed using temperature, pressure and nitrogen
borrowed from the atmosphere. The combination of foaming process and polymer performance delivers
excellent fire resistance, high temperature stability, toughness and insulation.

[ Find out about our three-stage process ][115]

relevant_companies.company_summary: Covestro AG is a leading global manufacturer of high-performance polymer materials, specializing in innovative solutions for various industries, including automotive, construction, and electronics. The company is committed to sustainability and circular economy principles, offering a range of products such as bio-based aniline, renewable hardeners, and advanced coatings. With a strong focus on research and development, Covestro aims to drive progress in material science and contribute to a more sustainable future.

# Welcome to Covestro!

We are a world-leading manufacturer of high-quality polymer materials. With innovative products,
processes and methods, we improve quality of life and drive our vision to become fully circular.
_crawl.linkedin_about: Covestro is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of high-quality polymer materials and their components. With its innovative products, processes and methods, the company helps enhance sustainability and the quality of life in many areas. Covestro supplies customers around the world in key industries such as mobility, building and living, as well as the electrical and electronics sector. In addition, polymers from Covestro are also used in sectors such as sports and leisure, telecommunications and health, as well as in the chemical industry itself. The company is geared completely to the circular economy. In addition, Covestro aims to achieve climate neutrality for its Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions by 2035, and the Group’s Scope 3 emissions are also set to be climate neutral by 2050. Covestro generated sales of EUR 14.2 billion in fiscal year 2024. At the end of 2024, the company had 46 production sites worldwide and employed approximately 17,500 people (calculated as full-time equivalents). Data protection information: https://www.covestro.com/en/social-media-privacy-statements

## Enriching Lives Through Innovation

### Huntsman embraces the entrepreneurial spirit of our founder, Jon Huntsman, and his core values
### of honesty, integrity, respect and responsibility.

For 50 years, our employees have been using science and ingenuity to create innovations that play a
critical role in the everyday lives of many millions of people.

As a global chemicals company, Huntsman’s work forms the building blocks for countless consumer and
industrial products that are part of your everyday life.

Our employees are united around a common goal: enriching lives through innovation.

## Our Business Divisions

Huntsman is comprised of three divisions, each of which has in-depth expertise in specific
chemistries and technologies and leading positions in the markets they serve.

#### Polyurethanes

Polyurethanes is a leading global producer of MDI-based polyurethanes focused on formulating
innovative, differentiated products for key downstream markets, including energy-saving insulation,
lightweighting and performance materials for automotive, comfort foam for bedding and furniture,
protective coatings, adhesives, and elastomers for footwear.

[View Division][93]

#### Advanced Materials

Advanced Materials provides specialty epoxy, acrylic and polyurethane-based polymer resin systems
and adhesive products, which are replacing traditional materials in aircraft, automobiles and
electrical power transmission. These products are also used in coatings, construction materials,
circuit boards and sports equipment.

[View Division][94]

#### Performance Products

Performance Products offers products that provide useful properties in everyday items people want
and need. Our leading global positions in the manufacture and sale of amines, maleic anhydride and
carbonates enable us to serve diverse consumer and industrial end markets, including energy,
automotive and transportation, coatings and adhesives, building and construction, electronics and
industrial manufacturing.

[View Division][95]

## Providing Solutions to Customers’ Challenges

We work in deep partnership with our customers to create solutions that help make people’s lives
more sustainable, effective, and comfortable. Our products are used in a diverse range of consumer
and industrial end markets, including aerospace, automotive and transportation, building and
construction, energy, as well as textiles and footwear.

[View Markets][96]

[View All News][100]

## Discover our global presence

We operate more than 60 manufacturing, research and development, and operations facilities in
approximately 25 countries and employ approximately 6,000 associates. Our global headquarters is in
The Woodlands, Texas, just north of Houston.

[View Locations][101]

## Enabling a Sustainable World

We see chemistry as a means of solving some of the most pressing societal challenges of our time.
Guided by our support of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and coupled with care for
our neighbors, we create products and innovations to help meet the world’s growing demands for food,
water, energy and opportunity. Learn about our journey to become a more sustainable business.

[View Sustainability][102]

## Huntsman’s History

The Huntsman Corporation was initially founded as the Huntsman Container Corporation in 1970 by Jon
Huntsman. Our company has grown through a series of acquisitions (with some divestitures). We went
public on the New York Stock Exchange in February 2005. Read more about our history and growth over
the decades.

[View History][103]

## Help inspire our innovations

The ingenuity and commitment of our employees drives innovations across a wide array of markets and
applications, enriching the lives of millions of people across the world. Our people-centered
company offers incredible opportunities for those prepared to take responsibility for their future.
Get started today!

## Enriching Lives Through Innovation

### Huntsman embraces the entrepreneurial spirit of our founder, Jon Huntsman, and his core values
### of honesty, integrity, respect and responsibility.

For 50 years, our employees have been using science and ingenuity to create innovations that play a
critical role in the everyday lives of many millions of people.

As a global chemicals company, Huntsman’s work forms the building blocks for countless consumer and
industrial products that are part of your everyday life.

Our employees are united around a common goal: enriching lives through innovation.

## Our Business Divisions

Huntsman is comprised of three divisions, each of which has in-depth expertise in specific
chemistries and technologies and leading positions in the markets they serve.

#### Polyurethanes

Polyurethanes is a leading global producer of MDI-based polyurethanes focused on formulating
innovative, differentiated products for key downstream markets, including energy-saving insulation,
lightweighting and performance materials for automotive, comfort foam for bedding and furniture,
protective coatings, adhesives, and elastomers for footwear.

[View Division][93]

#### Advanced Materials

Advanced Materials provides specialty epoxy, acrylic and polyurethane-based polymer resin systems
and adhesive products, which are replacing traditional materials in aircraft, automobiles and
electrical power transmission. These products are also used in coatings, construction materials,
circuit boards and sports equipment.

[View Division][94]

#### Performance Products

Performance Products offers products that provide useful properties in everyday items people want
and need. Our leading global positions in the manufacture and sale of amines, maleic anhydride and
carbonates enable us to serve diverse consumer and industrial end markets, including energy,
automotive and transportation, coatings and adhesives, building and construction, electronics and
industrial manufacturing.

[View Division][95]

## Providing Solutions to Customers’ Challenges

We work in deep partnership with our customers to create solutions that help make people’s lives
more sustainable, effective, and comfortable. Our products are used in a diverse range of consumer
and industrial end markets, including aerospace, automotive and transportation, building and
construction, energy, as well as textiles and footwear.

We see chemistry as a means of solving some of the most pressing societal challenges of our time.
Guided by our support of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and coupled with care for
our neighbors, we create products and innovations to help meet the world’s growing demands for food,

The Huntsman Corporation was initially founded as the Huntsman Container Corporation in 1970 by Jon

* ### Polyurethanes
* [Overview][94]
* [News][95]
* [PU for a Better Life][96]

Huntsman Polyurethanes is a global leader in MDI-based polyurethanes, serving over 3,000 customers
in more than 90 countries. We have world-scale production facilities in the US, the Netherlands and
China, and a global network of more than 30 downstream formulation facilities which are located
close to our customers, providing highly differentiated, tailored solutions.

Polyurethane (PU) is one of the most versatile polymers available and can be used to create rigid
and flexible foams, thermoplastic urethanes (TPUs), coatings, adhesives, sealants and elastomers.
This versatility sees it being used in widespread applications across multiple industries.

Polyurethanes play a critical role in addressing many of the global megatrends affecting the world
today. As the most effective thermal insulant in the market, MDI-based polyurethane is widely used
to deliver energy savings solutions in residential and commercial buildings. It is used throughout
the cold chain, in refrigerators and cold stores, helping preserve food.

Our lightweight composite materials improve the fuel efficiency of automobiles and forms of
transportation; our coatings and TPUs provide protection and extend the life of many different
products and applications; and our flexible cushioning foams provide superior comfort and enhance
wellbeing. These are but a few examples of the benefits our products and solutions provide.

## Key Applications

### Automation, Robotics and Engineering

Our PU and TPU elastomers and casting machines are used across industries to create components and
technical parts for a range of applications. Our materials make a difference to the performance of
parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying equipment – supporting the growth of smart factories and
automation.

[ Learn More ][108]

### Automotive and Transportation

Huntsman has a long and successful track record of delivering innovative MDI-based polyurethanes
solutions for automotive and transportation applications, including acoustics, seating and composite
materials. Sustainability in both manufacturing and vehicle performance is critical in the
automotive industry, and Huntsman’s polyurethanes make an important contribution to this goal: from
light-weighting materials that improve fuel efficiency, to bio-based products and comfort enhancing
foams. Our technical experts are ready to help solve complex design issues with differentiated,
bespoke, cost effective solutions.

[ Learn More ][109]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods –
from the refrigerated processing plants to the insulated storage warehouses and walk-in freezers, to
refrigerated transport vehicles, storage pods and grocery store freezers.

From grocery stores to consumers’ dining tables, our foams are used in cool boxes and domestic
refrigerators to keep food fresh and tasty.

[ Learn More ][110]

### Building and Construction

Hunstman offers a wide range of MDI-based polyurethanes products that are used in building,
construction and infrastructure applications. MDI-based polyurethane is the most effective insulant
available in the market and so is widely used to provide energy saving solutions in residential and
commercial buildings. Polyurethane insulation is used in roofs, interior and exterior walls, floors,
doors and ceiling cavities, pipes, as well as building exterior applications, in both new and
retrofit construction projects. Our insulation products also increase a building’s air quality,
reduce moisture infiltration, and make buildings stronger and quieter.

The outstanding thermal insulation qualities of MDI-based polyurethane foam have seen its use in
district heating systems – where it insulates the huge pipes that are used to transport energy –
increase significantly in recent years.

Huntsman is a pioneer in composite wood products, including medium-density fiberboard, particleboard
and oriented strand board, which are produced using MDI resins. Composite wood products are used in
building and construction to replace steel joists and beams.

Our MDI-based coatings are used to seal floors, decks and driveways, providing protection and
extending the life of the surface. And our thermoplastic polyurethanes (TPUs) are used to protect
cables and wires in residential, commercial and industrial buildings.

[ Learn More ][111]

### Elastomers

We have an extensive portfolio of hot- and cold-cast elastomers, hot casting machines and
thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific needs. Our
innovation is focused on addressing key industry trends and drivers, including automation,
sustainability, energy conservation, comfort and health, safety and mobility.

[ Learn More ][112]

### Electronics

Huntsman’s thermoplastic polyurethanes (TPUs) are widely used in a variety of consumer electronics,
due to their excellent durability, flexibility, pleasant haptics, soft touch and grip – from the
household wiring that runs low-amp domestic appliances to the molded parts found in your TV,
computers and hand-held devices. Additionally, TPUs can be found in cable power systems, protective
cases, printed circuit boards and other technical parts used in medical, technology, smart fabrics,
wearables, IoT (Internet of Things) and other consumer electronic devices, including plasma screens,
mobile phones, smart watches, tablets and laptops. Other TPU characteristics include scratch,
abrasion and impact resistance, good vibration absorption and chemical resistance. TPUs can also be
formulated for specific functionality such as flame retardancy, anti-static or conductive,
transparency and matte finish.

[ Learn More ][113]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane and solutions help
footwear companies get to market faster. To meet the high demands and rapidly changing trends in
the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on sustainable solutions, automation,
customization and smart manufacturing. We fully formulated grades and tailor-made systems, building
partnerships with our customers based on knowledge, trust and experience. With locations around the
world, our international network of footwear specialists combines global reach with local
knowledge.

[ Learn More ][114]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are the key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam,
a highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
Within the polyurethane formulated systems, our pioneering JEFFCAT^{®} catalysts provide emissions
reduction, performance and power for polyester, polyether and viscoelastic applications.

Our innovative formaldehyde-free MDI resins deliver significant improvements in the production and
performance of furniture-grade Medium Density Fiberboard (MDF), High Density Fiberboard (HDF) and
Particleboard (PB), that are widely used in furniture production for the home and the office.

[ Learn More ][115]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman’s TPUs are widely used in the manufacture of sports and leisure goods, helping fitness
enthusiasts lead an active, healthy life, and professional athletes train and perform at their
highest level. Elastic, durable, and easy to color and print on, they can be injection molded to
create a variety of items from specialist soles and inserts for running shoes, to tactile, soft
touch, wearable, electronic fitness trackers. Equally, TPUs are ideal for extruding to create
protective films for skis, snow and wakeboard surfaces; water bladders for hydration packs; and
lightweight stretchable fabrics for athletic clothing.

[ Learn More ][116]

parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying equipment – supporting the growth of smart factories and
automation.

[ Learn More ][108]

### Automotive and Transportation

Huntsman has a long and successful track record of delivering innovative MDI-based polyurethanes
solutions for automotive and transportation applications, including acoustics, seating and composite
materials. Sustainability in both manufacturing and vehicle performance is critical in the
automotive industry, and Huntsman’s polyurethanes make an important contribution to this goal: from
light-weighting materials that improve fuel efficiency, to bio-based products and comfort enhancing
foams. Our technical experts are ready to help solve complex design issues with differentiated,
bespoke, cost effective solutions.

[ Learn More ][109]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods –
from the refrigerated processing plants to the insulated storage warehouses and walk-in freezers, to
refrigerated transport vehicles, storage pods and grocery store freezers.

From grocery stores to consumers’ dining tables, our foams are used in cool boxes and domestic
refrigerators to keep food fresh and tasty.

[ Learn More ][110]

### Building and Construction

Hunstman offers a wide range of MDI-based polyurethanes products that are used in building,
construction and infrastructure applications. MDI-based polyurethane is the most effective insulant
available in the market and so is widely used to provide energy saving solutions in residential and
commercial buildings. Polyurethane insulation is used in roofs, interior and exterior walls, floors,
doors and ceiling cavities, pipes, as well as building exterior applications, in both new and
retrofit construction projects. Our insulation products also increase a building’s air quality,
reduce moisture infiltration, and make buildings stronger and quieter.

The outstanding thermal insulation qualities of MDI-based polyurethane foam have seen its use in
district heating systems – where it insulates the huge pipes that are used to transport energy –
increase significantly in recent years.

Huntsman is a pioneer in composite wood products, including medium-density fiberboard, particleboard
and oriented strand board, which are produced using MDI resins. Composite wood products are used in
building and construction to replace steel joists and beams.

Our MDI-based coatings are used to seal floors, decks and driveways, providing protection and
extending the life of the surface. And our thermoplastic polyurethanes (TPUs) are used to protect
cables and wires in residential, commercial and industrial buildings.

[ Learn More ][111]

### Elastomers

We have an extensive portfolio of hot- and cold-cast elastomers, hot casting machines and
thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific needs. Our
innovation is focused on addressing key industry trends and drivers, including automation,
sustainability, energy conservation, comfort and health, safety and mobility.

[ Learn More ][112]

### Electronics

Huntsman’s thermoplastic polyurethanes (TPUs) are widely used in a variety of consumer electronics,
due to their excellent durability, flexibility, pleasant haptics, soft touch and grip – from the
household wiring that runs low-amp domestic appliances to the molded parts found in your TV,
computers and hand-held devices. Additionally, TPUs can be found in cable power systems, protective
cases, printed circuit boards and other technical parts used in medical, technology, smart fabrics,
wearables, IoT (Internet of Things) and other consumer electronic devices, including plasma screens,
mobile phones, smart watches, tablets and laptops. Other TPU characteristics include scratch,
abrasion and impact resistance, good vibration absorption and chemical resistance. TPUs can also be
formulated for specific functionality such as flame retardancy, anti-static or conductive,
transparency and matte finish.

[ Learn More ][113]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane and solutions help
footwear companies get to market faster. To meet the high demands and rapidly changing trends in
the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on sustainable solutions, automation,
customization and smart manufacturing. We fully formulated grades and tailor-made systems, building
partnerships with our customers based on knowledge, trust and experience. With locations around the
world, our international network of footwear specialists combines global reach with local
knowledge.

[ Learn More ][114]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are the key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam,
a highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
Within the polyurethane formulated systems, our pioneering JEFFCAT^{®} catalysts provide emissions
reduction, performance and power for polyester, polyether and viscoelastic applications.

Our innovative formaldehyde-free MDI resins deliver significant improvements in the production and
performance of furniture-grade Medium Density Fiberboard (MDF), High Density Fiberboard (HDF) and
Particleboard (PB), that are widely used in furniture production for the home and the office.

[ Learn More ][115]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman’s TPUs are widely used in the manufacture of sports and leisure goods, helping fitness
enthusiasts lead an active, healthy life, and professional athletes train and perform at their
highest level. Elastic, durable, and easy to color and print on, they can be injection molded to
create a variety of items from specialist soles and inserts for running shoes, to tactile, soft
touch, wearable, electronic fitness trackers. Equally, TPUs are ideal for extruding to create
protective films for skis, snow and wakeboard surfaces; water bladders for hydration packs; and
lightweight stretchable fabrics for athletic clothing.

[ Learn More ][116]

* ### Performance Products
* [Overview][94]
* [News][95]

Huntsman Performance Products offers products that provide useful properties in everyday items
people want and need. Our leading global positions in the manufacture and sale of amines, maleic
anhydride and carbonates enable us to serve diverse consumer and industrial end markets, including
energy, automotive and transportation, coatings and adhesives, building & construction, electronics
and industrial manufacturing. With manufacturing facilities in North America, Europe, the Middle
East and Asia, we produce and sell over 800 products to over 1,000 global customers and provide
extensive pre-and post-sales technical service support.

**Commercial Licensing**

From planning to production, our licensing team works to ensure that Huntsman's patented
technologies add value. Our core strengths in safely operating and maintaining complex chemical
processes, technology transfer and deep technical expertise, combined with a broad range of
products, applications and formulations, and global network of R&D facilities, all lend superior
foundational and strategic support for your projects.

## Key Applications

### Energy

A leader in natural gas processing technology for over 60 years, Huntsman’s amines remove
environmentally unfriendly compounds from natural gas streams. We also provide solutions to oilfield
production challenges, and our polyetheramines are critical to the production of longer, more
efficient wind energy blades.

[ Learn More ][102]

### Automotive and Transportation

Our polyetheramines, ethyleneamines and maleic anhydride increase motor oil lubricity and collect
deposits off engine surfaces where they can cause loss of efficiency and damage. Maleic anhydride is
also a key building block of unsaturated polyester resins used to produce fiberglass for automobile
bodies and boat hulls. Our polyurethane additives reduce foam odor and emissions in automotive
applications, and we are one of the world’s largest producers of high-purity cyclic carbonates used
in the production of lithium ion batteries for electric cars.

[ Learn More ][103]

### Coatings and Adhesives

We produce water-borne, solvent-borne and 100 percent solid components for coatings and adhesive
applications. These technologies provide corrosion resistance, reduced odors, enhanced durability
and pigment dispersion in automotive, marine, industrial and architectural coatings. They also
deliver desirable bonding characteristics and workability in adhesives.

[ Learn More ][104]

### Building and Construction

Our ethyleneamines form integral building blocks in asphalt emulsion, enable stronger cohesion, save
energy and costs, and allow producers to add more recycled components to their mix. Our amines also
help control the density, porosity and flow of concrete, and reduce cement particle size to create a
uniform mix. Our polyurethane catalysts bring power, speed and strength to both closed-cell and
open-cell polyurethane formulated systems, and maleic anhydride is a key building block of
unsaturated polyester resins used to produce fiberglass.

[ Learn More ][105]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

We bring together innovation and world-leading process technologies to produce high purity
E-GRADE^{®} amines, including quaternary amines and amine oxides, and solvents for formulation into
semiconductor cleans applications. We offer alternatives to TMAH and NMP to enable next generation
formulated cleans. Our high-quality carbonate electrolyte solvents are critical to the reliable
operation of lithium-ion batteries used in consumer electronics.

[ Learn More ][106]

### Industrial Manufacturing

Our maleic anhydride and broad range of amines provide enhanced performance to applications in
metalworking and paper and water treatment.

[ Learn More ][107]

## Key Technologies

## Semiconductor-grade Amines

We are a world-leading supplier of semiconductor-grade amines. Our E-GRADE^{®} portfolio provides
high-purity, low-trace metal amines, including quaternary amines, amine oxides, and solvents
essential for semiconductor chip manufacturing including formulated cleaning, etching, and
stripping. Our commitment to safety, quality, reliability, and manufacturing excellence provides a
consistent production process – from blending, purification through cleanroom packaging.

[ Learn More ][108]

## Maleic Anhydride

We are the leading global producer of maleic anhydride and the leading licensor of maleic anhydride
manufacturing technology. Maleic anhydride is a highly-versatile chemical intermediate used to
produce unsaturated polyester resins (UPR), the primary ingredient in fiberglass reinforced resins
used for marine and automotive applications, and in construction products like countertops, tubs and
sinks. Maleic anhydride is also used in the production of lubricants, food additives and artificial
sweeteners.

[ Learn More ][109]

## Polyetheramines

We are the leading global producer of polyetheramines since first developing the family of products
over 50 years ago. The JEFFAMINE®products provide sophisticated performance characteristics such as
long working times for customized epoxy formulations. Polyetheramines are used in wind blade
molding, construction and flooring, paints and coatings, fuels and lubricants, and polyurethane
foams and insulations.

[ Learn More ][110]

## Ethyleneamines

We are the leading global producer of the full range of ethyleneamines, and our heavier slate of
homologues allows us to provide a large variety of product applications such as lubricant and fuel
additives, asphalt additives, epoxy hardeners, wet strength resins, chelating agents and fungicides.

[ Learn More ][111]

## Diglycolamine Agent (DGA^{®})

We are one of the largest global producers of DIGLYCOLAMINE® Agent (DGA®), a versatile amine used
across a range of applications. It is used in gas treating as an amine solvent for the bulk removal
of hydrogen sulfide, carbon dioxide and carbonyl sulfide. Other major applications include
electronics and metalworking, and it is an intermediate for products in end-use applications ranging
from agrochemicals to polyurethane foam insulation.

[ Learn More ][112]

## Low-Emission Polyurethane Catalysts

We are a leading global producer of low-emission polyurethane catalysts. Our JEFFCAT^{®} catalysts
provide reduced volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions and improved performance to a wide range
of polyurethane applications such as automotive seating, construction and furniture and bedding.

[ Learn More ][113]

## Carbonates

We are the only producer and largest supplier of propylene carbonate and ethylene carbonate in North
America. Our ULTRAPURE^{TM} high-purity cyclic carbonates and carbonate electrolyte solvents are
critical to the reliable operation and long working life of lithium-ion batteries for electronics
and electric vehicles. These carbonates are also used in cleaning applications in microelectronic
fabrications.

[ Learn More ][114]

Huntsman Advanced Materials is a leading global material solutions provider. Our portfolio of
adhesives, composites and formulation products meet demanding engineering specifications and address
customer-specific needs across a wide variety of industrial and consumer applications.

Serving more than 2,000 customers in over 30 countries, our dedicated employees are characterized by
their expertise in complex chemistry, long-standing relationships with our customers, and their
ability to develop and adapt our technology and applications know-how for new markets.

**Acquisitions**

In May 2020, Huntsman Advanced Materials completed the acquisition of CVC Thermoset Specialties
(CTS), a North American specialty chemical manufacturer serving the industrial composites, adhesives
and coatings markets. CTS offers specialized curing and toughening agents, resin adducts, and other
high-performance epoxy resins used in a wide range of applications.

In January 2021, Huntsman Advanced Materials completed the acquisition of [Gabriel Performance
Products][96], a North American specialty chemical manufacturer of specialty additives and epoxy
curing agents for the coatings, adhesives, sealants and composite end-markets, from Audax Private
Equity. To access the complete Gabriel product portfolio, please [click here][97].

## Featured Key Applications

### E-Mobility

Our Araldite® material solutions offer a wide range of heat-conductive encapsulants for electric
vehicles that can help manufacturers of electric motors to reduce the size, weight and cost of
production, while increasing the power output of the machines. Our thermal management solutions for
electronics applications in the electrified powertrain can improve power density, extend lifetime
and meet the highest temperature endurance requirements.

[ Learn More ][103]

### Aerospace & Defense

Our EPIBOND^{®}, EPOCAST^{®} and URALANE^{®} material solutions are qualified on over 200 OEM
specifications and backed by over 50 years of innovation - delivering performance where it matters
most. We can help you improve production processes, realize complex designs, reduce weight, remain
compliant with stringent standards and lower long-term maintenance costs.

[ Learn More ][104]

### Electrical Energy

Our Araldite® innovations can be found throughout the energy value chain, from power generation to
transmission, distribution and storage. Our products and services help leading global companies and
OEMs to address their electrical engineering challenges.

[ Learn More ][105]

## Other Key Applications

### Automotive

Our thermal management solutions for electronics applications in the electrified powertrain can
improve power density, extend lifetime, and meet the highest temperature endurance requirements,
while our wide range of automotive composite solutions answers the growing need for both high
performance and mass-production cycle times. Optimizing processes begins with selecting the right
materials, and Advanced Materials offers a range of products that are specially designed for
automotive processes.

[ Learn More ][106]

### Electronics

Our reputation in the electronics industry has been built on innovative solutions which address
protection, safety and sustainability. Our Araldite® material solutions are used at every stage of
the production process for printed circuit boards and electronic devices.

[ Learn More ][107]

### Sports and Leisure

Lightweight, strength, flexibility, design freedom and fatigue resistance are key factors driving
product development in this demanding industry. Huntsman has more than 50 years’ experience of
combining design materials, composite resins and adhesives in a variety of applications for sports
and leisure.

[ Learn More ][108]

## Key Material Technologies

## Coatings

Our Araldite® and Aradur® brands provide our customers with one of the broadest epoxy resins
portfolios in the industry and we are a global leader in curing agent supply. Our broad range of
material solutions in powder and liquid coatings can be found in transportation, automotive, marine,
architectural and consumer white goods applications.

## Adhesives

Araldite® adhesive range for assembly operations secures long-term performance and safety of
assemblies. Our product portfolio includes more than 300 adhesives and five adhesive technologies,
serving 22 industries worldwide.

production, while increasing the power output of the machines. Our thermal management solutions for
electronics applications in the electrified powertrain can improve power density, extend lifetime
and meet the highest temperature endurance requirements.

[ Learn More ][103]

### Aerospace & Defense

Our EPIBOND^{®}, EPOCAST^{®} and URALANE^{®} material solutions are qualified on over 200 OEM
specifications and backed by over 50 years of innovation - delivering performance where it matters
most. We can help you improve production processes, realize complex designs, reduce weight, remain
compliant with stringent standards and lower long-term maintenance costs.

[ Learn More ][104]

### Electrical Energy

Our Araldite® innovations can be found throughout the energy value chain, from power generation to
transmission, distribution and storage. Our products and services help leading global companies and
OEMs to address their electrical engineering challenges.

[ Learn More ][105]

## Other Key Applications

### Automotive

Our thermal management solutions for electronics applications in the electrified powertrain can
improve power density, extend lifetime, and meet the highest temperature endurance requirements,
while our wide range of automotive composite solutions answers the growing need for both high
performance and mass-production cycle times. Optimizing processes begins with selecting the right
materials, and Advanced Materials offers a range of products that are specially designed for
automotive processes.

[ Learn More ][106]

### Electronics

Our reputation in the electronics industry has been built on innovative solutions which address
protection, safety and sustainability. Our Araldite® material solutions are used at every stage of
the production process for printed circuit boards and electronic devices.

[ Learn More ][107]

### Sports and Leisure

Lightweight, strength, flexibility, design freedom and fatigue resistance are key factors driving
product development in this demanding industry. Huntsman has more than 50 years’ experience of
combining design materials, composite resins and adhesives in a variety of applications for sports
and leisure.

[ Learn More ][108]

## Key Material Technologies

## Coatings

Our Araldite® and Aradur® brands provide our customers with one of the broadest epoxy resins
portfolios in the industry and we are a global leader in curing agent supply. Our broad range of
material solutions in powder and liquid coatings can be found in transportation, automotive, marine,
architectural and consumer white goods applications.

## Adhesives

Araldite® adhesive range for assembly operations secures long-term performance and safety of
assemblies. Our product portfolio includes more than 300 adhesives and five adhesive technologies,
serving 22 industries worldwide.

**Huntsman Advanced Materials Certifications **

Huntsman Advanced Materials has implemented a Quality Management System (QMS) to assist in meeting
our [Quality Improvement Policy][103], and thus achieving our strategy to be a leading provider of
material solutions that creates value and growth for all stakeholders through effective and
efficient management of its business processes in conformance with the International Standard ISO
9001.

Parts of the business also comply with applicable sector-specific standards, such as automotive
standard IATF 16949, aerospace standard AS/EN 9100, ISO 14001 (environmental), and/or the standard
ISO 45001 (Occupational Health and Safety). In addition, Huntsman Advanced Materials is committed to
meeting the requirements of Huntsman's global EHS Standards.

**Huntsman Advanced Materials Quality Certificates **

Our certified systems started in 1987 at our site in Duxford (UK) with a certification according to
BS 5750 (an ISO 9001 predecessor). As the market requirements for Huntsman Advanced Materials have
evolved, so have we as a division.

**ISO 9001 Certification**

The current ISO 9001:2015 certification is globally valid for the whole division, Huntsman Advanced
Materials, and it encompasses all manufacturing sites.
* [ISO 9001:2015 (US and EU)][104]
* [ISO 9001:2015 (Panyu, China)][105]

**Automotive IATF 16949:2016 Certification**

Huntsman Advanced Materials operates four sites—Taboão da Serra (BR), Panyu (CN), Bad Säckingen
(DE), and Monthey (CH)—all of which hold IATF 16949 certification. In addition, there are remote
support locations in Basel (CH), Shanghai (CN), Kraków (PL), and Heredia (CR). These sites are
certified according to automotive industry requirements. However, certification applies only to
specific product lines and products. Please check with your customer service center to confirm
whether the products you purchased fall within the scope of this certification.
* [IATF 16949 - Taboao Da Serra][106]
* [IATF 16949 - Panyu][107]
* [IATF 16949 - Bad Sackingen][108]
* [IATF 16949 - Monthey][109]

**Aerospace standard AS/EN 9100 Certification**

Huntsman Advanced Materials holds site specific certifications according to the aerospace standard
AS 9100 and EN 9100 at our locations [Los Angeles (US)][110] and [Duxford (UK)][111].

**Huntsman Advanced Materials Environmental Certificates**

**ISO 14001 and Responsible Care**

Responsible Care^{®} is the chemical industry’s global voluntary initiative under which companies,
through their national associations, work together to continuously improve their health, safety and
environmental performance, and to communicate with stakeholders about their products and processes.

**Environmental ISO 14001 Certification**

Using Responsible Care^{®} as the base, several of our facilities have been certified to [ISO
14001][112]. Sites covered by this certificate are Bad Säckingen (DE), Bergkamen (DE), Duxford (UK),
Monthey (CH), Pamplona (ES), [Panyu (CI)][113], Rock Hill (US), Ashtabula (US), and Taboão da Serra
(BR).

**Occupational Health and Safety ISO 45001 Certification**

Using Responsible Care® as the base, Huntsman Advanced Materials holds site specific certifications
according to the OH&S standard ISO 45001 at our locations [Monthey (CH)][114] and [Bad Säckingen
(DE).][115]

**Laboratory Accreditation **

**Laboratory ISO 17025 Accreditation**

Our main laboratory for Material Testing located in Basel (CH) gained accreditation in 2005 for:
Testing laboratory for electrical, mechanical and aging characteristics of synthetic materials.
* [ISO 17025][116]

## What is Echo?

Echo is your 24/7 customer portal for quick and easy online interactions with Huntsman. It's the
source of information for your purchases across all systems and channels and provides instant access
to the information you need through an intuitive user interface and time-saving features.

[Document Access]

### Document Access

View and download invoices, COAs, and more

[Invoice Management]

### Invoice Management

Maintain accurate financial records

[Product Information]

### Product Information

Make informed decisions

[Online Order]

### Online Order

Easily browse and purchase products

[Get Support]

### Get Support

Reach Customer Service at a touch of a button

## How Echo can save you time and efforts?

Echo helps you increase your efficiency by streamlining purchasing processes, automating document
handling, facilitating self-service transactions and offering permanent access to our services.
These efficiency gains translate into faster decision-making, smoother workflows and improved
overall productivity for your purchasing team.

[Register for a webinar][98]

## 24/7 Availability

Access information and services anytime, anywhere

## Smooth Workflows

Online Order and Procurement Management

## 360° Visiblity

Live order status

## Multilingual Support

Available in multiple languages for global users

## Ready to see Echo in action?

Meet face to face with our Echo experts and see why already hundreds of customers globally trust our
customer portal to deliver exceptional purchasing experiences.

Free demo, zero commitment

A short 15-minute call to explore Echo

Followed by a discussion tailored to your user needs
[Schedule a demo][99]

> "Today's customers want answers - and they don't want to wait. Are items in stock? If not, what's
> the delivery time? How much does this order cost? With Echo, answers are all in one place,
> anytime."

Sara Brownlee, Office Sales Manager [See the interview][100]

## How Echo Works

Echo is a secure site linked in real time to Huntsman's systems, with access available to all our
customers. It's easy to set up and you can quickly start using it from any authorized desktop,
tablet or smartphone.

## Step 1

Reach-out to Customer Service to register your company account.
**OR**
Join one of our webinars to learn more about Echo. Your access link will be automatically sent to
you afterwards.

## Step 2

Receive your registration e-mail.

## Step 3

Access [https://echo.huntsmanservice.com][101] and create your password.

## Step 4

Start using Echo as your one-stop shop for all of your purchasing needs.

[Request an account][102]

## Frequently Asked Questions

#### Will Echo replace the interaction I currently have with my Huntsman customer service
#### representative?

][103]

No. You may continue to contact your Huntsman customer service representative at any time, for any
reason, as you do today.

#### The information of our orders and invoices are sensitive. Is the Echo platform secured?

][104]

Of course. Echo is a secured site linked in real time to our systems.Access is password secured and
reserved to our direct customers who can only see their own account details.

#### I order products from other Huntsman divisions; can I now use Echo to order all of my products?

][105]

Yes, you can access the account of another division you have access to by using the dropdown section
‘Other Division’ above the Huntsman Logo on the ECHO Home Page.

## Enriching Lives Through Innovation

### Huntsman embraces the entrepreneurial spirit of our founder, Jon Huntsman, and his core values
### of honesty, integrity, respect and responsibility.

For 50 years, our employees have been using science and ingenuity to create innovations that play a
critical role in the everyday lives of many millions of people.

As a global chemicals company, Huntsman’s work forms the building blocks for countless consumer and
industrial products that are part of your everyday life.

Our employees are united around a common goal: enriching lives through innovation.

## Our Business Divisions

Huntsman is comprised of three divisions, each of which has in-depth expertise in specific
chemistries and technologies and leading positions in the markets they serve.

#### Polyurethanes

Polyurethanes is a leading global producer of MDI-based polyurethanes focused on formulating
innovative, differentiated products for key downstream markets, including energy-saving insulation,
lightweighting and performance materials for automotive, comfort foam for bedding and furniture,
protective coatings, adhesives, and elastomers for footwear.

[View Division][93]

#### Advanced Materials

Advanced Materials provides specialty epoxy, acrylic and polyurethane-based polymer resin systems
and adhesive products, which are replacing traditional materials in aircraft, automobiles and
electrical power transmission. These products are also used in coatings, construction materials,
circuit boards and sports equipment.

[View Division][94]

#### Performance Products

Performance Products offers products that provide useful properties in everyday items people want
and need. Our leading global positions in the manufacture and sale of amines, maleic anhydride and
carbonates enable us to serve diverse consumer and industrial end markets, including energy,
automotive and transportation, coatings and adhesives, building and construction, electronics and
industrial manufacturing.

[View Division][95]

## Providing Solutions to Customers’ Challenges

We work in deep partnership with our customers to create solutions that help make people’s lives
more sustainable, effective, and comfortable. Our products are used in a diverse range of consumer
and industrial end markets, including aerospace, automotive and transportation, building and
construction, energy, as well as textiles and footwear.

[View Markets][96]

## Discover our global presence

We operate more than 60 manufacturing, research and development, and operations facilities in
approximately 25 countries and employ approximately 6,000 associates. Our global headquarters is in
The Woodlands, Texas, just north of Houston.

[View Locations][101]

## Enabling a Sustainable World

We see chemistry as a means of solving some of the most pressing societal challenges of our time.
Guided by our support of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and coupled with care for
our neighbors, we create products and innovations to help meet the world’s growing demands for food,
water, energy and opportunity. Learn about our journey to become a more sustainable business.

[View Sustainability][102]

## Huntsman’s History

The Huntsman Corporation was initially founded as the Huntsman Container Corporation in 1970 by Jon
Huntsman. Our company has grown through a series of acquisitions (with some divestitures). We went
public on the New York Stock Exchange in February 2005. Read more about our history and growth over
the decades.

[View History][103]

## Help inspire our innovations

The ingenuity and commitment of our employees drives innovations across a wide array of markets and
applications, enriching the lives of millions of people across the world. Our people-centered
company offers incredible opportunities for those prepared to take responsibility for their future.
Get started today!

# About Us

### Innovating CHEMISTRY

**SAM POLYURETHANES PVT. LTD.** is a renowned Importer & Distributor of Chemicals, engaged in
indenting, stocking and distribution of a wide range of Polyurethane chemicals since 2012. We are
selling Polyols, TDI, Silicones catalysts and Additives, MDI, Modified MDI and pre-polymer (Binder)
to the above-end market. We also sell preblended systems and PMDI for the rigid insulation
applications. We are also Selling various PU chemicals for the viscos molded pillows, HRmolded
furniture systems, Batch block viscos and HR systems to the customers in good quantities.

**SAM POLYURETHANES PVT. LTD.** is a leading distributer of chemicals for all kinds of foam
indusries in pan India with warehouses at the Pan India level. We supply as per the demands
ofcustomers in the foam manufacturing world with the very competitive environment in a flexible way.

We are in the business of assisting the industry for international as well as local sourcing and
supply of raw materials and ready fo use products for PU foam manufacturing and im to provide added
products and services fo our esteemed customers. We represent several reputed international
manufacturers of our supplied products, some of whom are the world leaders in their fields. **SAM
POLYURETHANES PVT. LTD.** caters to various industries in the field of Polyurethenes like Flexible
slab stock, Rigid Insulations, Flexible molded, Furniture, Footwearand the automotive industry, etc.

We, **SAM POLYURETHANES PVT. LTD.** have been effective in establishing ourselves in this field so
far in India with our Headquarter in New Delhi. Our company caters to the requirements of the
clients throughout the country with ease and precision.

We are supported by a reputed vendor base who constantly offers us qualitative range of products
which are supplied to the clients fully understanding the need of the end customers. Further, we are
also enabled with a team of technical experts who are hard working. In addition, we have our own
warehouses, R&D center and related infrastructure which helps us in our current business and would
also help us in expanding our business over the years.

### Our Comprehensive

Followings are the list of raw material which we can supply:

### Basic PU Raw Material
* TDI, All types of Polyether Polyol for flexible slab stock foam.
* MDI, All types of base Polyether Polyol for Rigid foam.
* High EO Polyols/6000Mw/5000Mw/HR Polyols/VE Polyols.
* Methylene Chloride.

### Special Pre-Blended System
* Pre-blended system for HR molded foam (from 35 to 90 molded density), TDI/MDI Based.
* Pre-blended system for HR slab batch ( from 30 fo 60 density), TDI based.
* Pre-blended system for Viscos slab batch foam (from 40 fo 100 density) MDI based.
* Pre-blended system Viscos Elastic molded foam (from 40 to 90 density), MDI based.

[Read More][41]

### Other Products
* Pre-polymer MDI for Rebonded foam.
* Modified MDI for HR molded system.
* Polyester Polyols (All types).
* Special Polyol for VE/Rigid/HR/Adhesives.
* Base Polyols for Viscos-Elastic/HR foam manufacturing in continuous line for slab stock.

[Read More][42]

### SPECIAL FEATURES OF SAM POLYURETHANES PVT. LTD. BUSINESS PROTFOLIO:
* We represent Wanhua as a distributor & an indenting agent for the product, Polyols, TDI, MDI,
PMDI, VE systems and Modified MDI (All types) at PAN India level.
* We represent Hejia Chemicals as a distributor & an indenting agent for all fypes of silicones
Catalysts and additives.
* We are manufacturing and supplying Prepolymer for Rebonded foam binders.

# About Us

### Innovating CHEMISTRY

**SAM POLYURETHANES PVT. LTD.** is a renowned Importer & Distributor of Chemicals, engaged in
indenting, stocking and distribution of a wide range of Polyurethane chemicals since 2012. We are
selling Polyols, TDI, Silicones catalysts and Additives, MDI, Modified MDI and pre-polymer (Binder)
to the above-end market. We also sell preblended systems and PMDI for the rigid insulation
applications. We are also Selling various PU chemicals for the viscos molded pillows, HRmolded
furniture systems, Batch block viscos and HR systems to the customers in good quantities.

**SAM POLYURETHANES PVT. LTD.** is a leading distributer of chemicals for all kinds of foam
indusries in pan India with warehouses at the Pan India level. We supply as per the demands
ofcustomers in the foam manufacturing world with the very competitive environment in a flexible way.

We are in the business of assisting the industry for international as well as local sourcing and
supply of raw materials and ready fo use products for PU foam manufacturing and im to provide added
products and services fo our esteemed customers. We represent several reputed international
manufacturers of our supplied products, some of whom are the world leaders in their fields. **SAM
POLYURETHANES PVT. LTD.** caters to various industries in the field of Polyurethenes like Flexible
slab stock, Rigid Insulations, Flexible molded, Furniture, Footwearand the automotive industry, etc.

We, **SAM POLYURETHANES PVT. LTD.** have been effective in establishing ourselves in this field so
far in India with our Headquarter in New Delhi. Our company caters to the requirements of the
clients throughout the country with ease and precision.

We are supported by a reputed vendor base who constantly offers us qualitative range of products
which are supplied to the clients fully understanding the need of the end customers. Further, we are
also enabled with a team of technical experts who are hard working. In addition, we have our own
warehouses, R&D center and related infrastructure which helps us in our current business and would
also help us in expanding our business over the years.
