# About Us

### Innovating CHEMISTRY

**SAM POLYURETHANES PVT. LTD.** is a renowned Importer & Distributor of Chemicals, engaged in
indenting, stocking and distribution of a wide range of Polyurethane chemicals since 2012. We are
selling Polyols, TDI, Silicones catalysts and Additives, MDI, Modified MDI and pre-polymer (Binder)
to the above-end market. We also sell preblended systems and PMDI for the rigid insulation
applications. We are also Selling various PU chemicals for the viscos molded pillows, HRmolded
furniture systems, Batch block viscos and HR systems to the customers in good quantities.

**SAM POLYURETHANES PVT. LTD.** is a leading distributer of chemicals for all kinds of foam
indusries in pan India with warehouses at the Pan India level. We supply as per the demands
ofcustomers in the foam manufacturing world with the very competitive environment in a flexible way.

We are in the business of assisting the industry for international as well as local sourcing and
supply of raw materials and ready fo use products for PU foam manufacturing and im to provide added
products and services fo our esteemed customers. We represent several reputed international
manufacturers of our supplied products, some of whom are the world leaders in their fields. **SAM
POLYURETHANES PVT. LTD.** caters to various industries in the field of Polyurethenes like Flexible
slab stock, Rigid Insulations, Flexible molded, Furniture, Footwearand the automotive industry, etc.

We, **SAM POLYURETHANES PVT. LTD.** have been effective in establishing ourselves in this field so
far in India with our Headquarter in New Delhi. Our company caters to the requirements of the
clients throughout the country with ease and precision.

We are supported by a reputed vendor base who constantly offers us qualitative range of products
which are supplied to the clients fully understanding the need of the end customers. Further, we are
also enabled with a team of technical experts who are hard working. In addition, we have our own
warehouses, R&D center and related infrastructure which helps us in our current business and would
also help us in expanding our business over the years.

### Our Comprehensive

Followings are the list of raw material which we can supply:

### Basic PU Raw Material
* TDI, All types of Polyether Polyol for flexible slab stock foam.
* MDI, All types of base Polyether Polyol for Rigid foam.
* High EO Polyols/6000Mw/5000Mw/HR Polyols/VE Polyols.
* Methylene Chloride.

[Read More][40]

### Special Pre-Blended System
* Pre-blended system for HR molded foam (from 35 to 90 molded density), TDI/MDI Based.
* Pre-blended system for HR slab batch ( from 30 fo 60 density), TDI based.
* Pre-blended system for Viscos slab batch foam (from 40 fo 100 density) MDI based.
* Pre-blended system Viscos Elastic molded foam (from 40 to 90 density), MDI based.

[Read More][41]

### Other Products
* Pre-polymer MDI for Rebonded foam.
* Modified MDI for HR molded system.
* Polyester Polyols (All types).
* Special Polyol for VE/Rigid/HR/Adhesives.
* Base Polyols for Viscos-Elastic/HR foam manufacturing in continuous line for slab stock.

[Read More][42]

### SPECIAL FEATURES OF SAM POLYURETHANES PVT. LTD. BUSINESS PROTFOLIO:
* We represent Wanhua as a distributor & an indenting agent for the product, Polyols, TDI, MDI,
PMDI, VE systems and Modified MDI (All types) at PAN India level.
* We represent Hejia Chemicals as a distributor & an indenting agent for all fypes of silicones
Catalysts and additives.
* We are manufacturing and supplying Prepolymer for Rebonded foam binders.

_crawl.linkedin_about: AS Rubber & Plastics are one of the largest distributors of PVC Foam from 90Kg to 320Kg in the United Kingdom. AS Rubber & Plastics Limited was established in 1996 by Arthur Weale who had over twenty-five years experience in the industry sector. The main core activity of the business was the distribution of plain and adhesive coated cellular foam, with the primary material at that time being PVC foam supplied by our business partners the Italian foam producers Copescoat, into sectors such as automotive, construction, HVAC, medical electrical and engineering. As a result of the company’s continued growth by the end of 2001 AS Rubber & Plastics Limited reached full capacity and moved to a double unit with over 16000 square feet, with integrated offices and space for its own machinery investment which included laminators and log cutters. The company’s staff and turnover grew in the UK and extended to exports, and AS Rubber & Plastics Ltd were presented with the Innercity 100 Award in November 2002. Our product range continued to diverse further in 2004 when the company employed further Sales staff from within the Rubber and Foam Industry which helped the company to increase its manufacturing business further. With the continued growth of AS Rubber & Plastics Ltd in October 2011 the company relocated to new premises in West Bromwich. The relocation has given us a much improved working environment and will also give us the capacity for the continual growth of the business with further investment in machinery. Our relationship with Copescoat remains stronger than ever and our Sales of various types of PVC foams and Vinyls continues to improve year on year. We are always looking at new materials to add to our current product range which include EPDM and Neoprene Sponge, Nitrile PVC, Polyethylene Foams and many different types of Polyurethane Foams and a wide range of acrylic adhesive tapes we can supply in log and cut roll form.
_crawl.key_brands_represented: Gaskets; Seals; Insulation Foams; Adhesive Tapes; Filter Foam

European Association of Flexible Polyurethane Foam Blocks Manufacturers Non-profit organization Compliant with EU competition law CertiPUR Strong representation in the European market Commitment to sustainability and circular economy Collaboration with various stakeholders in the industry Responsible Care® REACH Regulation compliance Avenue de Cortenbergh 71, 1000 Bruxelles, BELGIUM Belgium Geographical Europe Africa Middle East CIS countries EUROPUR & EURO-MOULDERS Annual Conference 2026 scheduled for June 19, 2026. Safety Guidelines now available in French as of April 14, 2026. Support for the 'Circular Plastics Made In Europe' campaign as of March 5, 2026. Promote the benefits of flexible polyurethane foam. Contribute to standards and legislation related to PU flexible foam. Facilitate cooperation between companies along the supply chain. Regulatory compliance with evolving EU legislation. Environmental concerns regarding foam production and recycling. Expansion of membership to include producers from Africa, the Middle East, and CIS countries. Growing demand for sustainable and recyclable materials in the foam industry. EUROPUR represents the vast majority of flexible PU foam plants in the European Economic Area, producing around 90% of the foam made in the region. Increasing focus on sustainability and circular economy initiatives. Rising demand for flexible polyurethane foam in various applications. EUROPUR – Homepage

Health & Safety
As part of the chemical industry, EUROPUR is committed to Reponsible CareTM.
We seek to continuously improve the environmental, health and safety
knowledge and performance of our technologies, processes and products over their lifecycles. Discover more

Sustainability
We are committed to transition to a circular economy. Flexible polyurethane foam is a fully recyclable material. With recent development of technology, we can expect polyurethane to have limitless cycles of recycling and thus becoming fully circular. Discover more

CertiPUR
CertiPUR is a voluntary testing, analysis and certification

programme for the environment, health and safety properties of

polyurethane foam used in bedding and upholstered furniture applications Discover more

_crawl.linkedin_about: EUROPUR is the European association of flexible polyurethane foam blocks manufacturers. Polyurethane foams make our daily lives safer and more comfortable. They are vital to applications that we take for granted. Mattresses, furniture cushions and car seats are just some examples. On the website www.europur.org you will find more information about flexible polyurethane foams, their many uses and contribution to our quality of life as well as about our association and its activities. As part of the global chemical industry, EUROPUR is committed to Responsible Care®. This notably means that we seek to continuously improve the environmental, health and safety knowledge and performance of our technologies, processes and products over their life cycles .

# ABOUT US

**EUROPUR is the European Association of Flexible PU Foam Blocks Manufacturers**. Founded in 1966
and located in Brussels, we have been representing our industry and been providing a platform to
discuss and act on the major issues related to foam production and use for more than five decades.

Today our foam producing members operate production plants in 32 countries in geographical Europe.
Since 2019 we welcome foam producers from Africa, the Middle East and CIS countries in our
membership. Together, **our members operate the vast majority of flexible PU foam plants in the
European Economic Area and produce around 90% of the foam made in the region**. The way our members
operate is as diverse as is the PU industry: some members sell foam blocks only, some create
semi-finished products and some make mattresses, furniture and other consumer goods directly.

**Nearly 70 organisations from the flexible PU foam supply chain are associated members** in our
association: raw materials and additives suppliers, machinery manufacturers and various service
providers ranging from laboratories to recycling companies.

## OUR MISSION

[promote_icon]

### PROMOTE

the unique benefits of flexible polyurethane (PU) foam in its multiple applications.

[speak_icon]

### SPEAK

on behalf of the European flexible PU block foam industry to regulators and other stakeholders (e.g.
media, consumers, industry associations).

[contribute_icon]

### CONTRIBUTE

to standards and legislation related to PU flexible foam and our industry, by providing adequate
expertise to decision-makers.

[initiate_icon]

### INITIATE

research projects on the performance of flexible PU foam throughout its lifecycle, notably including
health, safety and the environment.

[communicate_icon]

### COMMUNICATE

on research project results, and publish information of common interest to our members, the public
and other interested stakeholders.

[motivate_icon]

### MOTIVATE

motivate our members to continuously improve the environmental, health and safety knowledge and
performance of their technologies, processes and products over the lifecycle.

[provide_icon]

### PROVIDE

up-to-date information to our members on foam industry-related legislation and its evolutions, as
well as general market data in full compliance with EU competition law.

[facilitate_icon]

### Facilitate

cooperation between companies along the supply chain for the common benefit of industry (e.g. to
transition to a circular economy)

## WORKING GROUPS

To achieve its mission, EUROPUR relies on cooperation between experts from its member organisations
in working groups, which operate according to the priorities set by our members. Their number and
scope may thus vary over time. We currently have four working groups: Product Stewardship &
Impurities, Environment, Health & Safety (EHS), Sustainability and Communication. Our member experts
work together in these working groups for the common benefit of the industry, in full compliance
with competition law.

Our strength is in numbers: in recent years between 10 and 50 experts with numerous backgrounds
regularly participate in the work of individual working groups.

Product stewardship & impurities

**Chair:** Julie Walker, Innovation Manager, The Vita Group

**Lead Staff:** Patrick de Kort, Regulatory Affairs Manager, EUROPUR

Product Stewardship and Impurities is EUROPUR’s ‘historical’ working group in which members discuss
all issues related to polyurethane foam and raw materials. It seeks to ensure that polyurethane foam
is produced according to the highest standards and in compliance with all legislation relating to
chemical substances used in foam production. As such it:
* Regularly **evaluates **and updates the specifications of EUROPUR’s environment, health and safety
standard, [**CertiPUR**][79][.][80]
* **Cooperates **with other stakeholders along the PU foam supply chain for continuous **product
improvement**, as well as for information collection on risk assessments and exposure scenarios
for substances used in the manufacturing of PU foam.
* **Monitors regulatory developments** relating to substances, notably under the REACH Regulation,
and informs members so that they can act accordingly to comply with legislation.
* **Provides input **into initiatives that aim at allowing market uptake of environmentally-friendly
products, such as the EU ecolabel criteria for mattresses and furniture.
* **Monitors **anonymous **test results** on polyurethane foam from companies participating in the
CertiPUR programme to identify substances present in foam as impurities.

Environment, Health & Safety

**Chair: **Georg Pirkl, Head of Business Development Raw Materials EMEA, Covestro

**Vice-chair: **Paul Alfred Howard, Manufacturing Engineering Manager, Adient

EUROPUR’s Environment, Health & Safety working group is composed of representatives of flexible PU
foam manufacturers and suppliers to the industry, which cooperate to:
* **Analyse **potential **risks** linked to the production of flexible polyurethane foam, notably as
regards the handling of raw materials
* **Makes recommendations** to the industry to ensure progress towards ever safer workplaces.
* **Discuss** and evaluate **best practises** for the production of flexible polyurethane foam, with
a strong focus on the protection of workers and the environment.
* **Exchange **information **on incidents** and near-incidents in foaming plants to allow members to
learn from each other and help in mitigating risks across the entire industry.
* **Exchange **information on the implementation of **EU legislation** related to production
facilities by EU Member States.
* **Create **a Training material course allowing members to comply with REACH Restriction for
Diisocyanates.
* **Provide input** into regulatory discussions **on safe handling of chemicals **at EU level but
also in Member States.
* **Liaise **with the rest of the supply chain to improve safety **on shared activities** (e.g.
transportation of raw materials)

SUSTAINABILITY

**Chair:** Bart Haelterman, R&D Director, Carpenter

**Vice-chairs:** Mike Murray, Chief Technology Officer, The Vita Group & Marcel Moeller, Global
Sustainability Director, Dow Polyurethanes

**Lead Staff:** Theodoros Mardas, Sustainability Policy and Market Research Officer

This working group was launched in June of 2015. It provides a platform for members to exchange
knowledge and information on the lifecycle of flexible polyurethane foam. This includes innovative
raw materials, improvement of production processes, recycling of post-industrial and post-consumer
foams and recycling technologies.

The working group also performs research in areas of common interest to support members in improving
the life-cycle of PU foam and its recycling. It closely monitors discussions taking place at EU and
Member State level and, where relevant, provides input on end-of-life of foam-containing products,
extended producer responsibility schemes and legislation pertaining to specific products (e.g.
mattresses, furniture, automobiles).

In 2022 a specialised ‘Advocacy Working Group’ has been formed. Participants are industry experts in
the field of sustainability, coming from member companies active in recycling of flexible
polyurethane foam. The group reports to Chair of the Sustainability WG.

Communication

** Chair:** Bart J.
ten Brink, President, EUROPUR

** Lead Staff:** Constance
Rossi, Communications Officer

A communications working group was set-up in 2014. It is supporting the secretariat to reinforce
EUROPUR’s ability to promote the unique benefits of polyurethane foam in its multiple applications
in cooperation with other stakeholders from the supply chain, to organise our Annual Conference and
coordinate our social media messaging.

Health & Safety
As part of the chemical industry, EUROPUR is committed to Reponsible CareTM.
We seek to continuously improve the environmental, health and safety
knowledge and performance of our technologies, processes and products over their lifecycles.
[Discover more][83]
Sustainability
We are committed to transition to a circular economy. Flexible polyurethane foam is a fully
recyclable material. With recent development of technology, we can expect polyurethane to have
limitless cycles of recycling and thus becoming fully circular.
[Discover more][84]
CertiPUR
CertiPUR is a voluntary testing, analysis and certification
programme for the environment, health and safety properties of
polyurethane foam used in bedding and upholstered furniture applications

Health & Safety
As part of the chemical industry, EUROPUR is committed to Reponsible CareTM.
We seek to continuously improve the environmental, health and safety
knowledge and performance of our technologies, processes and products over their lifecycles.
[Discover more][83]
Sustainability
We are committed to transition to a circular economy. Flexible polyurethane foam is a fully
recyclable material. With recent development of technology, we can expect polyurethane to have
limitless cycles of recycling and thus becoming fully circular.
[Discover more][84]
CertiPUR
CertiPUR is a voluntary testing, analysis and certification
programme for the environment, health and safety properties of
polyurethane foam used in bedding and upholstered furniture applications

Health & Safety

recyclable material. With recent development of technology, we can expect polyurethane to have
limitless cycles of recycling and thus becoming fully circular.

Relive the energy of the India Mattresstech & Upholstery Supplies Expo (IME) - India’s dedicated B2B platform for the mattress manufacturing and upholstery supply industry. Watch the highlights and experience where manufacturers, suppliers, and innovators connect, source new technologies, and shape the future of the sleep products industry in India.

#### Snorer

Support and alignment matter most and so does ergonomic mattress structures and supportive pillow
technologies for you.

#### Snooze Master

You appreciate plush comfort, explored through premium foams and advanced comfort layers.

#### Pillow Hugger

Pillows and accessories define your comfort, from fillings and fabrics to upholstery materials.

#### Night Owl

Recovery after long days is key and you want mattress comfort materials and sleep innovations.

#### Early Bird

You value balanced support and reliability which is built on durable mattress components and
well-engineered materials.

#### Deep Sleeper

You value strong support and durability and focus on springs, foams and mattress core components
that shape better sleep.

#### Light Sleeper

You prioritise quiet comfort and give attention to quilting, advanced foams and fabric technologies
that reduce disturbance.

#### Endless Scroller

Late nights need adaptable comfort and you value modern mattress materials and ergonomic design
innovations.
